species.name: Slime
species.flavor: Gorgeous globs of goo that are loathed as monsters almost as much as they are loved as mascots. Honestly, just look at that cheeky smile...

species.name: Dracky
species.flavor: Bat-like blighters who grin like nobody's business to hide the fact that they're afraid of pretty much everything.

species.name: Boss troll
species.flavor: Grotesque giants that lord their power over all trollkind. Anyone unlucky enough to get knocked down by their clubs is unlikely to ever get back up again.

species.name: Metal slime
species.flavor: Mercurial monsters that flee at a moment's notice. Their appearance delights, but their inevitable escape leaves you dreaming of the experience you could've had.

species.name: Ghost
species.flavor: Spectral so-and-sos who vanish as soon as they're done scaring their victims-usually unsuspecting travellers.

species.name: Golem
species.flavor: A statue built by human hand, and brought to life in order to stand guard over Cantlin. Tragically, it was tainted with evil, and turned into a monster.

species.name: Bewarewolf
species.flavor: Although they're strong and like to come out swinging, they're far from stupid. In fact, they're the intellectual pride of the werewolf world.

species.name: Scarewolf
species.flavor: Werewolves who've figured out how to cast Fizzle, which they use to muffle their enemies' magic before flinging themselves into the fray, fists flying.

species.name: Tearwolf
species.flavor: Well-respected in the werewolf community, these lupine leaders are said to have been elevated to their position of power by dint of their ability to cast spells-a rare skill among their kind.

species.name: Prestidigitator
species.flavor: Once earnest students of spell-craft, these weak-willed sorcerers were seduced by the illicit allure of black magic, and are now no longer men.

species.name: Lunatick
species.flavor: These curious monsters' enormous eyeballs afford them excellent vision, even in absolute darkness. Once they set their sights on their prey, they will not give up until they wrap their tentacles around it.

species.name: Raving lunatick
species.flavor: Ticks who've taken on board dangerous levels of darkness. As leaders among their kind, they're also curiously considerate, and as such, are handy with healing spells.

species.name: Scorpion
species.flavor: The unhappy outcome of spontaneous mutation, these overgrown arachnids use their giant stingers to subjugate their prey.

species.name: Cosmic chimaera
species.flavor: A chimaera whose form was forever changed by the light of a meteor shower, which also pumped its powers through the roof.

species.name: Green dragon
species.flavor: A truly terrifying creature whose claws alone have cut short the careers of countless adventurers. Add fiery breath and a tree trunk of a tail, and you can see why the Dragonlord set one to guard Princess Gwaelin.

species.name: Blue dragon
species.flavor: Ice-breathing dragons of pre-eminent power. Though rarely forced to fight in earnest, when they do, a single snap of their enormous jaws is usually enough to end the argument.

species.name: Dread dragon
species.flavor: The latest in a legendary line of superior serpents. Even the Dragonlord recognizes them as a force to be reckoned with, and counts many of their number among his closest coterie.

species.name: Skeleton
species.flavor: They spend their days scouring the land for whoever it was that gave them the bonk on the head that cracked their skull and killed them.

species.name: Army ant
species.flavor: Army ants are absolutely obsessed with order. If any member of the insectoid infantry should slip out of step with its allies, it will send itself straight to bed without supper

species.name: Ratscal
species.flavor: Rodent-like monsters who call mountainous regions home. They've survived in the wild for years upon years thanks to their top-class survival instincts.}}

species.name: Terrordactyl
species.flavor: Flying dragons whose deep blue hue enables them to pursue their prey across sea and sky all but undetected.

species.name: Deadnaut
species.flavor: Sorrowful soldiers who've had their souls stolen, and are forced to stay enslaved to their masters even after their bodies have gone, and only bones remain.

species.name: Badboon
species.flavor: Though viciously violent, these enormous apes use their brains as much as their brawn. Their favourite trick is to outwit their prey by lying in wait for it where it would least expect.

species.name: Cobra kaiser
species.flavor: Vicious snakes whose venomousness is made very obvious by their violent colouration. Their favoured meal-making method is to weaken their prey with poison and spells, then wolf it down whole.

species.name: Smog
species.flavor: Cloud-like creatures formed when evil intentions accumulate. They tire travellers out by fogging up their field of vision and sending them round in circles, then strike when they're at their weakest.

species.name: Merlusc
species.flavor: Slug-like sea creatures that stick onto passing ships, then slither up the sides to snack on whoever happens to be aboard.

species.name: Berserker
species.flavor: Swirling, whirling balls of monstrous energy that carve a path across the battlefield, cutting down enemy and ally alike-often to the extreme annoyance of their fellow fiends.

species.name: Fat rat
species.flavor: Great big rodents with teeny tiny hearts who start running scared at the slightest of sounds.

species.name: Maulusc
species.flavor: Slimy creatures that favour muggy climes. Mauluscs are so insidious that, despite being slugs, they can't resist rubbing salt in their enemies' wounds.

species.name: Chewlip
species.flavor: Cute little carnivorous plants that just kept growing and growing until eventually they were huge, hideous, man-eating monsters.

species.name: Sentripede
species.flavor: Insects so thick-skinned that average attacks won't so much as scratch them. The cause of many an adventurer deciding to supplement their swordplay with some spell-casting.

species.name: Cyclops
species.flavor: One-eyed giants that roam the wilds of Rendarak. One swing of their enormous arms is enough to topple trees for miles around.

species.name: Eyelasher
species.flavor: Its tentacles are equipped with all five senses, and are massively more dexterous than any analogous human appendage. Creepy...

species.name: Mean spirit
species.flavor: So named because of their upsetting appearance--they look so unbelievably unpleasant that some even liken them to deities of death. But they're not actually all that bad.

species.name: Dragonfly
species.flavor: Fiends that have figured out how to float like butterflies and sting like enormous, fire-breathing serpents. Their flame attacks are so quick and deadly that they strike terror into even the most toughened travellers' hearts.

species.name: Gargoyle
species.flavor: Creatures cursed with voices so raspy that even they themselves get annoyed. They can often be seen gargling with rainwater to try and remedy the issue.

species.name: Miasma
species.flavor: Gaseous gatherings-together of grudge-riddled, rage-fuelled fog. The vast majority of accidents at sea and other mist-based misadventures are caused by these malicious monsters.

species.name: Ghoul
species.flavor: The vile revivifications of rancid cadavers. They feel no pain and wander in search of fresh flesh until they fall apart-an eventuality that might not actually be that far off.

species.name: Gigantes
species.flavor: These heartless, hulking horrors are responsible for the tragic ends of countless travellers, who they clobber with their clubs.

species.name: Batmandrill
species.flavor: Winged warlocks who lay waste to all before them with powerful spells and blistering breath attacks. A nightmare come to life.

species.name: Orc chieftain
species.flavor: As orcs age, their fur gradually gains a golden hue. When their whole coat has turned, they are given purple tunics to commemorate the occasion.

species.name: Goregon
species.flavor: According to legend, these are the severed heads of heartbroken sorceresses decapitated for daring to dabble in forbidden love.

species.name: Gremlin
species.flavor: These miniature monsters apprentice to other demons while they wait to become full fledged fiends. Though they may not look it, they're extremely studious sorts.

species.name: Hawk man
species.flavor: Knights of the sky who sling spells as well as swinging swords. Their chivalric pretensions are a rarity among monsters and are also, quite frankly, an impediment to the business of baddie-ing.

species.name: Hargonaut
species.flavor: Soldiers who have offered up their bodies and their souls to High Priest Hargon, and whose loyalty does not fade, even in death.

species.name: Gnashturtium
species.flavor: These fearsome carnivorous flowers go around weakening unwary wanderers with poison before swallowing them whole.

species.name: Grimlin
species.flavor: These lovable little rouges of the demon kingdom don't bat an eyelid when berated for being rude, or playing tricks on their betters. And everyone forgives them nonetheless. They're just so adorable!

species.name: Orc king
species.flavor: Keen contrarians who rant and rave at their underlings for getting hurt, but can't help using Moreheal to make them better.

species.name: Orc
species.flavor: These hulking hogs take their training seriously, and practise Multithrust about a million times a day. But despite this diligence, the wild boar blood in their veins means they're far from mild-mannered.

species.name: Mummy
species.flavor: These sad souls believed in the afterlife until they reawakened like this. Now, they despise all life and shamble about looking to add more to their ranks.

species.name: Iron ant
species.flavor: While they may appear steely at first glance, these cowardly critters give up all to easily at the first sign of hardship.

species.name: Cobra king
species.flavor: Every single one of these snakes has the exact same pattern on its skin, irrespective of environment, eating habits or any other factor. One of the great mysteries of the animal kingdom.

species.name: Dragonfry
species.flavor: Diminutive dragons with the wings of insects and tails that are said to be surprisingly soft and squishy to the touch.

species.name: Whackolyte
species.flavor: A devotee of the dark arts so dedicated to death and destruction that they were brought back from beyond the grave to further hone their horrific powers.

species.name: Somnol ant
species.flavor: Annoying insects that send foes to sleep before sneaking off back to their nest with them. They have to move so slowly to keep their victims from stirring that they sometimes wake and make a break for freedom.

species.name: Big badboon
species.flavor: Burly apes covered in gaudy green fur. They're exceptionally social animals, and enjoy hunting in packs.

species.name: Tyrannodactyl
species.flavor: Though graceful aerialists in general, they're mediocre multitaskers, and often crash into trees and suchlike while trying to cast magic on the wing.

species.name: Magus
species.flavor: These masked monsters are masters of magic, though they display little dedication to the study of the dark arts. Indeed, it is to avoid hard work that the lazy devils learn each and every spell that might make their lives easier.

species.name: Madusa
species.flavor: A gratuitously grotesque creature composed of an eyeball surrounded by slithering snakes. Some have suggested that they came about when a witch was caught up in her own curse by accident.

species.name: Chasmonaut
species.flavor: Knights who, having wished never to die, were brought back by diabolical forces. The jaunty angle they walk at speaks to their cavalier disposition.

species.name: Killipede
species.flavor: These intransigent insects-close relatives of the Sentripede--are hard-headed in both senses of the world, being both sensationally stubborn, and extremely well-armoured.

species.name: Toady
species.flavor: Amphibian abominations that propel their tongues to drag in prey before it can react. Questionable table manners though they may have, these croakers are cracking crooners.

species.name: Toxic toad
species.flavor: Poisonous pests whose harmful secretions cause crops to wither and waste away in their wake. The arch-nemeses of farmers the world over.

species.name: Overtoad
species.flavor: Kings among toadfolk, they love to sing, but are more monotone than baritone. This makes for boring ballads that put people to sleep more often than not.

species.name: Batterfly
species.flavor: Each flap of their fragile wings sends forth a fine cloud of scales, which causes their prey to hallucinate when inhaled, allowing them to swoop in for a quick bite.}}

species.name: Betterfly
species.flavor: More barbaric than their batterfly brethren, these winged inconveniences like to tease their targets before discharging a volley of magical spells.

species.name: Dread admiral
species.flavor: Their wings release tiny scales that, when inhaled, induce instant paralysis. And they wonder why nobody ever wants to play with them...

species.name: Antnibbler
species.flavor: Though their twisty tongues and keen claws are likely to leave long-lasting lacerations, these monsters prefer to eat ants over adventurers.}}

species.name: Antgobbler
species.flavor: All the ants they've eaten have granted them immense strength, enabling them to slash through solid stone with a swipe of their claws.

species.name: Antguzzler
species.flavor: Their claws can cut iron and their tongues topple trees, yet their appetite for ants shows no sign of abating. Who knows how they got so strong on such a meagre diet...

species.name: Waspion
species.flavor: Airborne annoyances that flatter to deceive--their stingers are devoid of venom, causing many of them to suffer from wicked impostor syndrome.

species.name: Scornet
species.flavor: It is said that wasps attack people in black, but scornets are not so picky--old rags, haute couture or even someone starkers, they go after everyone regardless of outfit.

species.name: Rumble bee
species.flavor: Insectoid irritations with improbable intelligence, they excel at the Sizz spell and flee at the first sign of defeat. Cowardice is the better part of valour, after all.

species.name: Killerpillar
species.flavor: Large larvae that are sluggish when crawling, but can reach stupendous speeds when they roll up into a ball.

species.name: Illerpillar
species.flavor: These lugubrious larvae consume quantities of toxic weeds, enabling them to exhale poisonous breath. They dream of the day they can spread their wings as beautiful butterflies.

species.name: Grillerpillar
species.flavor: Spewing flames all day can take its toll on one's throat. These larvae can lessen that burning sensation and get straight back to spitting fire by drinking some molten lava.

species.name: Vladdy
species.flavor: Demonic delinquents that stalk the dead of night in their dapper three-piece suits and bow-ties. If they have a preferred tailor, they do a great job of keeping them secret.

species.name: Drac the Vlad
species.flavor: Blood-sucking baddies who refuse point-blank to go near male arteries--except on the battlefield, where any blood becomes potable!

species.name: Vladiator
species.flavor: Venerable vampires that have lived longer than most other monsters. As such, they are strong beyond compare and have, perhaps ironically, gained a good grasp of healing magic.

species.name: Seaslime
species.flavor: Lovers of sand, sea and sunslime, they spend their days on the beach, ever on the lookout for a snazzy new shell to grow into.}}

species.name: Raven lunatic
species.flavor: Widely derided as harbingers of calamity, these cruel crows can crush the rocks they hold in their claws with consummate ease.

species.name: Spiked hare
species.flavor: These barbaric bunnies like nothing more than barging into enemies horn-first. Some say their purple hue is due to bruising from the impact.}}

species.name: Putrefido
species.flavor: Undead dogs reanimated by mysterious means. Though they wander with little purpose, drooling as they shuffle, they are known to befriend humans.

species.name: Bullmustiff
species.flavor: Maggot-ridden mutts that died and never went to doggy heaven. Now they roam the land looking to weaken their enemies and earn the edge in battle.

species.name: Rottenweiler
species.flavor: Canids that succumbed to starvation only to be resurrected by dark devices. A phantom hunger now besets their bellies as they search for their next unfulfilling meal.

species.name: Crabber dabber doo
species.flavor: Any time is feeding time for these ravenous crabs with insatiable appetites. They're always salivating at the prospect of tucking into an unwary adventurer or two.

species.name: Handsome crab
species.flavor: Their crushing claws are powerful enough to pierce huge holes in the hulls of ships. Fishermen's friends they are not.

species.name: Cumaulus
species.flavor: Clouds of condensed vapor whose disconcerting grin do little to ingratiate them with meteorologists.

species.name: Hell niño
species.flavor: Scorching clouds of pyroclastic pollution, they will spew flames until they turn to soot if no one tells them to stop.

species.name: Freezing fog
species.flavor: Wintry wackos that bring a taste of the tundra to battle, bombarding their foes with icy incantations like Kacrack and Chilly Breath.}}

species.name: Jackanape
species.flavor: Powerful primates that are quick to anger at even the slightest inconvenience. Best give these bad-humoured bullies the wide berth they demand.

species.name: Whackanape
species.flavor: Peeved primates with an appetite for destruction. One punch from their pumped-up appendages is likely to send even the most well-armoured adventurer to the infirmary.

species.name: Smackanape
species.flavor: The pinnacle of primate power, these mighty monsters not only pack a punch themselves, they can bear the brunt of a beating without batting an eyelid.

species.name: Vampire cat
species.flavor: Cats like bats that flap about and nullify the spell-casting potential of opponents who rely on magic.

species.name: Catula
species.flavor: Flying felines that bring their bothersome behaviour to the battlefield. Not only will they siphon off your MP, they may also call their buddies to come and back them up.}}

species.name: Robbin' huddle
species.flavor: Robbin' 'Ood's larcenous lackeys who respect their boss with every ounce of their being. You can bet they would jump off a bridge if he gave the order.

species.name: Witch
species.flavor: A sexy she-monster that seduces enemies with her Puff-Puff ability before unleashing a barrage of spells on her hapless foes.

species.name: Crone ranger
species.flavor: These woebegone witches have mastered malign modes of magic, but are consumed by envy upon seeing capable human conjurers younger than they.

species.name: Ram raider
species.flavor: Ovine offenders flush with fine fleece and humongous horns. Violent of temperament, they snort in anger with every breath and charge anyone who meets their gaze.

species.name: Rampage
species.flavor: These sheepy adversaries are best avoided. Their need to preserve personal space means that if two ever touch, a butting of heads is unavoidable.

species.name: Beakon
species.flavor: These brutal birds are consumed by rage upon seeing an enemy, instantly heading off to much on them with their beefy bills.

species.name: Weaken beakon
species.flavor: Brainy birds that cast Kasap to dwindle the defences of their adversaries before they attack. Though flightless, their long legs allow them to leap great distances.

species.name: Belisha beakon
species.flavor: Every tale told of these beaky baddies is a lie, embellished to beyond believable. If you wish to learn the measure of the monster, you need but fight one.

species.name: Minidemon
species.flavor: Demonic infants destined for devilishness. The discrepancies in their fork-handling dexterity simply show their upbringing, but none of them know how to use a knife yet.

species.name: Garuda
species.flavor: Airborne atrocities prone to swooping down from the skies above. Their talons can haul up a horse and carry it off to be eventually eaten.}}

species.name: Elysium bird
species.flavor: Masters of the Multiheal spell, these avians are heralded as heaven's healers. However, they have an avaricious side and stuff their nests with all the shiny items they can find.

species.name: King squid
species.flavor: The terrible tentacles of these mighty molluscs twist around ships and drag them down to the depths. Their name alone strikes fear into the hearts of sea creatures the world over.

species.name: Squidzilla
species.flavor: Hailing form the trenches of the deep sea, these ancient creatures crop up in myths from across the ages. Tales tell of them dragging ships down into the cold, murky depths.

species.name: Heedoo voodoo
species.flavor: Hermitish shamans that hone their magic far from human settlements. Their incantations ring out from dusk till dawn, drawing ire and noise complaints despite the distance.

species.name: Voodoogooder
species.flavor: Necromancers that mastered forbidden forces. On quiet nights, their faint chattering can be heard, but it is unclear if they are talking to the undead or just themselves.

species.name: Troobloovoodoo
species.flavor: These connoisseurs of cursed incantations care not for human life. Regularly they reanimate the corpses of those who died unfulfilled, giggling gleefully the entire time.

species.name: Ursa minor
species.flavor: Stronger than the average bear, these ursine irregularities dominate their forest domains. When prey presents itself, they pounce with unparalleled power and precision.

species.name: Ursa major
species.flavor: These bear-like behemoths are fast on their feet and take delight in chasing their prey before slowly shredding it with their sharpened claws.

species.name: Ursa mega
species.flavor: Strong, smart and savage, these bears possess arms and legs as thick as tree trunks. Their massive muscles allow them to slice through the finest armour and shields with ease.

species.name: Magmalice
species.flavor: Swollen lumps of magma that were supplied with sapience via magical forces. Though hot to the touch, they are ice-cold in combat and attack with their abominable breath.

species.name: Firn fiend
species.flavor: Glacial goons that were given the gift of life through sinister sorcery. Though icy in appearance, passion burns within them, and they never abandon a friend on the battlefield.}}

species.name: Gold Digger
species.flavor: The gaudiest of golems with bodies that are built from bricks of pure gold. They drop a fortune when defeated and are targeted by greedy adventurers after a big payday.

species.name: Mimic
species.flavor: More unhinged than they look: these cheeky chests are the leading cause of death in labyrinths, and venerated veterans of the trap game.

species.name: Ethereal serpent
species.flavor: Hailing from the distant east, these wingless dragons, with their slender, sinuous bodies, are capable of flight through mystical magical means.

species.name: Boreal serpent
species.flavor: These dreadful dragons rule over the arctic wastes and can conjure up icy magic on a whim. Trouncing these tyrants requires brains as well as brawn.

species.name: Infernal serpent
species.flavor: Do not be fooled by their jolly magenta scales, these dancing dragons can scorch the earth and sear their enemies with beastly breath attacks.

species.name: Shadow
species.flavor: Denizens of darkness that dwell where light dare not shine. When summoned to the human plane, they manifest as pure gloom, using their inherent coldness to freeze their fleshy foes.

species.name: Manticore
species.flavor: When an Infanticore matures, this is what is created. Their staggering strength and incredible intelligence mean most adventurers ought to avoid them at all costs.

species.name: Franticore
species.flavor: Legendary beasts of a detestable disposition; they call forth ferocious flames with a single howl and can rend the earth with their callous claws, laying waste to entire armies.

species.name: One-man army
species.flavor: The souls of three swordsmen mingled to manifest this skeletal scoundrel. Billed as highly skilled with a blade, though 'Three-man army' might be a more apt name.

species.name: Troll
species.flavor: Though they are far from being the brainiest bunch, these humongous hooligans hit hard. To topple these titans, take advantage of their tendency to miss the mark.

species.name: Hydra
species.flavor: Five bonces are better than one for these dragons. Each head has its own personality and they regularly squabble at meal times--the middle one having to play peacemaker.

species.name: Flying flayer
species.flavor: Staunch supporters of violence in all varieties, these demented demons are allergic to fighting fair and are never seen with their dagger and whip.

species.name: Soaring scourger
species.flavor: Devious demons of high status, they use their daggers to jab their subordinates when bored. Just imagine what they would do to a human!

species.name: King Hydra
species.flavor: The pet of a megalomaniac, this multi-headed horror is said to have slaughtered a great hero who attempted in vain to vanquish it.

species.name: Dirty rat
species.flavor: Monstrous rats whose reddish hue is said to be from blood spilt when they bite intro their brethren, which they apparently do with cheerful abandon.

species.name: Dragon zombie
species.flavor: These once-noble dragons were defeated by adventurers in an ancient age. They then fossilised where they fell, before being stirred by a deep-seated desire for revenge.

species.name: Wight king
species.flavor: Once a king amongst men. Killed during a crusade. His bitter soul bears a grudge to this very day.

species.name: Healslime
species.flavor: Though possessing the power to memorise all manner of magic, their commitment to the Heal spell is unwavering-they never cast anything else!

species.name: Sky fry
species.flavor: Adolescent wind spirits who cling to Cumulus rexes, mistaking them for their dads.

species.name: Tongue fu master
species.flavor: Creatures capable of slurping up their victims' very vitality through their straw-like snouts. Depleted of joie de vivre, those afflicted are almost certain to experience a catastrophic crisis of confidence in the coming days.

species.name: Half hog
species.flavor: Though these ferocious fiends might look part man, part beast, don't be fooled-their minds are a hundred percent monster.

species.name: Blightcrawler
species.flavor: These burrowing beasties like to lie in wait underground before waylaying unwary wanderers with barrages of bane and suffocating sand clouds.

species.name: Skeleton squire
species.flavor: These skeletal soldiers are serial scavengers of the dead, but it's all for a good cause-they spend every spare coin on their beloved steeds.

species.name: Djinn genie
species.flavor: Continually re-inventing themselves, these insane lads keep Martian spiders as pets and dream of being heroes, just for one day.

species.name: Smashin' crab
species.flavor: These cranky creatures are painfully predictable players of rock, paper, scissors, throwing out the same tired hand every single turn.

species.name: Cannibox
species.flavor: Tricky chests that lure in avaricious adventurers with the prospect of treasure, when all that awaits is the pain of a powerful bite.}}

species.name: Meowgician
species.flavor: Half-man, half-cat, all magician. It remains unclear whether their inability to walk by a glass of water without knocking it to the floor is animal instinct or monstrous malevolence.

species.name: Nightcrawler
species.flavor: You might think these beasties' blue barbs drip with deadly venom, but it's nothing more than a bluff designed to ward off would-be predators. Don't assume the same of their properly poisonous peers though!

species.name: Crabble-rouser
species.flavor: These sea-dwelling soldiers are surly towards any underlings who cross their path, but are brazen boot-lickers around the top brass.

species.name: Cumulus rex
species.flavor: Blustery bodachs whose bodies are lighter than air, causing them to waft ever upwards. If they try to take a nap outdoors, they'll often wake up miles away.

species.name: Delusionist
species.flavor: Devious demon spawn utterly devoted to the darkness, despite the downside it presents to seeing friends and family. Not to mention the ever-present danger of tripping over.

species.name: Hirsute hexer
species.flavor: Sorcerers who seem almost consumed by the abyss, but when asked about their little familiars, they simply sigh and say that 'Some treasures are beyond words...'.

species.name: Bag snatcher
species.flavor: These swift and sticky-fingered scoundrels simply dump their stolen goods after making good their getaway-they're in it for the thrill, not the profit.

species.name: Claws célèbre
species.flavor: Prone to feeling blue, these cheerless crustaceans once flocked together to keep the loneliness at bay. Before long, there were so many of them that they'd accidentally formed a sub-aquatic army.

species.name: Baron von bellycose
species.flavor: This great lord the netherworld is a spellcaster supreme. The sphere he holds sucks in wicked human thoughts, which he stockpiles in his stomach as the source of his sorcerous power.

species.name: Necromacer
species.flavor: Famously fussy about their armour as they've had one too many accidents while whirling their weighty flails about.

species.name: Drakulord
species.flavor: These magnificent menaces have mastered the martial art known as the way of the dragon fist, earning them power to sunder the seas and level mountains, or so it's said.

species.name: Metal dragon slime
species.flavor: Dragon slimes who've taken on a metallic tinge, which means that when the fire they breathe blows back in their faces, they don't get burned.

species.name: Grotwyrm
species.flavor: Vulnerable to Zombiesbane and Dragonsbane.

species.name: Vis mager
species.flavor: They say the little dragon perching on the shoulder is a modest mark of individuality in the world of high-flying sorcerers. Happily for them, they're also said to bring good luck.

species.name: Mouseflap
species.flavor: These rascally rodents' enormous ears allow them to soar through the air. Only they can't hear a thing but rushing wind while in flight.

species.name: Woebergine
species.flavor: Audacious aubergines who ambush anyone around for the chance to strut their stuff, even if it earns them a walloping nine times out of ten.

species.name: Sculpture vulture
species.flavor: Sinister living statues imbued with souls by an accredited and accursed sorcerer. They stand stock still before assailing unsuspecting passers-by who confuse them for ordinary ornaments.

species.name: Mousenap
species.flavor: Wrong-headed rodent spirits who became monsters by allowing their wicked thoughts to run rampant. Their new bee-like bodies only boost their means of making mischief.

species.name: Fire fry
species.flavor: The surprisingly sadistic children of cursed fire sprites, far more malevolent than their chubby little cheeks might suggest.

species.name: Shabby cat
species.flavor: Though missing the stern stripes of the common Weartiger, their forest green fur works in their favour when camouflaged in the foliage of their natural habit.

species.name: Collum o'golem
species.flavor: Though always willing to take on any travellers who cross their paths, the chronically overworked Collums are simultaneously fighting a battle against sleep.

species.name: Merderer
species.flavor: These fighting fit fish-men fillet foes with their super-sized spears. To maintain their massive muscles, they spar with brawny Barracuda.

species.name: Master moosifer
species.flavor: Nigh-on unstoppable dealers of death who aren't just masters in name alone - they know every calamitous trick in the book.

species.name: Thuggler
species.flavor: Endlessly juggling eyeballs is bad enough, but the most painful part of the spectator experience at one of these monsters' shows is actually the audience's stony indifference.

species.name: Wight prowler
species.flavor: Prison guards employed in perdition who were tasked with tracking and catching criminals who escaped their bonds before they can be executed.

species.name: Bird of terrordise
species.flavor: Flame-feathered fiends often mistaken for phoenixes. Apparently the fire they breathe is so searingly hot it singes their own skin, making every attack absolute agony.

species.name: Ginormoose
species.flavor: Another antlered animal warrior in the Demon King's army. Despite their massive size, they're disarmingly dexterous and even design their own weaponry.

species.name: Scrapper
species.flavor: Rusted steel soldiers that have served so long that they're now beyond servicing. Sadly for them, seeing them creak into action is more likely to draw sympathy than strike fear.

species.name: Mega moai
species.flavor: Only the enormous noggins remain, but when first sculpted these stone-wrought soldiers were truly colossal, capable of crushing a castle underfoot as if it were nothing.

species.name: Terrorhawk
species.flavor: Brutal birds born from flame, so large of frame they can't actually fly. Still, they dream of the day that they might finally make use of their weeny wings.

species.name: Gourdzilla
species.flavor: This vicious vegetation is said to have spawned from a single seed that survived its fall to the underworld in a shower of stars.

species.name: Charmour
species.flavor: Malevolent suits of mail settled by spirits. Any armour-aficionados they encounter can't help but admire their metallurgic magnificence even in the midst of battle, making them mighty easy pickings.

species.name: Very devil
species.flavor: These long-lived Little Devils are no longer satisfied with childish pranks, but plan on pursuing proper demonhood by dabbling in deeds several shades darker.

species.name: Clawcerer
species.flavor: These savvy tabbies might seem cerebral, perhaps even scholarly, but a single whiff of catnip is all it takes to whisk them away with the faeries.

species.name: Mandrake monarch
species.flavor: Well-muscled mandrakes who fancy themselves musketeers, having adopted the motto 'All for one and one for all'. That is, until the tide of battle turns, and then it's every mandrake for himself.

species.name: Awebergine
species.flavor: These egomaniacal eggplants are the dictionary definition of divas-browbeating their weaker Woebergine cousins into being their back-up dancers when they're in the mood to cut a rug.

species.name: Mad moai
species.flavor: A scowling statue that sticks out so well in any surrounding, people often choose them as landmarks to meet by, even if standing around while they sternly stare can be somewhat disconcerting.

species.name: Enormoose
species.flavor: In the panoply of mythical beasts serving in the Demon King's army, even these monstrously massive mammals are afraid to stick their heads above the parapet for fear of their master's capricious character.

species.name: Night knight
species.flavor: Soldiers of a mad monarch who dragged the denizens of his dominion down to hell with him, where he now dominates a new damned domain.

species.name: Fright knight
species.flavor: These sorry creatures come to life when a spiteful spirit settles in the remains of renowned knight.

species.name: Whole hog
species.flavor: Savage swine with perfectly piggish personalities-they make it a point to never say 'please' or 'thank you'.

species.name: Strangler fish
species.flavor: You might think these ferocious fish would fly into a frothing frenzy for any old food that gets flung their way, but in reality they're rather picky eaters.

species.name: Stainless scrapper
species.flavor: The very first mechanical killing machine, designed by Dr. Dorte. Though a prototype design, their capabilities were more than up to snuff out in the field.

species.name: Rotwyrm
species.flavor: Vulnerable to Zombiesbane and Dragonsbane.

species.name: Demon deacon
species.flavor: Not the most committed clergymen in the unholy church, these carefree clerics spend all day scoffing sacramental wafers and quaffing communal plonk.

species.name: Alarmour
species.flavor: These nasty knights are the wretched remnants of once-righteous warriors who fell from grace and now answer directly to the Demon King.

species.name: Emperor slime
species.flavor: Once competed with the peerless Platinum king jewel for the throne of a fabulous city of gold, but softened over time, content with all it had achieved already.

species.name: Grinade
species.flavor: These unsettling stones size their opponents up, smirking all the while, then explode into action with unstoppable force.

species.name: Wight watchman
species.flavor: Malicious types who prey upon travellers. It's said that the sight of one of their lanterns held aloft, swaying eerily in the early hours, spells certain doom.

species.name: Metal heavy
species.flavor: A demon clad in diabolical armour with a life-and face-of its own. Neither is ever quite sure which one is being addressed as they both answer to the same name.

species.name: Purrestidigitator
species.flavor: Meowing mages who have managed to master their pesky animal instincts, and as such have become the most enlightened among their occult colleagues.

species.name: Tongue fu fighter
species.flavor: Loathsome little louts who love nothing more than lashing their tensile tongues up and down their powerless prey, delighting in every disgusted face they pull.

species.name: Frightcrawler
species.flavor: Not even experts can agree on whether these malefic monsters are fully grown fiends, or if they're merely larvae that might one day mutate into something more menacing.

species.name: Hell hog
species.flavor: Boorish beasts who barge into battle and batter their foes with their blooming huge batons, but who will balk if asked to bludgeon their best buds.

species.name: Damned well
species.flavor: They tend to get on well with bloody hands, sometimes pairing up to pull pranks on unsuspecting passers-by.

species.name: Beastly priest
species.flavor: Men of the cloth who worship murk. The precepts of their faith include fasting, community outreach, and stealing human souls to condemn them to an eternity of suffering in the fires of Avernus.

species.name: Abominape
species.flavor: Ape monsters with fur as white as a blizzard. They pack snow into iceballs and furiously hurl them at enemies. Needless to say, their temper is hotter than their habitat.

species.name: Candy cat
species.flavor: A happy-go-lucky, good natured monster. Born with only one stripe, it grows another with each passing year.

species.name: Blue fang
species.flavor: One of the guardians of the Dragon Graveyard. Attacks candidates to test their worthiness to undertake the trial.

species.name: Satyr
species.flavor: The large horns above each ear fall off and grow back every year. The hornpipes they carry are carved from their old horns.

species.name: Capsichum
species.flavor: A distinctive monster shaped like a pepper. In their culture, two is always better than one, so they stick together with the help of a large skewer.

species.name: Abyss diver
species.flavor: Marine marauders known as 'hell's little helpers' for their skill at sinking ships, sending scores of souls to the underworld with a single stroke.

species.name: Bag o' laughs
species.flavor: Burlap sacks filled with humour and good cheer. They delight in being the centre of attention, and bag every opportunity to crack a cringe-worthy dad joke.

species.name: Battle beetle
species.flavor: The armoured pink carapaces of these insect monsters are highly resistant to physical attacks and spells. Try using magic to lower their defense before attacking.

species.name: Beetleboy
species.flavor: Despite their weighty appearance, these insectoid monsters are quite swift. They like to tackle their opponents head-on with the help of their huge horns.

species.name: Ber
species.flavor: The selfish body of the mighty jabberwockee. Deeply resents jab, kee, and woc for forcing it to carry them all the time.

species.name: Bloody hand
species.flavor: Monsters born from the pools of blood that gather beneath the headsman's block. Their unnerving gestures are said to beckon disaster.

species.name: Bobonga
species.flavor: An overweight and cautious dragon. When threatened, it takes a swig of amor seco essence from its jar to restore its HP.

species.name: Body politic
species.flavor: The huge and sluggish body politic resists all but the most dedicated attacks.

species.name: Boe
species.flavor: A left-handed monster that swings a single sword with both hands. The youngest of the four brothers, it has an affinity for cheese.

species.name: Boh
species.flavor: Although as stocky and strong as a sumo wrestler, this monster doesn't seem to live up to its true potential on its own.

species.name: Bubble slime
species.flavor: Every relationship is toxic when your body is covered in poison. These lovelorn lotharioozes are always on the lookout for romance, but are destined to struggle to even get a hug.}}

species.name: Buffalogre
species.flavor: A ferocious and powerful golden monster that grows even stronger when fighting alongside its friend, mohawker.

species.name: Bunicorn
species.flavor: These rabid rabbits store strength in the huge horns on their heads. Myriad adventurers have been taken in by their adorable appearance only to meet an unfortunate end.

species.name: Caped caperer
species.flavor: These dancers of the netherworld once played a central role in the rituals performed in honor of the Lord of Darkness. Experts in a wide variety of dance steps.

species.name: Chainine
species.flavor: Bulldog-like monsters that throw their spiked collars to ensnare enemies and make them easier to hit.

species.name: Chimaera
species.flavor: These monstrous amalgamations bear the head of a vulture and the body of a serpent. They are widely hunted for their wings by humans and so suffer more than most species.

species.name: Claws
species.flavor: Aggressive monsters covered from head to toe in hard scales. They use magic to lower enemy defenses before moving in for the kill.

species.name: Cockateer
species.flavor: A race of swordsmen... or should that be 'swordschickens'? They boast powerful swords skills and mastery of the Wind Sickles attack.

species.name: Crocodog
species.flavor: An enormous, airborne alligator creature with a cruel smile and a vicious chuckle. Beware its powerful body-slam attack.

species.name: Cureslime
species.flavor: High-ranking Healslimes who have mastered the Fullheal spell. Their reddish colouration to stark confirmation of their dedication to restorative magic.

species.name: Dancing devil
species.flavor: A race of demons wearing what appear to be bright blue pants. They are rumored to drop them when defeated.

species.name: Dancing flame
species.flavor: A human soul so consumed with rage that it was reborn as an incandescent flame.

species.name: Dark condor
species.flavor: An evil-bird monster that flies the skies of the World of Darkness. Casts powerful healing magic on itself its allies when close to defeat.

species.name: Dark devildog
species.flavor: These powerful dog-monsters are a handful in their own right, but become even more difficult to defeat when they call upon hell's gatekeepers for help.

species.name: Dark dullahan
species.flavor: A warrior beheaded in battle and risen again as a monster. Said to occasionally summon dark condors.

species.name: Dark macarbour
species.flavor: A fearsome tree of death. In the World of Darkness, trees grow from leaves rather than seeds, sprouting branches first and roots last.

species.name: Dark minister
species.flavor: Loyal creatures that have dedicated their lives to evil.{{tt

species.name: Dark sabrecat
species.flavor: Ferocious shadowcats that prowl through the darkness. It is said that no one who set eyes on a dark sabrecat ever lives to tell the tale.

species.name: Dark sea-diva
species.flavor: Born from the toxic sludge of the dark seas. Prevents foes from attacking by singing funny songs and making them laugh.

species.name: Dark skeleton
species.flavor: This is what happens when the bleak, black bitterness of a Skeleton Soldier takes up residence in a traveller's shadow and becomes an evil-doing entity in its own right.

species.name: Dark star
species.flavor: A tiny star system from the World of Darkness. Emits an eerie light that makes enemies more vulnerable to spells.

species.name: Dark turkey
species.flavor: Once able to fly freely, these fearsome birds descended from the skies long ago to become swordsmen on terra firma. They taunt their foes by calling them 'chickens'.

species.name: Darkodile
species.flavor: A heligator that somehow lost its way, ended up in the World of Darkness, and began a new life as a darkodile.

species.name: Dead ringer
species.flavor: A bell made of ice. Those unfortunate enough to hear its chilling death-knell are frozen solid.

species.name: Death scorpion
species.flavor: Equipped with a carapace that could bounce back cannonballs, and pincers powerful enough to snip boulders clean in two. These are formidable foes indeed, hence the 'death' in the name.

species.name: Dieablo
species.flavor: A monster with a gleaming golden coat. Seems obsessed with collecting shiny objects.

species.name: Diemon
species.flavor: Mysterious monsters known for wearing eerie masks. Their real faces are said to become even scarier.

species.name: Dingaling
species.flavor: A monster shaped like a large bell. Usually does nothing more than watch and laugh but occasionally calls jargons for help.

species.name: Dark moth
species.flavor: Few travellers survive an encounter with these foul monsters, as every beat of their dark wings fills in the air with a poisonous powder.

species.name: Dark gryphon
species.flavor: Firebird born phoenix-like from raging infernos. Capable of exhaling an incinerating breath. Totally resistant to any fire-bird attack.

species.name: Anchorman
species.flavor: The anchor of a ship that sunk with all hands on board, given new life as a vengeful monster. Launches itself from the sea bed in an attempt to bring other ships down to share its fate.

species.name: Democrobot
species.flavor: The mighty combined form of the head of state, the body politic, the right wing, and the other right wing...er, left wing. Feared for its mastery of lightning magic.

species.name: Drackmage
species.flavor: Enigmatic drackies whose origins are mired in even more mystery than their bat-like brethren. It's not even clear if they're called by their right name.

species.name: Drackyma
species.flavor: These cheerleaders of the Dracky world spur their allies on with Snooze spells and helpful healing abilities, but secretly wish they could wow everyone with more impressive magic.

species.name: Dragonthorn
species.flavor: Thorny rose bushes turned into monsters by Dhoulmagus. Whenever one is killed, another is born to take its place.

species.name: Dragurn
species.flavor: Pot-bellied monsters known for their scaly coats, which repel fire and ice-based attack.

species.name: Dullahan
species.flavor: Talented and trusted monsters that serve as guardians. They are powerful indeed, with no weak points to speak of.

species.name: Fallen priest
species.flavor: Former priests of the cult of the Lord of Darkness. Their enslaved souls remain on earth to punish those who dare intrude into the Dark Ruins.

species.name: Fencing fox
species.flavor: These foppish fiends leave foes floundering with their flamboyant foil-work. When not showing off their skills with a sword, they like to demonstrate their dazzling dancing.

species.name: Woc
species.flavor: The egotistical left arm of the mighty jabberwockee. Constantly on the lookout for a chance to use its magic and speed itself up and flee.

species.name: Wild boarfish
species.flavor: A fish monster with a pig-like face. Its flesh is poison to anyone foolish enough to eat it.

species.name: Wight priest
species.flavor: An apostle of the Lord of Darkness who sacrificed his own life in order to save his master. Calls upon other monsters to fight alongside him during difficult battles.

species.name: Walking corpse
species.flavor: The rotting remnants of a once proud person. Though they retain a slither of their soul, they are cursed to ramble aimlessly forevermore, barely aware if they are alive or dead.

species.name: Volpone
species.flavor: Aristocrats of the monster world. Famed for doing the Hustle Dance where in dire trouble to tip the balance in their favor.

species.name: Unholy bishop
species.flavor: Fearsome magicians who hold the power of life and death in their cruel hands. Masters of magic, they are adept at casting every form of spell.

species.name: Treeface
species.flavor: Previously peaceful trees turned violent vengeance-seekers when passing travellers carelessly carved their names into their trunks. See what happens when you don't respect nature?

species.name: Toxic zombie
species.flavor: This horrid humanoid secretes poisonous pus form its spoiled skin. If you're unlucky enough to come into contact with the stuff, wash immediately with consecrated water.

species.name: Terror tabby
species.flavor: A feline monster that spends its days lazing around. In battle, its sleepiness is contagious.

species.name: Tentacular
species.flavor: Deadly dwellers of the deep. These titanic terrors can toss a fishing boat about as if it were a child's plaything.

species.name: Tap devil
species.flavor: Famed for their fancy footwork, these monsters use a variety of dance attacks during battle. See if you can spot them all!

species.name: Swingin' hipster
species.flavor: Green devils that make their homes in remote areas. They curse their foes with the point of a finger.

species.name: Stone guardian
species.flavor: Effigies of dark gods that were carved from solid stone. Originally created to watch over humans, these rocky reprobates now cause them more harm than good.

species.name: Stone golem
species.flavor: Monolithic monsters made when their beastly brethren pile up rocks they've poured their most poisonous thoughts into. Beware their brick-like fists.

species.name: Squid kid
species.flavor: The juvenile form of the King squid. Not particularly interested in fighting. Think of them as the mascots of the sea!

species.name: Spitnik
species.flavor: The dazzling bodies of these monsters burn as fiercely as the surface of the sun. They spew fire at their enemies.

species.name: Solaris
species.flavor: A mad planet with evil ambitions. Calls forth meteor storms to destroy any who dare oppose it.

species.name: Snapdragon
species.flavor: Strange monsters that are animated forms of cursed rose bushes. They entwine enemies in thorny vines, then incinerate them with powerful fire spells.

species.name: Smacker
species.flavor: They get real satisfaction from staring at people's peacefully snoozing faces, so like to send foes to sleep. However, the stress of skirmishing means those succumbing to slumber almost always have nightmares, and don't look remotely serene.

species.name: Skipper
species.flavor: A hairy furball of a monster whose love for unwanted old boots manifests itself in much the same way as a hermit crab's love for discarded shells.

species.name: Skeleton soldier
species.flavor: They spend all day staring at their skulls in the mirror, obsessed with the idea that the cracks are getting bigger. It's probably the stress of all that skeletoning.

species.name: Siren
species.flavor: Evil mermaids that seduce and lure unwary sailors to their deaths with the tantalising promise of Puff-Puff delights.

species.name: Silhouette
species.flavor: Frightful phantoms born of the festering hatred and horrific torment of humans. They cast the Thwack spell to send their enemies off to the underworld.

species.name: Silenus
species.flavor: These monsters use their hornpipes to herd wild sheep to lush green pastures. Their flocks are utterly devoted to them.

species.name: Shade
species.flavor: Paranormal malformities awash with the life force of other monsters. Their shadowy form obscures their true nature--a visage too terrible to ever divulge to the world.

species.name: See urchin
species.flavor: A healer of the sea. Will often flee immediately after healing an injured comrade. Can be quite difficult to hit.

species.name: Rockbomb
species.flavor: Sedentary stones that will self-destruct if not dealt with in a timely manner. With these troublesome lumps of rubble, every battle is a race against the clock.}}

species.name: See angel
species.flavor: Expert healers of the sea. Focus your attacks on these monsters first, as they are capable of resurrecting fallen allies.

species.name: Sea dragon
species.flavor: Fearsome monsters of the deep sea. Capable of using Gigaflash to dazzle enemies. Remarkably agile and hard to hit.

species.name: Riptide
species.flavor: A fearsome fighter of the seas with razor-sharp claws. Capable of spinning its body like a propeller to cut the enemy to ribbons.

species.name: Right wing
species.flavor: Famed for chuckling evilly during battle. In reality, chuckles evilly all the time.

species.name: Restless armour
species.flavor: Warriors from an ancient era whose souls inhabit their otherwise empty plates. Though their armour shows signs of rust, their skills do not, and their blades are well whetted.}}

species.name: Puppeteer
species.flavor: A unique monster that delights in telling its opponents stories using hand-puppets.

species.name: Puppet player
species.flavor: A strangely theatrical monster. Performs a carefully prepared puppet show entitled 'Love Story' that stirs up the enemy in all sorts of ways.

species.name: Puppet master
species.flavor: The undisputed master of puppeteers. The distinctive fire-spewing chimaera puppet is an original creation.

species.name: Pink pongo
species.flavor: Far more agile than they appear, these monsters are harder to hit than you think. Their clubs pack a powerful punch.

species.name: Pigmalion
species.flavor: The tortured spirits of humans who perished at sea, Whenever a fellow monster dies, pigmalions almost inevitably sacrifice their own lives to resurrect their fallen allies.

species.name: Paprikan
species.flavor: A pair of psychotic peppers. Their crazed grins belie their wiliness in battle. They can prevent enemies from using spells, and like to pummel their adversaries with body-slams.

species.name: Pandora's box
species.flavor: Open this chest with trepidation, for it contains despair, envy, prejudice, discord and everything in between. Will hope remain when all else is removed, or simply misery?

species.name: Pan piper
species.flavor: Half man, half goat, and the worst of both. Usually timid, they turn red if provoked and call for fellow pan pipers to join the fray.

species.name: Octavian pirate
species.flavor: Eight-legged octopoid aggressors possessed by the spirits of dead buccaneers, whose barbarity in battle they have also inherited.}}

species.name: Notso macho
species.flavor: Muscly monsters besotted with their bulky, broad-bladed swords. Preoccupied with looking cool, they practise their sword poses any spare moment they have.

species.name: Night sneaker
species.flavor: Monsters that sulk around in the dead of night. They are masters of defensive magic and can deflect enemy spells.

species.name: Night fox
species.flavor: Extremely agile, these monsters are feared for their skillful rapierwork and Mercurial Thrusts.

species.name: Mushroom mage
species.flavor: Foul fungi with a deep-seated disdain for mushroom pickers. They are skilled spell-casters and have significantly more smarts than their mush-brained kin.

species.name: Mummy boy
species.flavor: The priests who performed the burial rites on these deadbeats would rise from their own graves if they could see the state of their bandages now.

species.name: Mumboh-jumboe
species.flavor: The combined form of mum, boh, jum, boe. Rattles opponents by casting Boom and using earth-shaking physical attacks.

species.name: Mum
species.flavor: Surprisingly bossy for a monster that is an incompetent fighter at best when alone. But it seems to have some sort of trick up its sleeve...

species.name: Muddy hand
species.flavor: Soily appendages that manifested from the despair of humans who died drowning in mud.

species.name: Mud mannequin
species.flavor: Humanoid masses of muck made magically mobile. Their disturbing dances apparently play some role in ensuring that they don't fall to pieces.

species.name: Mucho macho
species.flavor: Though their swordsmanship is second-to-none, their mentality leaves much to be desired, falling to pieces the second thing stop going their way.

species.name: Morphean mushroom
species.flavor: Former mushrooms that morphed into monsters when hungry humans attempted to pick them. It should come as no surprise that these unfun guys despise people.

species.name: Mohawker
species.flavor: A silver-colored comrade of buffalogre. This monster fights tactically, using powerful healing magic to turn the tide of battle in its favor.

species.name: Mimic king
species.flavor: Treasure chests brought as tribute to the Black Citadel, transformed by the power of the Lord of Darkness into vicious monsters.

species.name: Merman
species.flavor: Fishy freaks with strong scales and sharp claws that attack ships in schools despite never receiving a formal education.

species.name: Mecha-mynah
species.flavor: The mechanical bodies of these birds weigh more than Yangus after a big dinner! They have a tendency to snap the branches whey they roost and fall to the earth with a metallic clunk.

species.name: Mars rover
species.flavor: Quick-witted dog monsters. Their loud barks serve to intimidate the enemy and summon allies.

species.name: Man o' war
species.flavor: Toward the end of summer when the days get shorter, these slimes wash up on beaches in their droves. Be careful not to step on one, or you could be in for a nasty shock!

species.name: Magic marionette
species.flavor: Once the proud possessions of professional puppeteers, they come alive after being abandoned, and go on about the glory days.

species.name: Magic dumbbell
species.flavor: In groups, these otherwise silly looking monsters are capable of playing melodies that can lay low even experienced adventurers.

species.name: Lump wizard
species.flavor: The skin on these jellyheads is said to be so supple that it could cover an entire living room floor when stretched, like some weird rubbery carpet.

species.name: Lump shaman
species.flavor: Unsightly sorcerers whose indecisive tendencies do them few favours. Though grisly of visage, their spell-casting competence is not to be sneered at.

species.name: Lump mage
species.flavor: Sufferers of low self-esteem, these shy sorcerers are ashamed to have their bodies on display and so cast Dazzle to impair the vision of their would-be observers.

species.name: Living statue
species.flavor: Stony sentinels that were animated by the magic of a mystery mage. Though slow to act, their sheer size and mass are more than enough to offset any sluggishness.

species.name: Foul anchor
species.flavor: Fearsome and angry wharf-monsters. Use spells to attack them, as weapons have little or no effect on their tough steel bodies.

species.name: Fowlfighter
species.flavor: Bird-like monsters that patrol the halls of the Black Citadel. They carry swords consecrated by the Lord of Darkness himself.

species.name: Frogface
species.flavor: Although quite weak in frog form, their attacks become far more dangerous when they reveal the human faces on their backs.

species.name: Frogman
species.flavor: Frog-monsters with strange patterns covering their bodies. When provoked to reveal the human faces on their backs, they can use powerful spells and ice attacks which damage the whole party.

species.name: Frost wyvine
species.flavor: Born from silver frost, these ice-monsters live to punish those who hate snow and blizzards.

species.name: Frostburn
species.flavor: A creature created when a soul mired in a sadness so deep as to freeze one's hear forever was touched by an immeasurable evil.

species.name: Frou-frou
species.flavor: This giant dragon swings its enormous tail to wallop multiple foes simultaneously.

species.name: Funghoul
species.flavor: Ghastly fungi that thrive in dark recesses. A single sniff of their soporific Sweet Breath is enough to send even the most caffeinated traveller straight to sleep.

species.name: Gold golem
species.flavor: Often the target of travelers looking to solve their money troubles, these poor creatures envy the carefree lives of stone golems.

species.name: Goodybag
species.flavor: This is what becomes of Bags o' Laughs that come into a nice inheritance. They show off their new-found wealth to all, blissfully unaware that nobody likes a braggard.}}

species.name: Gorerilla
species.flavor: A brute of a monster that wields a club to bash enemies. Even a single blow can inflict a tremendous amount of damage.

species.name: Head of state
species.flavor: The self-proclaimed brains of the team. Capable of casting both lightning based and healing spells. Boasts of being elected by its fellow party members. In reality, it was handed the position by their father.

species.name: Headhunter
species.flavor: Expert axe-wielders who adore nothing more than chopping off heads-a joy that's permanently plastered on their faces.

species.name: Heavy hood
species.flavor: Blue-skinned bruisers with a death wish for their enemies. Consumed by killing, they persist in the pursuit of their prey until its demise is confirmed.

species.name: Heligator
species.flavor: A flying alligator creature that uses its enormous weight to body slam unwary foes into submission.

species.name: Hell hopper
species.flavor: A strange pair of monsters living together in a symbiotic relationship. Said to drop an exceedingly rare pair of shoes when defeated.

species.name: Hell's gatekeeper
species.flavor: A monster that stands guard at the gates to the netherworld. Calls forth an elysium bird to drive your monster team back into reserve.

species.name: Hellhound
species.flavor: Once ordinary wolves, now enslaved by an evil power. These unfortunate creatures tend to band together and live in packs.

species.name: High roller
species.flavor: The number of eyes hidden underneath their masks constantly changes during battle. When they roll a six, expect to see a bomboulder join the fray.

species.name: Hipster
species.flavor: A gorgeous hunk of a demon that spins and uses its thorny tail as a whip.

species.name: Hocus chimaera
species.flavor: The former familiars of foul witches that are considerably cleverer than their chimaera kin. They have a wide range of spells in their repertoire to boot.

species.name: Hood
species.flavor: Mysterious masked monsters with a nasty habit of hacking down unwary travellers. These vain creatures love to flex their muscles and psyche up in front of their enemies.

species.name: Hoodlum
species.flavor: These evil executioners skulk in the shadows, hoping to ambush unsuspecting adventurers with their enormous axes.

species.name: Ice queen
species.flavor: A tension queen found in snowy mountain regions. Few can survive her Cool Breath when she's fully psyched up!

species.name: Icikiller
species.flavor: Ferocious ice-warriors born and raised in the deep mountain snow. Said to display a hatred of all things warm.

species.name: Infernal armour
species.flavor: Suits of cursed plate mail that wait for an unwary warrior to put them on. Once donned, they take control of the poor human's soul and force it into eternal servitude.}}

species.name: Invisible swordsman
species.flavor: A knight that traded his physical body for the power of the Lord of Darkness. Lofts his sword high in the air to call down a divine punishment upon his foes.

species.name: Iron rhino
species.flavor: A silver beetle-monster. Protected by its iron-hard carapace, it can shatter boulders with a headbutt.

species.name: Iron scorpion
species.flavor: Their silvery skin lead some to assume that killing them will confer the same benefits as slaying a Liquid metal slime. Which is why they enjoy standing their ground and stinging those who scamper after them expecting a chase.

species.name: Jab
species.flavor: The stubborn head of the mighty jabberwockee. An unyielding blockhead of a leader, famed for never having apologized for anything in its entire life.

species.name: Jabberwockee
species.flavor: The combined form of four smaller monsters; jab, ber, woc, and kee. In spite of their penchant for working together, they seem to be lacking in the team-spirit departments.

species.name: Jargon
species.flavor: Physically quite imposing, these monsters are also capable of breathing fire and throwing magical sand from their jars. They appear to enjoy a symbiotic relationship with dingalings.

species.name: Jum
species.flavor: A right-handed monster that wields a sword far too large and heavy for it to handle well.

species.name: Kee
species.flavor: The pompous right arm of the mighty jabberwockee. Never misses a chance to guilt-trip jab, ber, and woc into thanking it for its healing ability.

species.name: Khalamari kid
species.flavor: The juvenile form of the same type of monsters as Khalamari. Often tries to play with the enemy instead of attacking them.

species.name: Killer croaker
species.flavor: Frog monsters with two faces. The sight of the demonic faces on their backs is widely regarded as an omen of death by adventurers.

species.name: Killing machine
species.flavor: Mechanical monsters that never stop moving. Once they have identified a target, they will stop at nothing to see it slain.

species.name: King kelp
species.flavor: Like pop-stars of the deep sea, these vile vocalists call other monsters to their aid with their soothing singing voices.

species.name: Left wing
species.flavor: Incessantly complains about the activities of the right wing, body politic, and head of state, but lacks the motivation to actually do anything about it.

species.name: Lethal armour
species.flavor: Stained red from the bloodshed of battlefields aplenty, these possessed suits of plate mail take pride in having slain heroes and innocents in equal measure.

species.name: Liquid metal slime
species.flavor: The speediest sludge you are likely to see (albeit briefly), they take advantage of their low profile to reduce drag and hasten their escape from sticky situations.

species.name: Cyber slime
species.flavor: A slime who admires Metal slimes and has undergone repeated body modifications. The lightning it unleashes by shorting out electronic circuits is intense. In the end, I wasn't able to become a Metal Slime, but I'm pretty satisfied with the current state of things. I'm especially confident that the red left eye is super cool.

species.name: Shell slime
species.flavor: Beauty-conscious slimes that decided to care for their complexion by growing a shell to hide inside, thereby preserving the sliminess of their skin.

species.name: She-slime
species.flavor: Brightly coloured beauties that are very proud of their orange complexion. They are a little stronger than their blue brethren and slightly warm to the touch.

species.name: Drake slime
species.flavor: These flappy little fellows are so convinced they're dragons that their friends don't have the heart to tell them the truth.

species.name: Dragon slime
species.flavor: These winged wonders are perfectly adapted to cold climates, and remain wondrously wobbly even at sub-zero temperatures.

species.name: Gem slime
species.flavor: Golden, gem-like slimes. Folk tales purport that every bit of gold in existence was once worthless scrap metal before being transmuted by these monsters' midas touch.

species.name: Argon lizard
species.flavor: Long hunted for their precious Argon hearts, these monsters run at the first sight of humans.

species.name: Skelegon
species.flavor: The bleached bones of deceased dragons brought back to life by dark designs. They serve their summoners, carrying out any command with unwavering loyalty.

species.name: Drakularge
species.flavor: Defeating these doughy dragons yields useful loot, but stacked stats, crazy claws, and Flame Breath don't make it a doddle.

species.name: Crabid
species.flavor: These decapodal deviants might look vicious to the untrained eye, but really they are cowards who will call for backup as soon as the going gets though.

species.name: Khalamari
species.flavor: Although temporarily transformed into a ferocious brute by Dhoulmagus' enchantments, Khalamari is actually quite a kind fellow at heart. At one time he planned to open his own comedy club.

species.name: Silvapithecus
species.flavor: Monarchs among monkeys whose stunning, snow-white fur sets them apart from the crowd, and is also a top-notch temperature regulator, keeping them feeling just right under almost any conditions.

species.name: Trap box
species.flavor: A monster that carries the precious Venus' tear in its mouth. Its guiding motivation appears to be its obsession with priceless jewels and treasures.

species.name: Ruin
species.flavor: The ruin of the Black Citadel itself, risen to defend its master Rhapthorne from the Hero and the party!

species.name: Dessert demon
species.flavor: A great demon with a giant spoon and a love of sweets. He is known among his fellow demons as a compassionate and kind person. There is a rumor that it may be Belial himself, who has an extremely picky eating style and has become discolored from eating only sweets.

species.name: Stark raven
species.flavor: Colossal crows that mate with their corvidesque companions for life. When presented with a potential partner, the pair exchange skulls in place of wedding vows.}}

species.name: Wailin' weed
species.flavor: Flower-Monsters nourished by the anguish of those unfortunate enough to be turned into thorny vines, such as the residents of the Trodain Castle.

species.name: Tortured soul
species.flavor: The cursed spirit of the abbot of the former abbey, which was destroyed after being stricken by the plague. Slaying this poor creature put an end to many centuries of suffering.

species.name: Terminonatator
species.flavor: Sea dragons who were once kings of the ocean. Almost driven to extinction by the ever-warming atmosphere, a few survived in the deepest depths, and have begun to emerge again of late.

species.name: Archdemon
species.flavor: Aristocrats among demons whose non-stop barrage of brutal spells almost always sees those they set their sights on floored in seconds.

species.name: Redtail hipster
species.flavor: A cruel race of demons that cast instant death spells in an attempt to consign their foes to an early grave.

species.name: Corpse corporal
species.flavor: Having been dug up and brought back from the beyond, they're not big fans of the living, and will eagerly curse them at every opportunity.

species.name: Wyrtoise
species.flavor: Kings among their kin, they cast Kabuff and Wildfire with aplomb. Their spells have earned them their peers' praise and elevated them, essentially, to royalty.

species.name: Wyrtle
species.flavor: Sometimes they think they are dragons, other times turtles. But regardless of how they feel, their sleep-inducing Sweet Breath and brutal bite are cause for consternation.}}

species.name: Lick-o'-flame
species.flavor: Vulnerable to the Dragonsbane.

species.name: Phoenix
species.flavor: The errand-birds of fiery deities, these flying phantoms are feared the world over. They swoop from the heavens whisk people away as punishment for their impiety.}}

species.name: Hunter mech
species.flavor: Thanks to the motion detection and prediction module with which it is equipped, this murderous machine is able to strike even the fastest-moving foes with unerring accuracy every single time.

species.name: Darksteel dragon
species.flavor: A giant dragon with the colours of a dark and starless night. His seemingly limitless might took Hero and the party to the brink of despair during battle.

species.name: Don Mole
species.flavor: A self-proclaimed artist and music lover. Unfortunately for those around him, his love for music doesn't necessarily mean he's any good at it.

species.name: Great argon lizard
species.flavor: The largest and most impressive Argon lizard. Its Argon heart is said to be pretty huge!

species.name: Red horn
species.flavor: One of the guardians of the Doors of Judgement deep within the Dragon Graveyard. Has carried out his duty for too many years to remember.

species.name: Servant of Darkness
species.flavor: Once the world's most powerful warrior, his abilities attracted Rhapthorne's attention and earned him a place as a sentinel of the Black Citadel.

species.name: Statue of Angelo
species.flavor: A perfect likeness of Angelo, created by the evil powers deep within the Black Citadel. Just as much trouble as the real thing!

species.name: Statue of Hero
species.flavor: A perfect likeness of Hero (Dragon Quest VIII), created by the evil powers deep within the Black Citadel. Now just a normal statue.

species.name: Statue of Jessica
species.flavor: A perfect likeness of Jessica Albert, created by the evil powers deep within the Black Citadel. Not nearly as squeezable as the real thing.

species.name: Statue of Yangus
species.flavor: A perfect likeness of Yangus, created by the evil powers deep within the Black Citadel. Given life by Rhapthorne's foul ambitions, it attacked the party.

species.name: Brigand
species.flavor: A combat specialist from the group of mountain bandits operating in the area by Alltrades Abbey. Only proper for the pilfering sort, all of this gear is pillaged property.

species.name: Vaipur
species.flavor: This sinister spirit watches the way out of the Sullied Sanctum. Cumulus vex, his boss, bestowed upon him the brooding black cloud on which he parks his priggish behind.

species.name: Malign vine
species.flavor: A man-eating mass of ferocious flora, revived by the restorative rays of the sun once the darkness shrouding Nottagen was lifted.

species.name: Rogue
species.flavor: Nominally a higher-up among the mountain bandits who operate in the area around Alltrades Abbey, but rumor is the boss only keeps him around as his whipping boy.

species.name: Terror troll
species.flavor: To these smooth-brained beefcakes, battle is nothing more than a game. When they find a playmate, they love to pound and pulverise them into pancakes.

species.name: King crab
species.flavor: Sick of seeing their friends and family hunted for food by humans, these larger-than-life critters are on a mission for revenge.

species.name: Armful
species.flavor: With six swords at their disposal, these skeletal psychopaths are hell incarnate, striking fear into the hearts of adventurers the second they start swinging.}}

species.name: Mermaniac
species.flavor: If other monsters get too close, these deranged denizens of the deep will lash out with their razor-sharp talons. They occupy the warrior caste in Merman society.}}

species.name: Shaman
species.flavor: Obsessed with the end of the world, they spend all day praying for apocalypse, seemingly unaware that if it happens, it will be the end of them too.

species.name: Striking sabrecat
species.flavor: Though their cubs are absolutely adorable, and are popular pets among the wealthy, they grow extremely vicious as adults, at which point only the King of Dirkandor wants anything to do with them.

species.name: Sabrecat
species.flavor: Though incredibly curious by nature, sabrecats are also easily bored-except when it comes to claw-sharpening, which they're completely obsessed with.

species.name: Battering ram
species.flavor: With hardy horns that can deflect even axe blades, these headstrong headaches charge about butting into everything. The only sleep they get is when they knock themselves out.

species.name: Ragged reaper
species.flavor: Their scythes, robbed from real reapers, ward off Whack, and they can upset enemies with Weird Dance and Snooze.

species.name: Knocktopus
species.flavor: Death spells work well on these awkward octopuses, which shower their enemies with skyborne spikes.

species.name: Gastropog
species.flavor: They slap their sickeningly long tongues across enemies' faces, and eject 'orrible ooze to slow their foes.

species.name: Boppin' badger
species.flavor: Badgers with large leaves and the gift of the groove. Their moves are admired by many in the monster world.

species.name: Great gruffon
species.flavor: Thick fur means the cold doesn't concern them, and great might makes them formidable when they muster their strength.

species.name: Cruelcumber
species.flavor: Poky little vegetables that often trouble travellers, but are terribly sour losers.

species.name: Earthenwarrior
species.flavor: Fiery-breathed pieces of highly protected pottery which fortify themselves even with Kabuff.

species.name: Manguini
species.flavor: They rake their vicious claws through enemies with glee, and make use of their slime stature to sidestep strikes.

species.name: Leafy larrikin
species.flavor: They flutter their leafy bodies to evade attack, and sometimes summon their buddies, the badger magers.

species.name: Slionheart
species.flavor: Supreme slimes who ooze class, and whose incredible strength and insane speed are second only those of the gods.

species.name: Teeny sanguini
species.flavor: Cowskin-coloured little devils who only chase after travellers because they want to play.

species.name: Chariot chappie
species.flavor: These crazy carters career into combat, crashing into the competition and occasionally causing them to cramp up.

species.name: Sacksquatch
species.flavor: Smack them with spells before they jump at the chance to blind you by blowing sand in your eyes.

species.name: Spirit
species.flavor: The result of darkness infiltrating the hearts of lost, lonely souls. These floating fiends might literally have their heads in the clouds, but in truth, they're some of the most grounded monsters you'll meet.

species.name: Wooper trooper
species.flavor: Amphibious soldiers and adepts of defence who can be found patrolling around bodies of water.

species.name: Live lava
species.flavor: Monsters of mercurial magma petrified of cooling down and spending eternity as solid stone forever stuck in place.

species.name: Fire Ball
species.flavor: A red bird-shaped murder machine that flies through the sky like a ball of fire. Releases Kerfrizz from the wings and do a self-destruct dance to explode! Some scientists claim that Fireball's true identity are Clockwork Cuckoos that have gone out of control due to overheating, but there have been few sightings and the truth is unknown.

species.name: Axolhotl
species.flavor: Nihilistic, flame-retardant desert warriors that use Flame Slash and Flame Breath, and are experts on Selflessness.

species.name: Equinox
species.flavor: Ceaseless steed of death, who tirelessly travels the skies, taking the lives of all in his path. Also known as the Black Star.

species.name: Sootheslime
species.flavor: Healslimes who've mastered the mighty Moreheal. So selfless that they often offload MP onto allies.

species.name: Uncommon cold
