species.flavor: Snow elementals that could freeze even fire, and pitilessly turn all before them to ice unless taken out to play.

species.name: Bud brother
species.flavor: They like to bring butts into battle to beef up the bloodshed, or if they're feeling inferior, they'll beckon forth a badja.

species.name: Shivery shrubbery
species.flavor: They go around in gangs trying to turn the world to ice by stealing MP with Drain Magic and using it to cast Crackle.

species.name: Scourgette
species.flavor: These veteran vegetables are very versatile, and can batter with Boom, and resurrect perished pals with Zing.

species.name: Zumeanie
species.flavor: Trop-pickle vegetables, ripened in the sun, and unable to cope with ice conditions. Can confuse with their spinning spears.

species.name: Scarlet fever
species.flavor: Rivers run dry, animals die, and the grass and trees are burnt to cinders when the scarlet fever walks the land.

species.name: Brainy badboon
species.flavor: So strong that it can often be seen smashing down trees with its trunk-like arms-having taken the moniker bestowed upon it by its fellow Badboons as a slight against its brawn.

species.name: Badger mager
species.flavor: Badgers who have begun the long journey on the Way of the Badja, but have only learnt one spell so far: Woosh.

species.name: Badja
species.flavor: Pure-hearted masters of the mighty way of the Badja, they evade blows with a mysterious mist, and foil magic with Fizzle.

species.name: Expload
species.flavor: Slow they may be, but their heavy weapons, in particular their ribbit launchers, are the terror of travellers everywhere.

species.name: Blastoad
species.flavor: Heavy toad tanks that pound enemies with poisonous rounds, and whose tongue lashings would make even the toughest tremble.

species.name: Mortoad
species.flavor: Hopping powder kegs with a whole heap of heavy artillery. Keep a particular eye out for the sickening Snot Shot.

species.name: Trigertaur
species.flavor: Intimidating enemies who damage defense with Sap, then take foes to task with their tridents. Whistle to really rile them.

species.name: White trigertaur
species.flavor: Monstrous masters of ice who are super-skilled with their icicle-like spears, and also adept at using Thin Air.

species.name: Sick trigertaur
species.flavor: They enjoy attacks that damage all enemies like Party Pooper and Boom, and like to rub it in by whistling at weakened foes.

species.name: Pink sanguini
species.flavor: Sanguinis who have cast off their cowskin kiddie coats for pink adolescent pelts. They love to have travellers for tea!

species.name: Genie sanguini
species.flavor: Cute little critters that can sing a Gritty Ditty to pump up their pals, or do the Kerplunk Dance to bring them back from beyond.

species.name: Bloody manguini
species.flavor: Freaky beasts who drain adventurers of their blood and MP, and sometimes flip them out with Fuddle Dance.

species.name: Boogie manguini
species.flavor: Dancing yellow devils who know every step there is -- not just the support steps, but tension-building tactical ones too.

species.name: Gruffon
species.flavor: They may be strong have have high HP, but they're just to laid back to last. Strike first, and you're bound to beat them.

species.name: Gramarye gruffon
species.flavor: Grown-up gruffons who are beyond the boulder-throwing badness of their boyhoods, and now know Zammle as well.

species.name: Python priest
species.flavor: Reptilian reverends who can cast Swoosh, and make use of Multiheal when their mates are in trouble.

species.name: Cannibelle
species.flavor: They wander the world searching for souls to consume, believing that each victim's cry of despair makes them ever more beautiful.

species.name: Octagoon
species.flavor: As strong as steel, and with horns hard enough to hew rocks in two, only the toughest will best these heavyweight beasts.

species.name: Salamarauder
species.flavor: These piratical pests freeze foes with their breath, and evade attacks while summoning support.

species.name: Grody Gumpdrops
species.flavor: This cunning cryptid tempted adventurers into his cave with the promise of coin, only to turn the tables and take their treasure instead.

species.name: Moai minstrel
species.flavor: Those facing these po-faced Pierrots should overcome the urge to laugh - a clout with Kamikazee just isn't funny.

species.name: Blood mummy
species.flavor: Recent converts to the cult of the Lord of Darkness. Use magic to fell them quickly before they have a chance to curse you.

species.name: Raving reaper
species.flavor: Scary scythe swingers who like to aim for the vitals, and are sometimes so drunk on the darkness that they go haywire.

species.name: Peckerel
species.flavor: They fly fast at their foes with paralysing attacks, and treat troublesome opponents to an Assassin's Stab.

species.name: Cobra cardinal
species.flavor: Masters of most forms of magic, who are admired by many monsters, and cause chaos with Kazing, Kasnooze and Zammle.

species.name: Boa bishop
species.flavor: Masterly mages of the reptile kingdom. They attack twice, and can bring buddies back from the brink with Omniheal.

species.name: Bagma
species.flavor: Their HP's not so hot, but these burning bags can turn up the heat with their baking breath, and summon live lavas too.

species.name: Corrupt carter
species.flavor: Armoured chariots that are bolstered even further with Kabuff, then battered at breakneck speed into the enemy.

species.name: Flamin' drayman
species.flavor: These fire-powered four-wheeled fighting machines will knock foes for six or fry them with Kafrizz.

species.name: Grim reaper
species.flavor: They render victims helpless with Deceleratle and Kasap, then swoop in to swipe their souls with their savage scythes.

species.name: Tantamount
species.flavor: These heavenly horses lash out with Lightning Storm, sometimes strike twice, and read the battlefield like a book.

species.name: Brrearthenwarrior
species.flavor: Nippy knights on a quest to rid the world of evil with Chilly Breath and Kacrackle Slash.

species.name: Barriearthenwarrior
species.flavor: Hard horsemen who may not say much, but whose actions speak louder than words. They soup up sub-par strength with Oomph.

species.name: Alphyn
species.flavor: They may be made of a muddle of bits, but these fast foes attack twice and cast Kaboom, Bounce, and Feel the Burn.

species.name: Cyber spider
species.flavor: Magic will make mincemeat of these mechanical web weavers, who mainly make use of mucus-based ammo and dazzling rounds.

species.name: Freaky tiki
species.flavor: Menacing masks with mega defence who enfeeble foes with Eerie Light and Dazzleflash, then dish out some serious damage.

species.name: Vermillion dragon
species.flavor: A giant dragon whose scales gleam with a fiery hue. Attacked Hero and the party to test their courage and worthiness to bear the title of heroes.

species.name: Ultimate dragon
species.flavor: Like a phoenix from the flames, the Ultimate Dragon embodies the true power of the Lord of the Dragovians. The final Dragovian Trial.

species.name: Shocktopus
species.flavor: Betentacled terrors that are immune to poison, paralysis and sleep. Whack them silly before they launch a Spike Strike.

species.name: Giddy gastropog
species.flavor: Strange snails that are fond of Fuddle. They're darned durable, and entirely untouchable when they shrink into their shells.

species.name: Gloomy gastropog
species.flavor: The believe that the best offence is the dogged defence afforded by foiling attacks with Pincushion, Sweet Breath, and Kafuddle.

species.name: Stale whale
species.flavor: Woeful whales who singe foes with Scorch, and whose rancid spines are rank enough to confuse anyone they touch.

species.name: Pale whale
species.flavor: Deep-sea dwellers that blind foes with Dazzleflash and blaze a trail with their bright breath. Darkness can defeat them.

species.name: AU-1000
species.flavor: Reinforced robots that render attack impossible with a blast of blinding light, then slice foes silly.

species.name: Void droid
species.flavor: They shoot showers of arrows, slice savagely with their swords, and use any means available to annihilate enemies.

species.name: Vermil lion
species.flavor: They expunge spells with Disruptive Wave and burp forth black breath. Also able to cobble themselves by meditating.

species.name: Prime slime
species.flavor: Legendary slime soldiers who amplify their attack with Oomph, and whose lightning speed lets them attack twice on the trot.

species.name: Bling badger
species.flavor: Grandmasters of the Way of the Badja, these shining paragons bring both brains and brawn to bear in their supreme style.

species.name: Wishmaster
species.flavor: They pound the ground, toppling enemies all around. Then, as if that wasn't enough, they clobber them with Kaboom as well.

species.name: Cumulus hex
species.flavor: Mental elementals that mislead with Mist Me, and dish out Disruptive Waves and Freezing Blizzards. Afraid of fire and light.

species.name: Cumulus vex
species.flavor: The archvillain who stopped the wind in Aeolus Vale, causing the Cirrus no end of suffering. Malign power allows him to manipulate the dark cloud at his feet to do his bidding.

species.name: Godsteed
species.flavor: It's said that when their crystal-clear eyes shine, even the most grizzled veterans will be laid to rest. Beware their bright breath.

species.name: Slugly betsy
species.flavor: Warty, weighty witches who watch over their own with support spells. Irksome if they cast Kazing or Magic Barrier.

species.name: Claw hammer
species.flavor: Giant sharks that topple enemies with Trip of a Deathtime, then hit them while they're down. Strong against ice magic.

species.name: Power hammer
species.flavor: Not content just to be strong, they get tough with Kabuff, then try to get critical. Watch out for their Sandstorm strikes.

species.name: Hammer horror
species.flavor: They whip up a storm with Thin Air, and engulf all in evil with their dark breath. Embrace the light to end their existence.

species.name: Seavern
species.flavor: True masters of the sea, these supreme seasaurs scare foes silly with a blood-curdling cry, then smash them with a tsunami.

species.name: Parched peckerel
species.flavor: Known as 'sandstreakers' for their insane speed, which is added to with Acceleratle, and supplemented with sleep attacks.

species.name: Geothaum
species.flavor: They emit waves of darkness that lower the agility and defence of all enemies. Hard to harm with earth or darkness.

species.name: Widow's pique
species.flavor: They wrap their victims in sticky silk, then smack them with a stinker of an attack. Firmly insulated against fire attacks.

species.name: Apeckalypse
species.flavor: Blighted birds that live on poisonous plants. They frighten foes with War Cry, and vex them with venomous attacks.

species.name: Wight emperor
species.flavor: Spine-chilling sorcerers who cast Kazam, Kafuddle and Kathwack. Face them unprepared at your own peril.

species.name: Heyedra
species.flavor: Born when the eyeballs of fallen fiends absorb ambient bitterness from the air around them. But despite this, they're oddly buoyant characters, lacking any memory of their former lives as they do.}}

species.name: Gripevine
species.flavor: Their massive mouths can release an aromatic mist which lures in unsuspecting prey before they make their move and munch them down whole.

species.name: Great troll
species.flavor: Descended from the most dastardly despots in troll history. One strike from their cruel club is a death sentence for anyone who finds themselves on the receiving end.

species.name: Blight knight
species.flavor: These demonic masters of battle know no fear, and calmly await attacks, then counter them with catastrophic quickness.

species.name: Crème caraslime
species.flavor: Does it tastes slimy or caramelly? That's the brule-ling question. Yet no one can answer it because no one has ever eaten one.

species.name: Queen slime
species.flavor: The beautiful queen of the slime world with a warm smile. In reality, she is cold as ice and loves Kacrack. Until now, she has dominated the slime world without appearing on stage and relying on King Slime as her butt. This is the long-awaited appearance.

species.name: Wonder wyrtle
species.flavor: These reptilian regents can bring down bolts of lightning and exhale gouts of flame, but aren't wild about water or darkness.

species.name: Prestidigitator
species.flavor: These one-time humans were transmogrified into monsters when their magnanimous motivations for mastering magic mutated into malevolent machinations.

species.name: Abracadabrer
species.flavor: Humans that merged with a demon to become something far more foul than the sum of its parts. They excel in explosive magic that causes excessive damage.

species.name: Hocus-poker
species.flavor: One-time sorcerers that succumbed to the dark side. Drunk on their new-found power, they annihilate anyone daft enough to defy them.

species.name: Leger-de-man
species.flavor: A demonic deal turned these magicians into monsters, and all for the sake of a bit more magical might. They strive to best wizards the world over to prove their power.

species.name: Legerdeman
species.flavor: Skilled spell-casters with a truly terrifying repertoire of tricks up their sleeves. Some say said sleeves are stained red with the blood of those they've bested.

species.name: Sorcerer
species.flavor: Skillful employers of both offensive and defensive spells whose secret lies in the fact that they use them every day. When it's cold, they'll cast a quick Sizzle to warm up, and if someone's annoying them, a blast of Fizzle usually shuts them up.

species.name: Gaia dragon
species.flavor: He was one of the twelve generals of the demon army. He was the most powerful of them all and sought to destroy everything with his power as the King of Dragons. He had been aiming to take his master's place, but was sealed away along with the other generals in the labyrinth created by the Crown of Wisdom. He will never forget that humiliation.

species.name: Raptile
species.flavor: A fun and unique lizard with a cute smile. Don't let that smile fool you, you'll be in for a painful experience. She always practices smiling by looking at her face reflected in the fountain. Aiming to become an idol in the Netherworld, she is searching for the cutest angle today as well.

species.name: Chest mimic
species.flavor: If anyone lets their guard down and opens the dresser, he'll gobble them right down, right from the head, and then he'll deliver a devastating blow with a dynamic movement. The Mimic intended to disguise itself as a treasure chest, but somehow it ended up transforming into a chest of drawers. Thus, a new species of monster was born.

species.name: Slimeshroom
species.flavor: A strange slime with mushrooms growing on its body. It chants Dazzle to confuse travelers. When I lived in a humid place, mushrooms started growing on my body. I was a bit surprised, but I no longer had to worry about food.

species.name: Elder dragon
species.flavor: An ecological dragon that lives by eating the herbs that grow on its back. It gets excited and creates a blizzard, showing no mercy to its natural enemies! The herbs on the back are effective for beauty. If you eat them every day, they have anti-aging effects and are popular among women.

species.name: Dread squirrel
species.flavor: A squirrel monster with a tail larger than its body. It swings its proud tail around and delivers a Desperate attack. Although their tails are naturally small, daily grooming apparently allows air to enter the fur, making them fluffy.

species.name: Hippo king
species.flavor: He uses his prized axe to cut down enemies and ignores damage. He is the leader of the Hippo tribe and leads the Hippo soldiers. There was once a historic battle in which a 100-man army defeated a large army of tens of thousands of Rhinothropes. This battle is called the Hippolyte Wars.

species.name: Hell conductor
species.flavor: A conductor whose soul has been tainted by playing music from hell, the spells he casts create a harmony of abnormal conditions. The hellish music he played was said to be a terrifying tune that would kill anyone who heard it within three days.

species.name: Drag racer
species.flavor: These spry saurians use their super speed to outrace any creature they come across, save Liquid metal slimes, whose similar swiftness they can only nod to in respect.

species.name: Dragstar
species.flavor: Though they might look like lean, mean killing machines, these gentle giants are nothing but kind to their fellow creatures, often letting weary little monsters ride upon their backs when in need of a break.

species.name: Star lemming
species.flavor: A small magical beast with striped star-colored and night-colored fur that casts Kafuddle and causes chaos. They migrate in large groups across rivers once every few years, and the sight of the yellow flocks swimming across the river at night looks like a small galaxy.

species.name: Disfigurine
species.flavor: A monster to be feared, it fortifies its defenses with Bounce spells and Pincushion, while aiming for deadly Assassin's Stab attacks. This hated doll, rumored to bring misfortune to anyone who possesses it, has decided to really spread misfortune around the world, and has begun to take action.

species.name: Blue moon
species.flavor: A mysterious monster rumored to have fallen from the moon. By chanting Zushido, it can control gravity like a star. It is said that the teardrops that fall to the earth from the moon as it wanders alone in the night sky are called the Blue Moon.

species.name: Psycho master
species.flavor: A magical warrior who has fallen into evil ways and is skilled in the use of evil magic. He unleashes his own magical powers in an uncontrollable manner and is a threat. The kingdom has officially stated that although they are called magical warriors, they have no connection whatsoever to the Verinaard magical warrior corps.

species.name: Silver cape
species.flavor: The cursed figure of a once glorious royal family. His sword skills are top-notch, and his blade can block any attack. All members of the royal family of a certain country wore this cloak. When the fabric caught the light, it shone like a starry sky.

species.name: Gold mantle
species.flavor: The soul of a king of a certain fallen kingdom was possessed by a cloak. The deceased king quietly raised his sword. The golden cloak, which was a symbol of kingship, gave rise to jealousy, and a sorcerer cursed it to bind the king's soul.

species.name: Dragster
species.flavor: Known far and wide as the strongest of all the saurians, no one can outrun these fleet-footed fiends. In fact, the fate of their prey is sealed upon their sighting-they'll have to face the fangs sooner or later.

species.name: Hellbound horror
species.flavor: He's an annoying guy who's good at slowing down people's movements, lulling them to sleep, and holding people back. A unique monster that loves to play for a long time. I am trying to live my life by daring to restrain myself.

species.name: Ghost berry
species.flavor: Hellbound horror has overcome his gloomy personality and has become completely cheerful. Today too, she shouted with joy and performed a captivating dance until the morning. I changed my appearance to impress the girl I like, and it made me even more cheerful. The power of love is amazing!

species.name: Zebra mantis
species.flavor: A mechanized praying mantis with dazzling vivid black and white patterns. Watch out for the cannon and the flash grenades he fires from it. The black and white paint has a dazzling effect in group battles, but it has not been mass-produced because it is difficult to repaint by hand.

species.name: Black mantis
species.flavor: A praying mantis killer that sprays an unpleasant liquid that lowers attack power and poisons you. Under the cover of darkness, it targets travelers. The sharp eyesight that has been acquired through training does not miss the procession of ants that stretches across the pitch-black ground at night. She boasts ultra-high night vision.

species.name: Green scissors
species.flavor: An insect that hides in plants and protects itself with armor. With a hidden cannon, it deals great damage. The doctor who developed the cannon was said to have had a great influence on the later Demon weapons industry, and apparently received some sort of award.

species.name: Hellbound hunter
species.flavor: A blood-stained assassin possessed by the power of darkness. He specializes in putting his opponents to sleep and finishing them off with a Rain of Pain. For some reason, he likes jumping off high places, so on his day offs he travels far away to enjoy bungee jumping.

species.name: Dirty doll
species.flavor: He uses the spell Kafuddle to confuse his enemies and try to make them fight each other. His dirty nature is true to his name. He says that whenever he goes to the beach, people mistake him for a sea urchin because of his appearance and color, which is a problem for him.

species.name: Phantom fencer
species.flavor: A ragged cape enchanted by powerful magic. Invulnerable to air-based spells.

species.name: Phantom swordsman
species.flavor: Acolytes of the Lord of Darkness that gave their own lives in sacrifice. Their flesh is gone, but their faith remains to fuel their hunger for battle.

species.name: Royal reptile
species.flavor: The Emperor of the Dragon World rules with his overwhelming charisma. The flames he exhales shine like a jewel, captivating others. The first emperor had the ability to nullify attacks just by opening one eye. The Eye of the Dragon is a jewel that reproduces the glow of that eye.

species.name: Liege lizard
species.flavor: The majestic king of lizards, with powers rivaling those of a dragon. A magnificent flame spews from his mouth, befitting his royal name. The majestic figure of the Liege Lizard inspires the dreams of lizards. A world for lizards, by lizards!

species.name: Zaptile
species.flavor: A scary electric frog that stores electricity inside its body. It discharges the stored electricity to create lightning. When the Zaptile is happily bathing in the water, electrocuted fish float up to the surface, so there is no shortage of food.

species.name: Spike head
species.flavor: This is a very dangerous monster that increases its attack power with Oomph and then aims to inflict great damage by lashing out with the spikes on its head. The handles are covered in spikes so at first glance it may look inconvenient, but in fact it can be used like chopsticks, making it surprisingly useful.

species.name: Face invader
species.flavor: A colorful horned monster shaman. He stirs up sand, creates flames and fights like a ritual. Apparently, they perform rituals every night in a secluded cave, summoning spirits with evil hearts...

species.name: Visor kaiser
species.flavor: A mechanical soldier with a camouflage that melts into the darkness and attacks silently. The edge of darkness summons deep darkness, dazzling travelers and weakening them. A monster that has been magically modified by evil scientists. He vows revenge on the scientists and wanders through the wilderness today as well.

species.name: Mitey oak
species.flavor: A cute, round-bodied tree spirit that lives in the grasslands. It treasures the red leaf that grows on its head. Everyone is competing to see who can grow the biggest, but it's really like comparing acorns. There's not much difference.

species.name: Tufty tot
species.flavor: They perform a cute, fluffy dance and chant Zing. It is said that meeting her brings happiness. The healing plant, Tufty Tot. There is much mystery surrounding its ecology, and one theory is that it is the fluff of a flower that blooms on Yggdrasil.

species.name: Fluffy fur
species.flavor: A fluffy spirit. Despite its appearance, it is aggressive and casts the explosive spell Bang. It is aggressive and attacks. Judging from his name, one might assume he has some connection to the fluffy creatures, but he was actually born from a Feralbeast's furball. He has a devious personality.

species.name: Ham shamwitch
species.flavor: A pig monster who wanders the world wearing his favorite hat. He stores flames in his small body and explodes them whenever he gets the chance. A pig that doesn't travel is just a pig. With that, he left the herd. His sombrero, his travel companion, was a symbol of his freedom.

species.name: Amodeus
species.flavor: A great demon who likes to pretend to be an artist and loves blood and music. He uses various techniques to beautifully color tragedies. Apparently, he composed the heroic "Troll March" in just one night to inspire the Troll army. He has a natural talent for music.

species.name: Dank bubble slime
species.flavor: A negative slime that likes damp places. It places mushroom bombs and makes happy people explode. There was a time when the humid bubble was booming. It has since shriveled up, but it was called the King back then.

species.name: Evil ganesha
species.flavor: This elephant god was exposed to a large amount of demonic miasma and transformed into a demon. He holds weapons on his six arms and violently slashes at you. He has perfected his skills with each of the weapons he wields in his six arms, and it seems he plans to branch out to include boomerangs and whips in the future.

species.name: Elephant king
species.flavor: Originally an elephant monster worshipped as a sacred beast, its ability to use Multiheal is a remnant of its time as a sacred beast. His anger towards the hunters who were targeting the tusks of his fellow elephants built up and turned into a grudge, transforming the sacred beast into a demonic beast.

species.name: Hellbound heretic
species.flavor: A dreaded underworld worker colored by darkness and death. In addition to powerful spells, he is also adept at using charm and roars. He once served the Netherlord, but left due to differences in their views on life and death. Now he lives a carefree life as a freelance guardian.

species.name: Dark planet
species.flavor: An unidentified dark star lurks in the darkness of the night. Chants Kazammle to summon even deeper darkness. Dark Planet is feared by adventurers, but for some reason, it is revered by some gamblers as a good luck charm.

species.name: Mars face
species.flavor: A burning meteorite fell from the night sky and was given a will of its own. Its facial expression changes rapidly, increasing its attack power and excitement! Even though their strengths and living places are completely different, for some reason they seem to feel an attachment to Octopot.

species.name: Red baron
species.flavor: An archdemon of noble blood who pledges absolute loyalty to the Demon King. He weakens his enemies with mysterious light and casts vicious spells. The Red Baron is a noble demon with a long history spanning thousands of years. He turns the death throes of humans into music and revels in the sweet wine of chaos.

species.name: Polka dot dragon
species.flavor: A polka-dot frog dragon said to live in thunderclouds. It displays its majesty to travelers by wearing a Blessed Breath. Grandma said that if the Water Ball Dragon clicks its earrings three times, it will rain.

species.name: Tundragster
species.flavor: A pure white dragon sprints across the snowy plains in search of prey. Its glittering breath freezes everything in its path. Because no one has ever seen it, when a disaster occurs in the snowy plains, people shout that the dragon has appeared and fear it.

species.name: Yellow sickle
species.flavor: A ferocious praying mantis that was transformed into a killing machine by a monster. Suddenly, it fires off a flashbang, blinding you. It has a protective color that makes it easy to get confused on sandy beaches and deserts, but the sound of its body rattling makes it easy to find.

species.name: Rainbow scissor
species.flavor: An insect with a colorful body equipped with flash grenades and cannons. It is also equipped with an anger radar and locks on to enemies that react. Due to his brightly colored appearance and proud behavior, he is feared and known as the Rainbow Emperor.

species.name: Blue mink
species.flavor: A small, supple magical beast covered in blue fur. It uses Deceleratle to lower its enemy's speed and attack cautiously. He has a heroic tale of once crossing the ocean, landing on Cat Island in the Wena Islands, plucking out the whiskers of a giant cat tribe, and surviving.

species.name: Snaily tail
species.flavor: A demonic beast with a gigantic tail that curls up like a snail. If you get lured in by its Sultry Dance, it'll bite you with a painful blow! When startled, it hides inside its tail, resembling a snail, hence the name Snaily.

species.name: Needleman
species.flavor: A spiky doll that wanders around in search of prey. It is said that its small size will stalk anyone who lets their guard down. At first it had no thorns, but in order to survive, it grew cactus thorns onto its body and uses them for attack and defense.

species.name: Needle rabbit
species.flavor: This troublesome rabbit has a thorny constitution that shoots out when startled. If you approach it carelessly, you will be stung, but this does not necessarily mean that it is hostile. He is so timid and shy that he runs away if you make eye contact with him. He also quickly hides in the shadows, so it is apparently quite difficult to encounter him.

species.name: Hellbound hair-raiser
species.flavor: Although he appears to be an attention seeker, dyed all yellow, he is actually a skilled practitioner of both flashy techniques and understated tactics. I'm the lead vocalist for the legendary monster band "Lightning Death." You'll be blown away by my voice!

species.name: Lumbering lizard
species.flavor: An ancient dragon with a tree growing on its back. If it is injured during a battle, it eats the leaves to recover. A long time ago, a nut dropped by a bird among the scales on its back sprouted and eventually grew into a magnificent tree. It is truly a miracle of nature!

species.name: Masqueraider
species.flavor: A deformed soldier wearing shell-like armor. It can defend against physical attacks to a certain extent using special guard techniques. The two giant horns he holds belong to a dragon that lives in a distant valley, and retrieving them is a rite of passage for the clan.

species.name: Metal truffle slime
species.flavor: A mysterious mushroom has sprouted from the body of that Metal Slime! It quickly escapes, scattering spores. The mushrooms growing on its body are said to be one of Astoltia's three great delicacies, but apparently they're just rare and don't taste that great.

species.name: Mouldy slime
species.flavor: A grudge has taken up residence in the discarded rice bran and begun to move. It chants Kafuddle to soak your thoughts in rice bran. Long ago, my grandmother used to make this wonderful rice bran. Even now that it has rotted, I still remember her.

species.name: Frightening conductor
species.flavor: An unfortunate musician who died without being recognized by society has turned into a Demon who tries to control those who listen to his mysterious music. In reaction to his unfortunate life, he turned to death metal after his death. With his new song "Dormageddon" in hand, he is aiming for his major debut!

species.name: Hell's steward
species.flavor: A demon who is loyal to the Demon King and takes care of him. He is skilled at Zing and shows great consideration. A capable butler who manages the Demon King's schedule and health. Recently, he's also been working part-time as a waiter at a cafe.

species.name: Hippo guard
species.flavor: A dynamic hippo knight who constantly uses Feel the Burn to boost his strength, he is highly regarded by his comrades. He is a knight of the Hippo tribe and is highly regarded, but he feels self-conscious about his short legs. He is considering getting secret boots.

species.name: Hippo soldier
species.flavor: A brave hippopotamus warrior who is skilled at splitting helmets. When he gets angry, he uses Feel the Burn, which can be quite troublesome. It seems that a Rhinoceraxe is trying to challenge us, Hippo. Hippoppo. I'll show him that he's not on the same level as me, Tamas!

species.name: Naumannborg
species.flavor: A monster with six arms that brings about many disasters. It also has a stoic side, able to heal itself through Meditation. He is a handsome, domesticated elephant whose hobby is cooking. He can make delicious dishes three times faster than normal.

species.name: Evil sorcerer
species.flavor: An elite demon who has mastered sorcery. A formidable foe who can cause Kazam to go berserk and revive allies with Kazing. He has a personality that makes him like to act in everything he does, and is bound by countless rules, like the order in which he puts on his shoes in the morning, or where he starts washing in the bath.

species.name: Priest knight
species.flavor: A dark knight who serves the evil god has come from the Netherworld. He uses healing spells with the protection of the evil god. Due to his serious personality, it is rumored that he is struggling with his identity, whether he is a priest or a knight.

species.name: Jade flare
species.flavor: By just hesitating, the enemy will let their guard down and then use Time Bomb and Kaboomle to deal massive damage. He is particular about the sharpness of the flickering flares, and becomes upset when the flare is not set properly.

species.name: Zamtasm
species.flavor: An evil wraith born from Kazammle. Naturally, his favorite spell is Kazammle. Unlike the failed Firespirit, this is an elite spirit born from the highest level dark spells cast by the finest magicians in the Netherworld!

species.name: Sham hatwitch
species.flavor: A rookie boar monster wearing a large hat pulled down low on his body. When fighting, he gets scared and wraps himself in his hat to protect himself. Until recently, the monsters kept him as a pet, but he is now seen as a valuable asset and fights as one of their own.

species.name: Sham hamwitch
species.flavor: A hideous pig monster who has mastered forbidden alchemy. He brings disaster to the world with his Black Breath and Cursed Mist. The hat I always wear is the first one I made through alchemy. I really like the shiny color.

species.name: Hat hamwitch
species.flavor: The soul of a dead wizard resides in his favorite hat and controls wild boars. Beware of his special spell, Bang. You might think that the poor boar has had his body taken over by the hat, but it seems that he doesn't mind it at all as it makes him feel like a wizard.

species.name: Kaleidocat
species.flavor: A very rare cat demon boasting colorful stripes. It whimsically casts Frizz and licks around. Seven cats from Cat Island played a prank on Jailcat and painted him with magic paint, which is how he was created!

species.name: Remote
species.flavor: A cool desert ghost with a tropical vibe. Although it looks slow, it is light on its feet. When I applied Dowachaka Oil to my tanned, frizzy hair, my whole body turned a deep tan! Since then, my life as a popular guy has begun.

species.name: Trikaceratops
species.flavor: A crimson demonic beast that has lived on earth since ancient times. Its body is as heavy as a rock and unfazed by anything. When it's cold, they sleep huddled together in groups, but if they get too close, they are faced with the dilemma of getting pricked by the thorns and being unable to sleep.

species.name: Fromage fray
species.flavor: Despite his goofy appearance, he is a smart man who can't let his guard down and has the ability to cast explosive spells and heal himself. An unknown new face that looks both Slime-like and Ghost-like. Is there a secret under the hat?

species.name: Fromage grey
species.flavor: A dark warrior born when Fromage fray fell to the dark side of black mold. He masters the power of darkness. Why did he fall to the dark side of black mold? It is said that there is a story about Hakko that brings tears to his ears and tears to tell.

species.name: Fromage flay
species.flavor: As a result of fondue's longevity, it has developed a unique taste. A true name mawashist who is devoted to researching food. He is confident in his own delicious taste, and says that it goes particularly well with basil and tomatoes mixed with olive oil.

species.name: Lantern soldier
species.flavor: A foot soldier commander who lights up the battlefield with his lights. He rushes towards the enemy and suddenly blows himself up. A Bambooligan who's a hard worker became an ashigaru captain after many hardships. In fact, he seems to be an ambitious man who is not satisfied with his current position and is aiming for a higher rank.

species.name: Bambooligan
species.flavor: A mysterious soldier holding a bamboo spear. His friends hang out with each other and desperately try to stop those who want to destroy the bamboo forest. The bamboo forest is my hometown and the place where my soul returns... It expresses Aritake's feelings in the bamboo forest.

species.name: Bamboozler
species.flavor: A trickster of the Bambooligan tribe who carries a high-collared banner on his back. He likes flashy techniques such as Multithrust and self-destruction. Ikusaba is the stage of Han Dynasty. That's why I want to stand out and strongly assert myself. Look at my way of life!

species.name: General mech
species.flavor: The golden armor is proof of Bambooligan leadership, to inspire his subordinates to wage a big battle. He is a general who rules over the entire Bamboo Forest, but there is no shortage of people aiming for his position and he is busy putting down rebellions. The day when he can sleep in peace is far away.

species.name: Bamboogieman
species.flavor: The leader of a large force that leads the Bambooligan army and maintains a base in the Bamboo Forest. He protects himself by using the many friends he has summoned as a wall. The turbulent Sengoku era has begun, where the strong rule everything. Everyone is plotting strategies to unify the bamboo forest.

species.name: Shellie's Mother
species.flavor: A laid-back and generous slime-weaving mother. However, if you startle her, she'll strike you with lightning! The reason why Shellie's Mother's shell has no thorns is because she is kind enough to not hurt her baby snails.

species.name: Slimecicle
species.flavor: A pure white slime with a giant icicle on its back that can only be found in snowy regions. It puts travelers to sleep and attacks them. It silently sneaks up on travelers stranded in the snowy mountains. Locally, it is feared as the White Grim Reaper.

species.name: Haunted tomato
species.flavor: A monster that has been possessed by a demon inside a bright red tomato, giving it limbs. It absorbs your MP and attacks with its Zammle. It seems that it is her secret dream to one day go to the Netherworld and be eaten at the Great Demon King's table.

species.name: Holly oliver
species.flavor: A multi-talented fairy who can not only use powerful ice spells, but also dance a Weird Dance and cast Zing. Born from a 100-year-old holly tree that had an evil spirit dwelling within it. Because it was originally a holly tree, it has an extremely prickly personality.

species.name: Pumpkin kid
species.flavor: He fights by toying with his opponents with skillful steps such as a Weird Dance and the Fuddle Dance. The Pump Kids were too shy to dance in front of other people, but one day they discovered that they could dance if they hid their faces behind pumpkins.

species.name: Sacred silver haardvark
species.flavor: A very rare Haardvark with a holy silver metal body, excellent escape speed and luxurious EXP. It's the talk of adventurers. There is a mysterious legend that if you wash a skull for 100 years without ever letting go of it, your body will turn into sacred silver.

species.name: Pink bonbon
species.flavor: A rather troublesome idol of the Netherworld who supports her friends with hustle dancing and encouragement. Her fans don't yet know that she is an idol with such tenacity that she continues to practice dancing until she gets blood blisters on the soles of her feet...

species.name: Prison leader
species.flavor: The boss of the prisoners has been resurrected as a monster, trying to drive travelers to their deaths and increase the number of his minions. The large bone he holds in his left hand is an ancient bone that has been passed down from generation to generation to generation of prison lords.

species.name: Lunar chimaera
species.flavor: A vicious bird monster that launches breath attacks by increasing and decreasing the magical power of light and darkness like the phases of the moon. The new moon day is the only day off a month for the Lunar Chimaera. Since they are constantly flapping their wings, they can finally stretch their wings on this day.

species.name: Metal chimaera
species.flavor: These composite creatures are too metallic to be considered true Chimaeras. They are constantly chased by adventurers, leaving little time for them to search for new metal mates.

species.name: Snooty slime knight
species.flavor: A short, flimsy man who straddles a pink slime and shows off his brilliant sword skills, capturing the hearts of the girls. He's a severe narcissist who never misses combing his mane every day, much to the amazement of his slime partner.

species.name: Crimson glaive
species.flavor: It roars and makes enemies cower, then goes on a rampage swinging a giant sickle. Be careful of Kafrizzle, too. Its hideous crimson skin is said to be either stained with blood or discolored by rage.

species.name: Slime sisters
species.flavor: An idol unit from the Netherworld formed by three pink slime girls. Their signature performance, Momoiro Shower, will move fans to tears! Her dream is to reach the pinnacle of the Monster Idol Warring States period and retire while at the height of her popularity, saying, "I'm going to turn back into a normal Slime!"

species.name: Poison trill
species.flavor: It attacks by spewing poison stored in its purple body. Its appearance may be cute, but its insides are a poisonous evil spirit. Donguri Manako and Ochoboguchi have dopey looks on their faces as they make nasty, sarcastic remarks that shock the other monsters.

species.name: Red pudding
species.flavor: A monster accidentally created by a witch who loves sweets. It sometimes breathes fire, but it has no ill intentions and acts only on instinct. The pudding, which was supposed to be sweet, ended up being extremely spicy for some reason. It seems the witch who loved sweets was bad at cooking.

species.name: Soft serve spook
species.flavor: A cute ghost with a fluffy bubble body. Although it looks docile, it has surprisingly strong attack power. This is a work by a witch who loves sweets. She looks a little unhappy because she mixed up the sugar and salt in the whipped cream.

species.name: Armoured ant
species.flavor: Armoured monsters that go to battle by sucking the blood of their enemies. Fearless soldier ants that hide bombs in their tails. When walking in a queue with friends, they may step on a tail bomb and cause a major disaster.

species.name: Ice bomber
species.flavor: A bug-like monster that drops blocks of ice. A terrifying creature that absorbs the magical power of anyone it bites. The cool Ice Bomber loves shaved ice so much that he even shaves the ice himself to eat it. His favorite flavor is Blue Hawaii.

species.name: Mosquito gnat
species.flavor: A beetle-type monster with a time-honored name. A combat weapon that charges forward while protecting itself with a barrier. For some reason, I keep getting robbed by travelers. Even though I don't have anything worthwhile...

species.name: Scarab king
species.flavor: The emperor who reigns over the beetle monster world. He possesses incredible strength and attacks by dropping giant boulders. With his striking body, he stands out wherever he goes, and is the fashion king of the beetle world. He used to be a model.

species.name: Pious dogra
species.flavor: An evil nightmare demon who came from the world of dreams and controls the darkness. If you are hit by a pillow that he throws, you will be cursed. He seems to really like his brightly colored nightgown and pillow. Where on earth did he buy such tasteless things?

species.name: Napir
species.flavor: A demonic beast with a nasty look in its eyes that appears holding a pillow. It is said to put travelers to sleep and eat their dreams. It's good at putting people to sleep, but lately he has been worried about a lot of things and suffers from insomnia.

species.name: Incubus
species.flavor: A shady monster from the world of dreams that throws pillows at travelers, forcing them to sleep. He's a nosy guy who enters people's dreams, interprets their contents, and forces the results on them.

species.name: Nightmare
species.flavor: A terrifying incarnation of nightmares wielding a crimson pillow, he stirs up chaos with his Charm-Cha-Cha and hypnosis. If you rest your head on the blood-stained, bright red pillow and fall asleep, you'll never wake up from a dream about drowning in a sea of ​​blood...

species.name: Scratcher
species.flavor: A blue killer with a well-trained body and sharp claws. A formidable opponent who can slash twice and breathe flames. He is proud of his impressive claws and fins. His blue skin resembles Wetling's a bit, but he hates being told that.

species.name: Foebergine
species.flavor: An annoying fruit monster that approaches with a seductive dance and occasionally calls its allies. Be careful of its blown kisses. It is said that eating blueberries is good for your eyes, but apparently eating blueberries makes your eyes watery.

species.name: Large woebergine
species.flavor: The Jumbo Woebergine has undergone repeated breeding and improvement. Although it has grown significantly in size, its personality and fighting style remain the same. Unfortunately, I missed out on winning the jumbo vegetable contest held at Hell's Farm. I'm hoping for the next one.

species.name: Snotbonce
species.flavor: A fearsome red-eyed monster that poses as a sacred beast that brings good luck and ambushes travelers. If you get caught in its claws, you will die. When Snotbonce saw the image of a holy beast that brings good luck depicted in a certain grimoire, he realized that it didn't look like him at all!

species.name: Space devil
species.flavor: A space lifeform specialized in combat that was born from a meteorite. It considers anything that moves to be an enemy and attacks. After destroying a planet, they curl up their limbs, camouflage themselves as meteorites, and travel across space in a swarm, heading for the next planet.

species.name: Space demon
species.flavor: A space lifeform specialized in combat that was born from a meteorite. It slowly tortures its prey with toxins produced from its respiratory organs. Without words or letters, they express all their emotions through attack. They will even kill someone to convey the love they harbor.

species.name: Bilebonnet
species.flavor: A sinister red-eyed monster that poses as a sacred beast that brings good luck and stalks travelers. Beware of poison, paralysis, and confusion. When Bilebonnet saw the image of a sacred beast that brings good luck depicted in a certain story, he realized, "This is me!"

species.name: Octopot
species.flavor: A helmeted octopus soldier. A compassionate individual who sacrifices himself to dance the Kerplunk Dance. He has a lot of baby octopuses hidden under his helmet, so if anyone touches his helmet, he'll turn red with rage.

species.name: Captain drago
species.flavor: A moody dragon that can use either Boogie Breath or Blessed Breath. Either way, it's a frustrating experience for those who get hit by it. He is known in the world of demon soccer as a great captain, and was named MVP of the Demon King Cup with his lightning shot.

species.name: Hiptile
species.flavor: A dragon that boasts incredible strength that doesn't match its funky appearance. It brings poison, paralysis, and sleep, and destroys all living things. There is a strange rumor that Hiptile's earrings were blinking. Are they really earrings?

species.name: Death crow
species.flavor: Tengu, who had been training deep in the mountains, descended upon the human settlement. With one wave of his prized fan, a whirlwind of death was created. He gives various reasons for this, but in the end it seems he got tired of the training and left the mountain. He's become quite arrogant, boasting about his sorcery.

species.name: Goregoyle
species.flavor: A demon that flies freely through the sky and spreads chaos. It can create giant tornadoes by casting Kaswoosh. There is a theory that it may be a dirty Gargoyle, but the Goregoyle himself adamantly denies it.

species.name: Drackolyte
species.flavor: Spell-casting Drackies driven by a fierce desire to outdo their Drackyma cousins, who are also adepts in the art of enchantment. They stay up all night studying in order to try and get ahead.

species.name: Fightgeist
species.flavor: Skilled spectral spell-casters whose ethereal tongues can extend to more than twice the length of their ethereal bodies.

species.name: Spitegeist
species.flavor: A ghost that's gone to hell, stocked up on sinfulness, and come sauntering back to the land of the living to sow chaos.

species.name: Drohl drone
species.flavor: Though some like to see them more as members of the animal kingdom, their enthusiastic attacking of humans has made sure they continue to be classified as monsters.

species.name: Drohl diabolist
species.flavor: Extremely intelligent but utterly unlikeable, they have all manner of horrible habits, including belching up great gouts of grim gas all the time.

species.name: Skeleton scrapper
species.flavor: Reanimated bags of bones brought back from the dead in order to wreck revenge on...who exactly they can't remember, so they just attack any living being they see.

species.name: Viking soul
species.flavor: The ghost of a violent pirate who has repeatedly committed plundering acts. He strengthens his allies with Oomph and launches powerful attacks. His nefarious deeds have made him hated by the god of the sea, and even after his death, he is not allowed into the sea and instead rages on land.

species.name: Knight errant
species.flavor: A suit of blue-hued armour that's somehow been brought to life. The metal it's made of is essentially untarnishable, and so hard that swords often shatter upon impact.

species.name: Knight aberrant
species.flavor: A foul fiend lurking in Damdara. Unlike its fellow monstrous militiamen, this creature has long since abandoned all pretences to chivalry, and will swing its giant axe at each and every passer-by with equal abandon.

species.name: Knight abhorrent
species.flavor: These wicked warriors are every bit as awful as their name suggests, and they serve their dark master by slicing foes' souls from their bodies.

species.name: Knight of the white rose
species.flavor: A mysterious knight with noble aspirations like a blooming white rose. He uses Feel the Burn and gets stronger every time he is attacked. Due to his unyielding nobility and the beautiful face beneath his mask, he is hailed as the White Rose and is extremely popular among monster-type girls.

species.name: Kotobukino
species.flavor: He used to be a priest in charge of celebrating, but he went astray and became a monster. Recovery spells are handy. Even though they didn't call the monsters to celebrate, they appeared and began to organize without permission. A yokai with a reputation for being annoying.

species.name: Basarana
species.flavor: A flashy-looking monster who moves around violently. He fights while helping his allies with Zing and Multiheal. He's known as an eccentric in the industry because of his appearance and eccentric behavior, but for some reason, he's an irritating playboy who is extremely popular with the ladies.

species.name: Envoy of Yama
species.flavor: A great demon sent from Hell to reduce everything to ashes. He uses the Counter Wait stance to ambush his opponents. There is a rumor that liars have their tongues pulled out and taken away by Enma's messengers, but he's not that weak-willed.

species.name: Bamboo bopper
species.flavor: A mischievous young yokai boy who swings his favorite baton. Watch out for the spinning kicks he occasionally unleashes! His light and agile movements are the result of the bamboo stepping health method he practices every day without fail. However, his complexion remains pale.

species.name: Scroll mannequin
species.flavor: A lottery spirit that lives in the magical labyrinth. If you can defeat it, you will receive more lottery tickets as a reward. It is said that he issues all the lottery tickets for the Magic Labyrinth. He is also rumored to be in collusion with travel concierges.

species.name: Bone bat
species.flavor: An undead monster whose soul resides in the bones of a demon slain by humans and is resurrected. It launches curses. I'll be honest, when he was alive, he was a cute little Dracky! But now he's turned into bones, as you can see.

species.name: Bony bat
species.flavor: An evil bat monster said to fly around the underworld. It weakens you with curses and debilitating magic. Previously, the group consisted of five members: red, blue, yellow, pink and this white guy, but they were forced to disband when their leader, Red, retired.

species.name: Bone idol
species.flavor: The red leader of the Bony Bat Squadron has returned! He charms his enemies with his captivating gaze and finishes them off with his deadly Swoosh! He once took a break from work, worrying about his leadership qualities. But his burning passion brought him back to life!

species.name: Charm bat
species.flavor: Once you are captivated by the captivating gaze that shines from deep within her eyes, you will be controlled as her hands and feet. She seems to be proud of her pink body. Judging from her suspicious gaze and pink body, she seems to be the one in charge of sex appeal, but that's just a hollow story.

species.name: Flying corpse
species.flavor: The evil wizard has died and turned into a flying monster. Be careful of spell attacks such as Frizzle and Blunt. He is often said to be the most handsome of all the undead bats when he chants Frizzle and drives away humans.

species.name: Hell's gatekeeper
species.flavor: These big-boned fellows are no fans of magic, and prefer to protect their pals while waiting for a critical to come good.

species.name: Cosmoslime
species.flavor: A slime-like space lifeform that inhabits various places in space. It communicates with its allies telepathically and cooperates with them in battle. What appears to be a large head is actually just an ornament to deceive enemies, with its brain and heart hidden within one of its countless tentacles.

species.name: Metal healie
species.flavor: The miraculous Healslime's entire body has transformed into metal. It elegantly escapes while healing its allies. Everyone admires him for being able to heal his friends faster than anyone else, and he is called Healie after the mythical hero.

species.name: Queenie sanguini
species.flavor: Queen Fluffy has wandered in from the legendary paradise of the Kingdom of Sanguini. She sings battle songs with grace and inspires the Sanguinis. The beautiful blue of its fur is likened to an elusive blue rose. The tiara perched atop its head is proof of its standing at the top.

species.name: Snowy sanguini
species.flavor: A pedigree Sanguini with pure white fur like snow. It floats gracefully through the sky and has the chance to land a desperate attack. He has a brilliant career, having won the top prize at the annual Sanguini Competition held in the Netherworld.

species.name: Mandrake mangler
species.flavor: Dragon dragoons and masters of fire. Fiercely loyal, their friends are never far off, and when called, will come running.

species.name: Mandrake murderer
species.flavor: The dazzlingly pure white and mysterious Mandrake Marshal is said to be a lucky demon in some regions. There was a time when he rebelled against being considered sacred. The scar on his eye and the tattoos are remnants of his rebellious days.

species.name: Crystal hand
species.flavor: A beautiful and mysterious arm monster as clear as crystal. It sometimes summons Corpse Fly and changes the course of battle. The hand of the terrifying Ice Queen. She traps travelers in her icy world and collects them for her enjoyment.

species.name: Beckonring
species.flavor: The Demon Hand uses divine spells and summons allies. It is summoned by the magic of the ring on its middle finger. The mysteriously glowing ring skillfully controls the muddy arm. I tried to create the whole body, but gave up due to lack of magical power.

species.name: Muddy finger
species.flavor: It quietly emerges from the ground to attack with sleep or curse. The hand holding the ruby ​​ring seems to belong to a dead witch... During battles, he frequently summons Muddy hand. Muddy Hand seems to be willing to help, but in reality, he's just using him as an errand boy...

species.name: Witch's nail
species.flavor: Sometimes it will summon the Knight of the Stone to heal itself with Midheal and use it to its fullest. A monster with a haughty personality. The hands of a wicked witch grab the dancing jewels and snatch the gems from the bag. She seems to be desperate for her old age.

species.name: Chomp star
species.flavor: A demonic dance champion who combines graceful Hustle Dancing with intense spinning attacks reminiscent of breakdancing. That golden body is proof of a dazzling star in the dance world. Once our eyes meet, it's too late. I'll never let go of your heart.

species.name: Skeleton swordsman
species.flavor: Bony barbarians that requisitioned four arms from their fallen foes and attached them to their torso. They have sworn not make any more bodily modifications...to themselves.

species.name: Grievous bodily arm
species.flavor: Skeletal swordsmen that were masters of the blade before they became bones. They abandoned their humanity-and their mortality-in order to attain ultimate power.

species.name: Bushy Baby
species.flavor: Spring: A spirit born from newly sprouted trees. It appears in a cute form to soothe travelers. Even though it's time to graduate from diapers, this baby Treeface says he doesn't want to become an adult and refuses to take off his diapers.

species.name: Chocolate mudpie
species.flavor: A molten chocolate monster. It ferociously attacks the traveler who chants Boulderbringer and falls into the trap! It is said that this monster was born from the grudge of boys who did not receive any chocolate on that special day in February...

species.name: Shipwrecker
species.flavor: The vengeful spirits of people who drowned emerge from sunken ships. They are adept at appearing suddenly in front of you with their tricky movements. He appears at resorts in midsummer and gets in the way of couples playing in the waves. It seems he has a painful past.

species.name: Demon cloud
species.flavor: A horrible mass of demonic miasma that scatters cursed blades of dark breath all around. When angry, it will cast deadly spells. When you're feeling a little lonely and you sigh, all the flowers and plants around you will wither and wither all at once, making you feel even lonelier.

species.name: Golden Gloom
species.flavor: Nebulous nightmares with bothersome breath attacks and spells at their disposal. They like to evaporate then sneak up on adventurers to whisper words of death into their ears.

species.name: Baalzebub
species.flavor: A terrifying demonic genius who harvests human souls and offers them to the Demon King. He ties them up with tying spells and ends their lives with ice spells. In fact, he has a sweet tooth and especially loves soda. He says that if he has a soda, he can eat three bowls of rice.

species.name: Little wyvern
species.flavor: An ancient pterosaur baby born among the Small Fries' eggs. He's a little lost. He is bullied by his Small Fry brothers, and while holding back his tears, he dreams of the day he can fly in the sky.

species.name: Great keeper
species.flavor: Golden guardians of heaven's gates that pass judgement on would-be entrants. They eliminate those unable to meet their strict standards.

species.name: Forest peckerel
species.flavor: The leader of the forest bird monsters. He is also called the green angel because of his ability to heal his allies with Midheal and Kazing. The green feathers are easy on the eyes, and professional birdwatchers say they can rest their tired eyes by looking at the Forrest Peckerel's feathers.

species.name: Ersatz Estark
species.flavor: These mechanical menaces in malevolent mail were made by an evil engineer who modelled them after Estark, Lord of the Underworld.

species.name: Cosmo lunatick
species.flavor: An extraterrestrial lifeform that freely swims through space. It kills its prey with strange rays emitted from its gigantic eyeball. They have a terrifying biology in which they secretly lay their eggs inside the bodies of other extraterrestrial lifeforms and reproduce by using their flesh as nutrients.

species.name: Lunatick prince
species.flavor: A prince of the Lunatick world, wearing a large crown on his head. A thoroughbred with a wide variety of skills. Born to Raving Lunatick and Queen, he is of a distinguished lineage. Many women are enthralled by his cool and elegant gaze.

species.name: Lunatick queen
species.flavor: The Queen of the Lunatick World, wielding the power of lightning. She glares with her large eyes and paralyzes anyone who makes eye contact with her. The queen protects her nest with many soldier Lunaticks. She seems to be keeping a

species.name: Killer Torch
species.flavor: The murder candle was dyed red from being bathed in so much blood. It will release its hidden magical power and cast a series of spells. It is said that the path this guy walked on was a red path dripping with wax and human blood, and not a single blade of grass would grow.

species.name: Maniacal mole
species.flavor: Clutching a bloody and sweaty pickaxe, the beast watches over the underground. It gathers its strength to bring down a hammer on any traveler who gets in the way of the construction work. A reliable foreman who watches over the moles working underground. He won't tolerate shoddy work.

species.name: Wrecktor
species.flavor: Priests who serve a dark and unknown evil. Their extended exposure to eldritch energies has stripped them of every last vestige of humanity.

species.name: Little devil
species.flavor: Dinky demons sent to torment mankind as part of their training. They can't graduate until they've upset at least a hundred sorry souls.

species.name: Imp
species.flavor: Miniature maniacs that shoulder the hopes of all monsterkind. They try to cast all kinds of spells they don't know yet, hoping it will make them appear tougher than they actually are.

species.name: King she-slime
species.flavor: His body shines like the sun, filled with love for his fellow Slimes, and the crown that shines on his head is supported by his pride in protecting his comrades. I can't say this openly, but I think it would be good to have monsters to accompany me that have an orange color that stands out, like Slimes or Bubble slimes.

species.name: Noble dragon
species.flavor: Wondrous wyrms whose bodies suck in the power of starlight, giving them powers for which they've been celebrated since time out of mind.

species.name: Hoodie
species.flavor: Cowled criminals that only ever attack humans, supposedly because one once laughed at their face covering, leaving them with lasting psychological scars.

species.name: Infanticore
species.flavor: A mishmash of monsters that was birthed solely to slay adventurers. They soar high on dragon-like wings, before swooping down to attack with all six appendages.

species.name: Arcticore
species.flavor: Leonine beasts with a bitterly cold disposition, they use icy incantations to freeze the foes they hunt. However, having such a frigid body leaves them feeling sluggish and surly.

species.name: Type G0
species.flavor: The latest machine developed through repeated improvements to the Killing Machine. Not only have its bow and sword attacks been improved, but its cruelty has also been powered up! The meaning of the "G" in Type G0 has not been made public, but there are rumors that it actually contains Grandpa ...

species.name: Archbashop
species.flavor: Mindlessly violent ministers who hate creation and absolutely adore destruction. They'll only rest when the world stands in ruins at last.

species.name: Crone
species.flavor: Witches that turned into monsters when they swapped an ethical education in magic to pursue their own desires. They weep when they consider what could have been.

species.name: Divine dragon
species.flavor: A giant dragon enveloped in an aura of holy light. Challenged Hero and the party to reach their true potential through an epic battle of divine wrath and mercy.

species.name: Golden dragon
species.flavor: A golden dragon with scales as bright as the sun at the height of summer. His limitless willpower and reserves tested Hero and party during a long and arduous battle.

species.name: Silver dragon
species.flavor: A giant dragon with scales glitter like sunlight on a frozen waterfall. His cold gaze penetrated Hero and the party during battle, judging their qualities and capabilities.

species.name: Merking
species.flavor: Monarchs of merkind that are well-equipped to wage war; they cause chaos in combat with Crackle spells and can call in their kin as reinforcements.}}

species.name: Umbra
species.flavor: These denizens of the dark toil away in the shadows hoping to solidify their maleficent master's iron grip on the realm.}}

species.name: Li'l Whizzer
species.flavor: A frightening monster that calls its allies and drops bombs. Its all-green body gives it an oriental feel. It is whispered among gambling-loving travelers that when 14 of these are gathered together, something incredible will happen.

species.name: Gelbatross
species.flavor: A vicious demonic bird from the underworld. Its sharp claws are dangerous, but the most dangerous thing is its powerful dark magic. A legendary champion of underworld golf, getting the ball into the cup three strokes less than the regulation number is called a Gelbatross.

species.name: Quetzalcoatlus
species.flavor: The king of pterosaurs with a golden body who was once worshipped as a god. He spews flames fiercely and is adept at using Kaboom. There is a legend left behind by a tribe that claims to have been born from the sun, and it is said that when the sun perishes one day, the dragon will perish along with the sun.

species.name: Emporer tapper
species.flavor: The emperor of the tap world, dressed in flashy fur, will dazzle you with his magnificent moves, such as Kasnooze and Fizzle. The golden fur is proof of the emperor. The friction of the intense tapping damages the fur, causing it to lose its color and begin to shine golden.

species.name: Prometimos
species.flavor: A type of Cutterfly that grows by eating magma. The ability to launch flameballs is also a product of magma power. They have a tendency to swarm around flames, and sometimes getting too close can cause burns. It's hard to resist instincts like that.

species.name: Antiquitree
species.flavor: A spirit tree from the Netherworld that has lived for thousands of years and acquired evil knowledge. Uses advanced spells to sow chaos and destruction. Misunderstanding that it is an elixir for longevity, there is no end to the number of undeliverable people who tear off the leaves of the head and take them with them.

species.name: Evil tree-ent
species.flavor: A surprisingly dexterous tree monster that confuses enemies with its enchanting dance and torments its enemies with dark magic and sleep magic. Treeface has evolved over the years as the leaves change color, and its old-fashioned footwork is known for its ability to transform.

species.name: Dark brownie
species.flavor: A cheerful and powerful evil fairy who swings around a huge, vicious club with increasing excitement. She claims that her round eyes are her charm point, but they blend in with her black body and it's hard to tell.

species.name: Spiked club
species.flavor: A fearsome executioner who sends travelers to hell, delivering a crushing blow with his specially made spiked club. I once considered using a spiked hammer, but then I thought about what would happen to my name...

species.name: Bodkin bloodbow
species.flavor: An evil archer wearing a blood-stained red hood. He just single-mindedly releases Rain of Pain. The golden bow and arrow he holds in his left hand are the spoils of war he received from the archer he fought with earlier. It seems that he has no eye for shiny things.

species.name: Elder shield
species.flavor: A reliable brother of the little cubs with impressive topknots. No other cub can match his strong defense! Apparently, he spends an hour every morning styling his seemingly carefree topknot. He's surprisingly stylish.

species.name: Lil' tyke
species.flavor: Imp, who loves bingo, transforms after winning a series of matches! He unleashes the lucky breathing technique that brings good fortune. The fork in the left hand is a lucky charm that brings luck the more you poke it. There is a rumor going around that you can win at bingo with it, and many adventurers are eager to get poked!

species.name: Mogus
species.flavor: A noble feline mage with beautiful fur, she has honed her skills to even control Kaboom. He was originally a pet kept by a nobleman of the Netherworld, but he decided to become independent and rose to become a great wizard.

species.name: King foo dog
species.flavor: The sacred beast that was meant to drive away evil spirits was captured by the darkness and turned into a demonic beast. It spreads destruction while increasing its tension. He has lost his status as a sacred beast and people have come to hate him, but he doesn't care about that. It's all good.

species.name: Cosmo ghoul
species.flavor: An artificial space lifeform created to resemble a human in order to lure the people of the Moon into a false sense of security. Its sharp claws are laced with various poisons. Perhaps because the maker lacked artistic sense, this was the best they could do to resemble a human.

species.name: Hell's bellboy
species.flavor: A polite and gentlemanly monster who opens and closes the gates of hell. He has a gentle personality despite his appearance, but when he gets angry, he will trap you with the door. He has a welcoming spirit and welcomes anyone into Hell, but believes it is impossible to understand the stubborn Monban of Hell.

species.name: Peekabogre
species.flavor: A demon who boasts an impenetrable defense with a large shield. He can knock opponents away with a technique called Buckler Bash. I've had a terrible life as a demon up until now, but I've decided to get a big shield and make a comeback. Now is the time to stand up, demon!

species.name: Celtic faun
species.flavor: A ferocious, deformed beastman said to have come from the Netherworld. The sound of the flute fires him up and he launches a nightmarish attack. He was once a personal musician serving an aristocrat in the Netherworld, but he also has a dreamy side and came to Earth to pursue solo careers.

species.name: Night cat
species.flavor: A cat monster with wings that flies around in the darkness of the night and launches surprise attacks on enemies. Specializes in wind spells. I always sleep badly and worry about the tip of my head becoming pointy, so I always wear a nightcap when I go to sleep.

species.name: Drakulurch
species.flavor: He will not spare any of his enemies and will attack them all with his powerful blasts and fireballs. Although her doctor has recommended she go on a diet, she is risking her life by eating a lot in order to maintain the power of her Stomp.

species.name: Golden globe
species.flavor: Coveted by collectors the world over, these poor plants are sick and tired of the seemingly endless string of kidnap attempts they're forced to endure.

species.name: Robber rabbit
species.flavor: A stray rabbit who makes a living by stealing crops. His specialty is the Drop Kick, which he learned after going through a hellish situation. He looks scary at first glance, but underneath the mask he has a rather childlike face, and his round eyes stare back at you.

species.name: Bad hare
species.flavor: Originally a human bunny, he underwent dark training and turned black. He is a merciless assassin of the plains, with powerful fighting techniques. In the darkness, he underwent dark training to defeat the Robo-robins that attacked him from all sides. He was caught up in the self-destruct and turned black.

species.name: Ripped rabbit
species.flavor: A rabbit monster who has experienced the sweet and sour things of this world. He won't hesitate to make a suicide attack to defeat his enemies. Just between you and me, Ripped is a title given to a rabbit that has survived many ordeals.

species.name: Rottontail
species.flavor: His signature move is Multifists...but other than that, everything about this unidentified masked man is shrouded in mystery. He looks like a ferocious rabbit, but he is a kind-hearted masked man who secretly gives presents to underprivileged children.

species.name: 24-carrot bunicorn
species.flavor: A rabbit monster with shiny golden fur and eye-catching horns. Despite its cute appearance, it is ferocious in its search for prey. 24-Carrot Bunicorn's favorite food is corn soup with whole kernels. He skillfully uses his horns to eat the corn left at the bottom of the pot.

species.name: Summer wolf
species.flavor: A wolf man dressed in bright summer clothes. Just like his appearance, he has a light-hearted personality and will run away if he gets into trouble. "Summer Wolf" I made countless women cry during my summer adventures... All men are wolves ♪

species.name: Aloehaha
species.flavor: A baby demon born from an aloe vera plant. It taps to make itself lighter and when it gets angry, it gets excited and attacks. There was a time when rumors spread that it was good for beauty and health, and it was very popular. Those were the good times...

species.name: Scary cherry blossom
species.flavor: An evil spirit, enchanted by the beauty of the falling cherry blossom petals, resides within them. It charms travelers with its Cha-Cha, gathers up its power, and attacks. The mascara is perfect, the lipstick is crimson, and the straps of the geta are cherry blossom-colored. It's girly and makes my heart flutter...but...

species.name: Caterwaulin' kelp
species.flavor: A big name in the kelp world, he commands thousands of kelp monsters. His commanding baritone voice inspires the hearts of his allies. He graduated from Kaiso Military Academy at the top of his class. After racking up successes in many battles, he beat his rivals in the promotion race and was finally promoted to general.

species.name: Singing hibiscus
species.flavor: After singing the Magical Melody to increase his magical might, he can cast a powerful Kacrackle. He can also summon the Caterwaulin' Kelp. It is said that he was born when the essence of the long-lived Caterwaulin' Kelp overflowed and covered his entire body.

species.name: Vis mager
species.flavor: These sadistic sorcerers spend so long picturing the pained faces of their poor victims that they no longer know what a smile looks like.

species.name: Stumped druid
species.flavor: A fearsome dark fairy who can cast spells of darkness and death, her ruthless fighting style is highly regarded even in the Netherworld. Her seemingly cute appearance lures her targets into a false sense of security, and she is an accomplished assassin who can then finish them off with powerful spells.

species.name: String fella
species.flavor: A mischievous monster who wants your attention and will attack you with a hammer or strangle you with a rope. A soul resides in the braided sash woven by a renowned craftsman. Despite its appearance, it was originally a luxury item only available to celebrities.

species.name: Wire man
species.flavor: A string monster hero appears from a narrow gap. Throws a hard rope at the enemy to immobilize them. He appears with the words, "It's not just the rope that's tightly bound! I'm Wireman, the warrior of bonds!"

species.name: Puppet rope
species.flavor: A monster of ropes tied up like a doll, it uses its thin body to tighten its grip and launch spinning punches. He was originally used by humans as a puppet in plays, but he grew tired of his life of being tied down, so he became a monster that binds humans.

species.name: Schwarzchuld
species.flavor: In addition to his unparalleled sword skills, he also has excellent defense with his Kabuff. An elite knight of the jet-black class who excels in both offense and defense. The armor has become blackened as a result of long years of training in throwing lightning. This blackness is proof of the effort.

species.name: Harmachis
species.flavor: A god of heresy at whose feet all demons bow down. He exterminates living beings by engulfing them in hellish flames with his Kafrizzle. There is a terrifying legend that at the end of the world, Harmachis will appear in great numbers from the depths of the earth and reduce the world to nothingness.

species.name: Emerald demon
species.flavor: A strange emerald-colored demon who can freely swing a large axe and cast spells of fierce winds, sending anyone who approaches to hell. Born in May, he is the breeze-breezing young man who is most proud of his beautiful, deep green body and spends all his free time taking care of himself.

species.name: Mandrake mercenary
species.flavor: Not only skilled with a sword, this devious drake is a talented tactician to boot! However, these proficiencies both pale before his true calling-coming with cruel and unusual ways to make humans suffer.

species.name: Pandora's chest
species.flavor: A chest of drawers from the Netherworld that holds magical powers. It uses Whack and Death Dance to kill its prey, then gulps it down in one gulp. Originally it had the rather unkind name "Man-Eating Chest of Drawers," but it was renamed to something cooler to compete with Pandora's Box.

species.name: Killer fang
species.flavor: A bloodthirsty beast that is feared as a man-eater. It takes the opportunity to sacrifice itself and launches an onslaught of attacks. Killer Fang's sharp fangs grow larger as it ages. It seems that the person with the most magnificent fangs becomes the king of the herd.

species.name: Blondie
species.flavor: The fashionable leader of the monster world with a wine red body, a golden mane, and fangs peeking out from his nihilistic smile. It is said that the reason why he is so violent and bites anyone is because he is frustrated by being called a boy.

species.name: Orc queen
species.flavor: A magnificent monster who hides her kind heart behind her crimson fur and rules over many Orcs. She helps her allies with healing spells. A new theory has recently been published in a paper by Dr. Ivanov, a monster scientist, which suggests that the Orc Queen is not a queen at all, but simply a gluttonous orc.

species.name: Hyperboarean
