species.flavor: A troublesome monster that causes avalanches when it goes wild. When its attack power increases with its fighting dance, its trouble level also increases. The weapon in his hand is something he's proud of, but what he wants to brag about even more is his big, shapely ass. But he's embarrassed to show it off.

species.name: Gnubie
species.flavor: An ancient magical beast that existed before humans were born. It has a habit of pushing away anyone who approaches carelessly. Long ago, this world was dominated by an ancient lord. Now, only those who have adapted to the environment are barely surviving.

species.name: Golden disco
species.flavor: Although he has a cheerful and flashy personality, he shows a variety of expressions during battle, and at times he can intimidate others with his stern attitude. Although she looks glamorous and gorgeous, she doesn't have much money because she spends too much time at clubs.

species.name: Mortcury
species.flavor: The frozen meteorite that fell from the sky of another world was imbued with a will of its own. Uses Kaboomle to sweep away all enemies. It is rumored that anyone who sees Mortcury will soon die, but in the first place, most people who encounter such a vicious monster will die.

species.name: Caper tiger
species.flavor: These monsters are tasked with taking down a wild tiger and pilfering its pelt as part of their coming-of-age ceremony. The prized ponchos they put on are proof positive that they were up to the task.

species.name: Cursed rock
species.flavor: It usually lives a lazy life, just rolling around slowly, but once it locks onto its prey, it will use its strength to defeat it. It seems that anyone who encounters the cursed rock will be cursed with the image of its smile burned into their mind for the rest of their lives.

species.name: Twisted torch
species.flavor: It confuses the viewer with its smooth, stiff movements. An unpleasant monster chases after them with Kafrizz. It was originally built to serve as a pillar for the Demon King's castle, but if you let your guard down, it would buckle and could not support the ceiling.

species.name: Robber baron
species.flavor: Money talks, even in the underworld. These purse purloiners are far from pensive in the perdition that they call home-nabbing even a single dubloon is enough to have them doing handstands.

species.name: Wolfram wartoise
species.flavor: Always starts with the Bounce effect.

species.name: Gracolyte
species.flavor: Cannot be tamed.

species.name: Mirror grimage
species.flavor: Always starts with the Bounce effect.

species.name: Iron duke
species.flavor: Always starts with the Bounce effect.

species.name: Scarlet scorpion
species.flavor: Armoured scorpions which have been baked bright red under the savage desert sun. Just don't call them 'lobsters', or they'll sting you where the sun don't shine.

species.name: Diethon
species.flavor: Sinister great snakes who douse their foes in deadly poison. But they fall foul of their own virulent venom if they don't purge themselves of it at least once a year.

species.name: Sting slime
species.flavor: Despite appearances, they're actually appalling swimmers, and prefer to spend their summers by the beach instead of the open ocean.

species.name: Multicolour mannequin
species.flavor: He boasts a rainbow-colored body. He's good at Weird Dancing, but he also likes to use powerful explosive spells, and he loves flashiness just like his appearance. It is said that this shine is achieved when the mud of a long-lived Mud mannequin hardens and is polished by wind and rain. According to one theory, it takes 100 years.

species.name: Snow elder
species.flavor: An ancient dragon that lives deep in the snowy mountains. It uses C-C-Cold Breath and Kacrackle and other absolute zero blizzard attacks. It freezes everything. There was an incident where a man climbed a small hill to enjoy skiing on a snowy mountain and ended up standing on the back of a Snow Elder.

species.name: Special metal slime
species.flavor: Morphs into a Metal king slime if there are eight of them.

species.name: Glacial golem
species.flavor: A monster guarding the Gate of Trials carved from an underground block of ice. I may not look like this, but I'm actually quite sensitive to the cold. I've been alone for a long time, so my heart is also cold. Someone please warm me up.

species.name: Urubea genie soldier
species.flavor: None}}

species.name: Lumberin' Jack
species.flavor: A zombie that drags its rotten, festering body and spews gas. A terrifying messenger from the underworld that brings poison, paralysis, and curses. I wandered for a long time searching for my long-lost lover. Eventually I forgot myself and fell into the underworld, becoming like this.

species.name: Grand Dragon
species.flavor: A five-headed dragon of golden display that was thought to be the stuff of legend. Only those the Goddess has smiled upon are permitted to bask in its glory.

species.name: Ursa Argentum
species.flavor: While their silver coats are warm and fuzzy, their temperaments are anything but. These cold-blooded beasts are seriously savage and land critical hits for fun.

species.name: Hardy hand
species.flavor: The horrible hands of berserk combatants that lost their lives before their dreams were realised. They were later reborn as abhorrent appendages that brim with animosity.

species.name: Steely statue
species.flavor: Cast in forges where dark forces flow freely, their bodies have been imbued with exotic power. Regular weapons leave nary a scratch on these merciless monuments.

species.name: Iron Knight
species.flavor: These suits of armour once belonged to noble knights, but were possessed by sinister spirits. Each scratch on their armour is a score they long to settle.

species.name: Giruffian
species.flavor: A master of the sword, he skillfully moves his long neck to capture the enemy's appearance, and if he finds a chance, he will use a Multiclub or a Kasizzle. A Girascal during training. Once fully trained, they become Girapscallions. After many years, he finally became a Giruffian.

species.name: Giraffe sister
species.flavor: Her motto is "Strength is beauty!" The movements of those who have mastered the way of the staff are like a mesmerizing dance that even their enemies are entranced by. On her days off, she likes to wash off her battle makeup and take a sneaky stroll in a loose, fluffy style. Oh, no battles today!

species.name: Blue giraffe
species.flavor: A demonic monk who has undergone rigorous training and whose head has grown long, earning him great respect. He swings his explosive stick with graceful, dancing movements. Opinion is divided in the academic community as to its origin as being a dragon or a giraffe, and one theory is that it was originally a combined monster created through alchemy.

species.name: Dead bowdy
species.flavor: A mummy, not so much petrified as prettified, with a large pink ribbon and bow. But would anyone want to receive such a present?

species.name: Morrimp
species.flavor: An imp being impish by dressing up as Morrie. But it's not just the imp-osing outfit. Oh no, this cheeky devil is an imp-rovement on its brethren, with more GUSTO and more PASSION! So beware!

species.name: Gold nugcat
species.flavor: A candy cat coated in gold! In fact, it's so shiny, you shouldn't look straight cat it, for fear of clawsing damage to your eyes!

species.name: Cherreevil blossom
species.flavor: Everyone's favourite treevil when it's time to sit under the cherry blossoms in spring. But best observed from afar, since it will attack if it twigs you're there.

species.name: Santaclops
species.flavor: A spontaneous Xmas transformation of a hell hopper in a festive mood. Add a dead bowdy into the mix, and you've got a truly magical crimbo combo!

species.name: Box of tricks
species.flavor: A chestful of trouble inside which chaos reins.

species.name: Coffer of death
species.flavor: A fabled chest that promises to deliver all who encounter it to the hereafter.

species.name: Hippocamper
species.flavor: A sea horse that runs freely across the ocean floor, defying the currents of the water. It uses its Air Pollution to weaken its opponents and deliver a devastating blow. I would love to compete in a gallop with a horse, a creature that lives on land, but sadly the living world is too far away.

species.name: Ori column
species.flavor: A fearsome dance master who lures enemies into the world of death with mystical and mysterious movements that exude the scent of the orient. Originally, he was just a Prancing Pillar. When he was young, he traveled to an eastern country and was fascinated by the local dances, becoming a master after training.

species.name: Shadow noble
species.flavor: A noble black knight born in the depths of darkness, wearing a shadow. His signature Multithrust instantly transforms the world around him into a world of death. He comes and knocks on your door in the middle of the night, when even the plants and trees are asleep. It is said that anyone who accidentally opens the door will disappear, leaving behind only a shadow.

species.name: Picky mole
species.flavor: Release all the tension you've been building up in one go and get into a super high-tension state. In one go, it'll come at you! A legendary pickaxe user and tunnel construction expert, he is well known among the Shigura Demons. He has dug countless caves.

species.name: Dark nebulus
species.flavor: The evil legacy of the ancient Al-Agun. It was created using technology that cannot be replicated in modern times, and it vaporizes the target without a trace. It was created as an ultimate weapon to protect the ancient kingdom, but now only one remains roaming beneath the Pyramid.

species.name: Icicle dragon
species.flavor: The bones of many different animals that were frozen to death in a blizzard gathered together and began to move, imitating the shape of a dragon. Its breath freezes everything. I can at least breathe. Just like you guys! Like this, inhale and exhale... That's it. This is breathing!

species.name: Eagle devil
species.flavor: A noble demon with black wings who commands the Gargoyles. He uses his powerful sword technique to perform dive techniques. Hawk man calls himself a noble devil, but he has actually lived a long life. Now that he has gained fame and fortune, he has become even more selfish.

species.name: Rainbow rock
species.flavor: A rock monster that has the glow of an aurora floating in the icy sky. Be careful, as it will unleash a Kamikazee if you stare at it carelessly. The best way to relax is to lie down and look up at the sky with the Aurora dancing. Apparently, this is called aurora bathing.

species.name: Mandrake militant
species.flavor: He is confident in his Oomph and Leaping Cleaver, but his cautious nature and the fact that he never forgets to call for his allies makes him even more formidable. Don't be fooled at first glance. His dull body color is said to be cool, but he is still a very popular handsome man in the Mandrake Major world.

species.name: Night cardinal
species.flavor: A noble dark paladin who wields the power of death and annihilates all enemies that stand in his way with powerful spells and swordsmanship. He has a nasty habit of going by majority vote when making important decisions, which often results in him making unfavorable choices.

species.name: Tree sage
species.flavor: A Monolog that has become powerful after being parasitized by a Carnivine. Not only does it bite, it can also use healing spells. So does the heart of the Tree Sage belong to the Carnivine or the Monolog? The truth is shrouded in mystery.

species.name: Motherwood
species.flavor: The grudge of the murdered mother bird resides in the stump and turns it into a monster. It uses Kabuff and healing spells to protect the chicks in the nest. If you secretly observe it, you can see the heartwarming sight of a mother and child feeding the chirping chicks.

species.name: Snowball
species.flavor: A fairy that sometimes appears when it snows. She hops around happily, but she is always on guard against Mages who cast fire spells, as she hates them. It's a popular rumor among kids that if you leave Snowball's rain boots at home on Christmas, you'll definitely find a present inside the boots the next morning.

species.name: Rose princess
species.flavor: A spirit princess from a land of flowers that is said to exist somewhere. A mischievous princess who likes to turn people into roses. She transforms into roses using the magic of the walking stick she holds in her hand. She has brought back the treasures of her hometown to fill the world with flowers.

species.name: Devil maru
species.flavor: In life, he was a fiendish, wild samurai who committed every kind of cruelty possible. Even now, he continues to curse people and live his life in wickedness and cruelty. They say that Bushido is the way of death, but this guy boasts that the way of immortality is to find not dying.

species.name: Lingering ogre
species.flavor: A combat professional with an excellent balance of both offense and defense, he stands before people as a test of their abilities. The left and right shields have names, the one on the left is Furious Blackus and the one on the right is Greedy Orenzel. Both have very bad personalities.

species.name: Angora faun
species.flavor: A demon feared by the people as a messenger of the Great King of Terror. The tremendous power of Kafrizz is the very definition of fear. According to the prophet Puctradamus, on the last day, a horn will be blown to announce the end of the world to everyone.

species.name: Belfggor
species.flavor: A cold-hearted and excellent commander of a terrifying demon army. He scorches the surface of the earth with his Scorch breath attack. He's a sports-oriented corps commander who will punish monsters that he finds slacking by making them run around the Netherworld 30 times. He's strict, but he's also good at taking care of them.

species.name: Black batboon
species.flavor: A demon with great magical powers that can even control Kasizz. He has also mastered the death spell Thwack, so he is an opponent you cannot let your guard down against. The famous great demon Pazuzu is said to be from the Gusion tribe. They are very proud that such a famous demon came from their tribe.

species.name: Angola lizard
species.flavor: The reason he can live with Yuki in the flames is thanks to the heat of his Blessed Breath. He's a vicious guy who uses Oomph to increase his attack power and swings his tail around. Ever since he found out about the existence of a monster called Angora faun, he has secretly been burning with a competitive spirit. Will they ever become rivals?

species.name: Grand yellow belly
species.flavor: A giant yellow dragon that has evolved differently from Frou-Frou. It can now use Blessed Breath and the spell Remoreheal. There is also a rumor that the whole body being yellow is actually a warning sign of health problems caused by being overweight.

species.name: Silverine
species.flavor: A beautiful warrior demon with a silver-white body and golden hair. He cuts down anyone who opposes him with a single stroke of his dazzling golden axe. They take great care of their bodies to maintain their pride and joy of whiteness, but it seems that the undersides of both wings are difficult to brush and have darkened slightly.

species.name: Fromage fey
species.flavor: A tactician who lowers your resistance to magic and uses spells. The surface of his body is like oil that burns well. Seems to be slimy with burning oil. I also remember Frizz-type spells, but I'm determined not to use them because it would be terrible if my body accidentally caught fire.

species.name: Spirit flame
species.flavor: An evil will-o'-the-wisp that uses its breath to inflict pain on enemies and cast deadly spells. Beware of the Spinning Wheel skill. It is said to lure lost travelers into the forest, disguised as a bonfire, then take their life and make them its ally.

species.name: Old flame
species.flavor: It is said that the flames surrounding this monster shine so beautifully that they imbue the torches used in rituals with the power of fire. The Dancing Flame that has been burning for 1000 years without being extinguished has evolved to become stronger and purer, approaching the primordial flame.

species.name: Lickity spit
species.flavor: A perverse lower-level demon who loves to harass others and is good at attacks to achieve that end. Despite his small body, he is quite a big eater. Although Ukobak is a big eater, he is surprisingly picky about what he likes and dislikes. He loves fried food, and his favorite food is fried lizards.

species.name: Rapscallion
species.flavor: It is larger than the demon beast Eagle and is more cruel and cunning. It roams the frost-covered drift ice fields, violently slicing its prey to pieces. His stubborn father is actually searching for his runaway son, but is getting frustrated when he can't find him.

species.name: Blue horn
species.flavor: A wind-controlling, bull-shaped demonic beast that corners its opponent with kicks and critical hits, then finishes them off with a Wind Sickles attack. Due to his red and blue coloring, he is often paired with the inferior Red Horn, which secretly scars him.

species.name: Red fang
species.flavor: When the beastman is angry, his flaws become more apparent and his body appears bright red. He becomes highly excited and attacks ferociously. It was named after the cry it makes, "hunger". It is said that there are many different kinds of "hunger" sounds, as they use different pitches depending on their emotions.

species.name: Dark sabrecub
species.flavor: These baby dark sabrecats are vicious hunters who move as swiftly and silently as shadows, and put even the adults of some other species to shame.

species.name: Nessicure
species.flavor: The king of ferocious sea dragons, feared as the ruler of the deep seas. With a frozen spirit of ice, he specializes in cold attacks. The king thinks of the oarfish as his subordinate, but in reality, they have no relationship. In fact, he is a sad man with no new clothes.

species.name: Soul Mole in Memoriam
species.flavor: Don Mole's revival tour backing singers, joining him in the fourth challenge you encounter down Memories Lane. They're stouter and more soulful than ever, but can still be Dazzled.

species.name: Captain Crow in Memoriam
species.flavor: The sixth challenge that awaits on a trip down Memories Lane. Even in memoriam Crow is buckling swash, and enjoys giving a daring display of tension-building almost as much as receiving a puff-puff.

species.name: Goregonzolla
species.flavor: A cheese monster that spreads a unique odor around it. Its scent is so strong that you can tell where it is even if you can't see it. I often feel frustrated when I'm told that my name is inferior. He trains every day in hopes of becoming the ferocious boss he lives up to his name.

species.name: Needler
species.flavor: Easily recognised by the bundles of abundant fluff spilling from their masks, these furry fellows will make pincushions of pretty much anything they can poke their enormous needles into.

species.name: Haystack needler
species.flavor: These dapper dancers are said to have the deftest steps in the business, and spend their days sashaying across the sands with friends and family.

species.name: Lampling
species.flavor: A fire demon that has taken up residence in an abandoned lantern. Disguised as a lantern, it showers unsuspecting adventurers with sparks. People often ask me if the flames I'm holding close to my body aren't hot, but in fact they are extremely hot. I endure them in order to hide my true identity.

species.name: Grublin
species.flavor: Grisly little green grumps who won't stop swinging their swords once they get upset with someone.

species.name: Horknight
species.flavor: Elite grublin warriors who ride astride great big wasps. Beware their two-pronged spear and stinger strikes.

species.name: Rotten eggsoskeleton
species.flavor: Mechanical monsters made of a mysterious pearlescent metal as yet unknown to science, and given to emitting a paralysing gas.

species.name: Slayer of the Sands
species.flavor: The citizens of Gallopolis have lived in fear of this giant scorpion for centuries, and its unquenchable appetite for carnage has earned it a truly intimidating nickname: the Slayer of the Sands.

species.name: Fright bulb
species.flavor: Nobody knows where they started sprouting, but it's said that the first farmer to find one of these tuberous terrors was so shocked by its scream that he never picked up a spade again.

species.name: Fruity succubat
species.flavor: With her alluring appearance, which is unlike that of a monster, she lures adventurers into letting their guard down, showering them with affection and making them fall head over heels in love with her. She is a cunning monster. She finds great pleasure in captivating adventurers with her captivating gaze and slicing their throats.

species.name: Succubat
species.flavor: A beautiful and splendid monster that flies through the dark night with its large wings. Its charm makes its opponent weak in the knees, slicing them to pieces with its sharp claws. The fluffy feathers give you a Puff-Puff, which feels like heaven. But be careful, you might actually be sent to heaven if you're not careful.

species.name: Coralossus
species.flavor: Enormous creatures crafted from coral to fight in an ancient undersea war. Legend has it that they were designed to weapons of mindless destruction, with no free will of their own.

species.name: Evangelizard
species.flavor: These wise teachers of the dragon world are always in high demand, with their lectures often being booked up months ahead of time.

species.name: Bongo drongo
species.flavor: Their thundering drums are decorated with funny faces, and draw monsters from miles around with their rousing rhythms.

species.name: Brollyminator
species.flavor: Puckish parasols whose party trick is pretending to be ordinary umbrellas, then pranging the hands of those who grab the claws they have for handles.

species.name: Spitzfire
species.flavor: Hellish hounds endowed with dragon wings. They are unwaveringly loyal, and as such, are highly prized as guard dogs in the underworld.

species.name: Penny pincher
species.flavor: When people wish to make a killing on the slots, fate plays a cruel trick on them by turning them into these murderous machines.

species.name: Jerkules
species.flavor: Monstrously muscled four-armed fiends who love nothing more than flexing in front of the mirror. They've got a pose for every possible occasion.

species.name: Clangoustine
species.flavor: They may be the same colour as metal slimes, but they're nowhere near as nimble, owing to the weight of their all-but-impervious outer layer.

species.name: Otter shambles
species.flavor: Costumed creatures who have adapted to life at sea. Well, up to a point--they still can't get used to the taste of clams. Bleurgh!

species.name: Polar polly
species.flavor: A bird monster with fluffy feathers that has adapted to the frigid world. During battle, it shows no signs of being warm by unleashing its Kazammle. For a long time, they have lived comfortably without any natural predators, but with the appearance of the Rapscallion, they are becoming increasingly nervous.

species.name: Tundracky
species.flavor: Dracky is a fearsome, ruthless and heartless man who has acquired an icy spirit. However, being a Dracky, there is only so much he can do. He is concerned that his pale body colour means he cannot blend into the darkness, and becomes extremely angry when touched there.

species.name: Dark candle
species.flavor: It creates powerful spells from the flames above its head, which is the source of its magical power. A hybrid candle that combines the magical powers of darkness and fire. It is said that the countless candles used by ancient sorcerers in rituals to summon powerful spirits transformed into these monsters over time.

species.name: Pine needler
species.flavor: Fuzzy green fellows from the First Forest who've found so many World Tree leaves lying around that they've absorbed their life-giving powers.

species.name: Eggsoskeleton
species.flavor: Curious mechanical conveyances that can jump eggstremely high. Their drivers disappear when defeated, making it impossible to identify them.

species.name: Professaurus
species.flavor: Exceptionally well-educated dragons who other monsters studiously avoid for fear of being bored stiff with titbits of trivia.

species.name: Brollygagger
species.flavor: Umbrellas once owned by skilled assassins that carefully observed, and can now perfectly imitate, their former masters' moves.

species.name: Slick slime
species.flavor: Strange slimes made of an oily sludge with a truly unique texture. Touch one, and you won't forget it.

species.name: Gloomy grublin
species.flavor: Innocent, impish little things that run around the place bursting into tears at the slightest provocation.

species.name: Bite bulb
species.flavor: They're as red as ripe tomatoes, but no one's ever got close enough to take a bite and see if they taste like them. They spray out clouds of soporific spores so carelessly that they sometimes put themselves to sleep.

species.name: Leafy lampling
species.flavor: Though they began life as demonically possessed flames, long years living in the forest have seen these little fellows evolve to resemble acorns.

species.name: Midnight horknight
species.flavor: Gloomy grublins that have somehow learned to ride great big wasps. Despite their distinctly unchivalrous nature, groups of them often come together to play at being knights.

species.name: Shadow minister
species.flavor: Sent to hell for murdering their masters, these putrid politicians roam the underworld looking for new sovereigns to serve.

species.name: Kriller killer
species.flavor: Cruel crustaceans built solely for battle whose scythe-like claws are so sharp they can slice straight through their enemies' swords.

species.name: Jockilles
species.flavor: These massive mountains of muscle make an easy living as bodyguards for monsters smaller than themselves.

species.name: Silver sabrecat
species.flavor: Its pure white fur is beautiful, but it is an incredibly ferocious beast. It has killed countless prey with a single, devastating blow. They are extremely clean animals. After hunting, they always wash in rivers or lakes to remove any dirt or blood.

species.name: Kleptoreptile
species.flavor: Charismatic characters of the dragon world with many faithful followers and fans among their fellow wyrms.

species.name: Fouler jowler
species.flavor: Giants among jowlers gifted with god-like strength. It's said they're destined to save their kind in a time of great crisis.

species.name: Vampire succubat
species.flavor: A beautiful demon with dripping blood-red wings. It creates a pink storm and leaves opponents weak. A heart mark on the forehead is a charm that will make your love come true. She also has an innocent and pure side that makes it difficult for her to approach the person she likes.

species.name: Rantingen raven
species.flavor: The sight of these blood-red birds and the dragon skulls they carry can strike fear into even the most experienced soldiers' hearts.

species.name: Supreme succubat
species.flavor: Beautiful beasts whose winsome ways and plentiful puff-puffs have lured countless starry-eyed souls to an untimely end.

species.name: Snowgre
species.flavor: The failed experiments of wizards who imbue icy masses with the spark of life. The resulting creatures are completely uncontrollable, causing them to be abandoned by their creators.

species.name: Mosstodon
species.flavor: Golems who've been left out in the woods until moss and muck grew all over them. The earth shakes with every single step they take.

species.name: Leviathing
species.flavor: Snowgres reincarnated as even more atrocious foes. Their eyes glow red with animosity toward the masters who abandoned them.

species.name: Brollygarch
species.flavor: The devilish crimson of these cursed umbrellas makes them a must-have accessory among fashion-conscious fiends.

species.name: Brollympian
species.flavor: Utterly unhinged umbrellas with a worrying fixation on insta-death spells, which they supposedly learned from a king among demons.

species.name: Golden girl
species.flavor: The masterworks of the monster world's most accomplished demonic dollmaker. If ordered, they will rain down destruction indiscriminately.

species.name: Platinum poppet
species.flavor: Mechanical dolls animated by unseen forces. They keep humans as pets, and punish them painfully when they don't do exactly what they want.

species.name: Steel siren
species.flavor: When mermaids meet with truly tragic ends, the crushing weight of their bitterness causes them to be reborn as steel sirens.

species.name: Iron maiden
species.flavor: A doll that charms humans with its beautiful appearance and manipulates them at will. When it gets tired of manipulating them, it starts showering them with freezing snow. I'm a beautiful doll. Would you like to play with me? If you don't want to play with me, I'll play with you.

species.name: Grim gryphon
species.flavor: Their massive wings and cruel claws make them appear impressive, but they're mid-level monsters at best, and often get bossed around by others.

species.name: Gold drohl
species.flavor: Glitzy little snail-like so-and-sos whose shells get their shimmering sheen thanks to a diet of almost exclusively precious metals.

species.name: Stump champ
species.flavor: Demons made when the souls of men who've meet with unjust ends meld with tree trunks. They blaze bright red with rage at their wrongful deaths.

species.name: Megaton champ
species.flavor: The Netherworld arena champion who gets excited with his fighting dance and goes wild with his hip impact. Of course, he's in the open weight class! He is constantly trying to gain weight to improve his hip impact, and repeats the cycle of eating, sleeping, and training three times a day.

species.name: Abyssal octopot
species.flavor: A demon guarding the Gate of Trials, feared for its devil's tentacles. It heals its sea friends by dancing the Hustle Dance. He claimed that the octopus was once a gigantic monster capable of sinking ocean-going ships, but that the water pressure of the deep sea has caused it to shrink.

species.name: Octo dermon
species.flavor: Rather than wielding a weapon, she finds meaning in life in supporting her comrades by cheering and dancing. Its name and appearance lead people to believe it is highly poisonous, but it is actually non-poisonous. The octopus soldier is suffering from negative publicity.

species.name: Inferno
species.flavor: The flame used in a ritual by a group worshipping an evil god came to life. It became an evil entity that emitted a Cursed Mist and cursed all living beings to death. Her body temperature is surprisingly low, and she is good at dark techniques, which is actually a secret complex of hers. She wants to burn even hotter!

species.name: Desert galba
species.flavor: An outlaw whose sole purpose in life is to attack caravans in the desert. His specialty is gathering a large group of allies to surround his prey. Surprisingly, he's very popular and most of the bad guys in the desert are his friends, so no matter what the situation, his allies will come to his aid right away.

species.name: Desert gorba
species.flavor: His life's work is to discover desert oases and then dry them up with scorching winds, thus causing trouble for travelers. He became angry because his reflection in the water of the oasis was hard to see, and began to hate the oasis. What a nuisance.

species.name: Pink sabrecat
species.flavor: Despite its adorable appearance with heart patterns scattered all over its body, its ferocity and high physical abilities are no match for that of a Great Sabrecat. It is said that the more happy romantic relationships she has, the more heart patterns she will have, but for some reason, she seems to be single.

species.name: Honeyhead horknight
species.flavor: They're supposed to share their steeds' sweet honey with everyone else in the monster world, but they love it so much that they can't quite bear to.

species.name: Grumpy grublin
species.flavor: Legendary sourpusses said to be born when a grublin's gruffness boils over into outright rage. Suffice it to say, they're famously foul-tempered.

species.name: Gleeful grublin
species.flavor: These rakish rogues of the grublin world like to grin their way into the hearts of grublin girls, then toy with them mercilessly.

species.name: Jarvis's shadow
species.flavor: Jarvis is always berating his bumbling umbral underlings, but all of them are utterly unwavering in their loyalty to him.

species.name: Silver sabrecub
species.flavor: Cute little sabrecat cubs that are left out in the cruel cold of the snowfields, with the parents returning to raise only the survivors.

species.name: Sprite bulb
species.flavor: Having been raised in running water, these soothing blue relatives of the Fright bulb are said to bring peace and tranquillity to all who behold them.

species.name: Wight bulb
species.flavor: They suck the happiness from humans and store it up in tiny seeds, which when planted can grow into wish-granting flowers.

species.name: Lurid lampling
species.flavor: Jazzy little lights used as decorations for all the major monster festivals. Their contrasting colours can't fail to put one in the mood for fun.

species.name: Lava lampling
species.flavor: The fire in their bellies can reach tremendous temperatures, and losing focus for even a second could see them consumed in flames, making them understandably anxious.

species.name: Luminous lampling
species.flavor: They'll stay alive as long as the blue flames in their bellies keep on burning, and as such, are seen as symbols of life's evanescence.

species.name: Bongo fandango
species.flavor: Passionate percussionists who pound away enthusiastically despite the nippy northern winds. What better than a jam session to warm you up?

species.name: Bongo bango
species.flavor: Their thundering beats bring lurid lamplings from miles around to boogie, making death by drummer a very real risk for unwary adventurers.

species.name: Bingo bango bongo
species.flavor: Inspired by the Dark One, these demonic drummers composed a blistering beat with which to welcome the end of the world.

species.name: Lobster mobster
species.flavor: Fierce, fire-breathing beasts from the deepest depths of the ocean. The heat from their flames boils the water around them, which is what gives them their brilliant crimson hue.

species.name: Mothertoad
species.flavor: The emboldening battle ballads of this queen of amphibians can send swarms of froggy soldiers surging into the fray, filled with new-found fury.

species.name: Crushtacean
species.flavor: Unrivalled in both ferocity and greed by any other creatures of the deep, they empty the ocean wherever they go of all creatures great and small.

species.name: Gnawchid
species.flavor: Free and easy flowers that spend their days sunning themselves in oder to mantain the magnifecent marigold hue of their prodigious petals.

species.name: Runny eggsoskeleton
species.flavor: Horrifying murder machines made by madmen. They often leap up to attack from above using their powerful piston-like legs.

species.name: Clockwyrm
species.flavor: It looks colorful and pop, but it is a weapon with extraordinary lethality. It makes enemies who are deceived by its appearance and let their guard down, and plays with them. No one knows who made it, but one theory is that it was a toy made by a heaven-spanning giant to soothe babies.

species.name: Hard-boiled eggsoskeleton
species.flavor: Ultra-advanced mechanical contraptions with unmatched military might. Their spotted pattern signifies the severe danger they present.

species.name: Token taker
species.flavor: Maniacal slot machines that convince punters to pump them full of tokens, then take their lives into the bargain.

species.name: Gold grabber
species.flavor: Malevolent machines whose idea of an ideal day is one spent supping on the souls of those who foolishly trade them in for one last spin on the reels.

species.name: Fortune filcher
species.flavor: Spits out great torrents of tokens, but these are just a trick to attract the unwary, who it swallows whole when they come close.

species.name: A3G15
species.flavor: A mechanical soldier that a certain battle-loving great demon had created to use as his training partner. His fighting ability is outstanding. It is said that the great demon who created him was satisfied with its performance and gave his name to this mechanical soldier.

species.name: Mechidroid
species.flavor: A combat machine for use in high-heat areas, specializing in beam attacks and designed to be heat-resistant, even capable of withstanding the heat of magma. It is equipped with artificial intelligence through advanced programming, and it would apparently be quite hurtful if it was found to be a fake Type G0.

species.name: Shadeshifter
species.flavor: A fighting tribe that parted ways with the Flamethrowers long ago. They are the children of darkness, wielding Kazammle and Black Breath. He had wanted to live in the realm of darkness, but was frightened by the smiling, axe-wielding Headhunters and so moved away.

species.name: Red mist
species.flavor: Unsettling entities that look like nothing more than the great gouts of gore that fly up around them everywhere they goon the battlefield.

species.name: Garish garlic
species.flavor: Loathsome Leek mutated after eating a lot of garlic for health reasons. His abnormal body odor now stands in the way of adventurers. Apparently after just one fight, the smell will be unbearable for a week, so it's probably best to avoid fighting before a date if possible.

species.name: Hooper trooper
species.flavor: Bizarre beasts that use huge spiked hoops as weapons, with which they lay waste to all around them.

species.name: Hooper duper
species.flavor: Cunning creatures who jiggle their hypnotic hips in order to distract foes before slamming them with some serious spellcraft.

species.name: Hooperman
species.flavor: Superstar dancers of the monster world who take the lead in every show going, much to the grey gordons' chagrin.

species.name: Badonis
species.flavor: Muscle-bound monsters so tough, it's said they could tear the stars from the sky and punch holes through space itself.

species.name: Brodysseus
species.flavor: The leaders of elite three-hundred-man units in the underworld army who have led their men through hell and back, only to emerge smiling.

species.name: Golden goliath
species.flavor: Sizeable statues gifted with golden bodies by their creator, whose dying words they continue to hold dear to this day.

species.name: Master commander
species.flavor: The twin sword attacks of these glory-hunting tyrants of the deep are feared even by the gods themselves.

species.name: Headless horseman
species.flavor: These nasty knights gave up all pretense of chivalry long ago, and now aid the strong and prey on the weak.

species.name: Headless hunter
species.flavor: Silent as shadows, these ghostly knights fall upon their foes without warning, raining down brutal blows with unerring accuracy.

species.name: Headless norseman
species.flavor: Worshipped as gods of war in the monster world, with their chargers foaming at the mouth and their morning stars making mincemeat of enemies left and right, they're truly a terrifying sight.

species.name: Hellrider
species.flavor: Their crimson clothes mark them out as elite soldiers of the underworld. Utterly without mercy, they would pursue a foe to the depths of hell.

species.name: Calasmonaut
species.flavor: Skeletal soldiers brought to life by Calamos's malign magic. They have no will of their own, and exist purely to do their master's black bidding.

species.name: Horknight watchman
species.flavor: These ruthless rulers of the grublin kingdom are fiercely territorial, sending trespassers on their turf to an early grave with Thwack.

species.name: Tubby dracky
species.flavor: A mutant Dracky. She casts Deceleratle to hold back her enemies, then uses her voluptuous body to press them down and take them all down. When you lean against his belly, it fits your body perfectly and you don't want to get up. Dracky is a person who ruins people.

species.name: Pantomine
species.flavor: A clown who prioritizes his own safety while using the Bomboulder to bounce around on a ball. He uses various tricks to defeat his opponents and create a nightmarish stage. Apparently the Kerplunk act he performs at the Demon Circus is a surefire hit. His noble act of self-sacrifice moves people to tears and the applause never stops.

species.name: Erdrick's restless armour
species.flavor: A suit of restless armour decked out in Erdrick's signature kit who set out to engulf the world in unending terror.

species.name: Gold-plated puppet
species.flavor: With his golden, sparkling body, he is the star of the doll demon world, but he never neglects his basic Weird Dance. The shining golden body that everyone longs for is proof that he once won a gold medal at a Netherworld entertainment competition.

species.name: Ursa panda
species.flavor: A giant, hot-blooded panda that sees anyone it meets as an enemy and tears everything to shreds with a single blow from its powerful claws. A certain ruffian challenged the other to a fight to determine who the real ruffian was, but was completely defeated, and the matter was clearly decided.

species.name: Chihuawyrm
species.flavor: The sumptuous, snow-white fur of these sizeable serpents is warm enough to ward off even the most biting of blizzards.

species.name: Labradrake
species.flavor: Fabulously ferocious creatures that carved their name into legend with their own razor-sharp fangs. The mystical light they breathe can obliterate any and all that stand before it.

species.name: Tatsunaga
species.flavor: A ferocious red dragon feared for its penchant for eating people. It was originally attracted to Mount Huji by the heat and the smell of humans.

species.name: Cactolotl
species.flavor: They attract prey with their sweet-smelling cacti, then swallow it whole with their massive maws - like whales eating krill, only without any water.

species.name: Coralotl
species.flavor: Gargantuan sea reptiles who slept on the ocean bed for centuries, and were woken from their slumber when the Dark One returned.

species.name: Crystalotl
species.flavor: Curious creatures that eat ore, and refine it in their enormous insides into amethysts which are said to possess wondrous properties.

species.name: Dread dragooner
species.flavor: A warrior sent from the underworld who rides a dragon with grace. It is said that he wraps the living in a darkness and leads them to the other world. She is very sensitive to heat, so she doesn't wear tights under her armor. Her sweat gets on her body, which seems to annoy her partner dragon.

species.name: Electric needler
species.flavor: Ferocious furballs with an uncanny mastery of all things electric. Their dream is to bring all of Erdrea alive with thunder and lightning.

species.name: Spawny devil
species.flavor: These frustrating little fellows have learned how to confuse their foes, but are also in the habit of annoying their friends by doing it to them too.

species.name: Red giant
species.flavor: Only the Lord of Shadows himself need not fear these utterly unforgiving fiends. Their armour is awarded to them by the Dark One when they destroy their first kingdom single-handed.

species.name: Grey gordon
species.flavor: Committed cavorters who dedicate their lives to dance, and can be heard to say 'C'mon everybody, let's hustle!' about a hundred times a day.

species.name: Colossal cannibox
species.flavor: Titanic treasure chests whose grotesque gluttony is so unstoppable that they'll even swallow a Gigantes whole.

species.name: Mega mimic
species.flavor: Enormous mimics that are far too large to pass for treasure chests. That doesn't stop some greedy travelers from trying their luck, though.

species.name: Pandora's big bad box
species.flavor: Titanic treasure chests in which are contained all the calamities of the universe. If they were ever to escape, that would be the end of everything.

species.name: Dead man's soul
species.flavor: A very evil ghost who is particular about death spells. According to him, Thwack tastes refreshing, but Kathwack has a rich taste. I was the one who taught Thwack to the Frostburn! However, they seem to be good at deceiving people.

species.name: Cursed crooner
species.flavor: An unidentified, sinister entity exuding an extraordinary grudge. It attacks while singing a horrifying cursed song. There are many theories about its true identity, such as it being the vengeful spirit of someone who was offered as a sacrifice, or that it is searching for the man who betrayed it, but none of them have enough evidence.

species.name: Caliconjurer
species.flavor: With the power of the meat stick, the cat maker transforms into a calico cat! With love and courage, he stands out among the others and will sweep away all his enemies. Only Meowgician girls who have the sparkle of dreams in their hearts are supposed to be able to transform into calico cats, but it seems that there are rare cases of boys as well.

species.name: Deadly blade
species.flavor: A sword monster bathed in numbing medicine. It summons its allies with a horrifying screech and tears through travelers from all sides. He was performing a Sword Dance at a dance hall in the Netherworld, but other guests complained that he was constantly getting scratches, so he was banned from entering.

species.name: Grigory baby
species.flavor: He is the child of a fallen angel who rebelled against God and descended to earth. Despite being fallen from heaven, he has a habit of gathering in groups with his friends and acting in groups. Other monsters keep messing with my head. No one listens to me even though I tell them that the name doesn't mean that.

species.name: Shako demon
species.flavor: A doll that harbors a wicked evil spirit. He is an expert at inflicting abnormal conditions, disabling enemies with confusion and sleep while shining a Lullab-Eye. Originally, it was a ritual tool used to pray for the fulfillment of love, but instead of fulfillment, it brought about a breakup and was called a terrifying breakup charm.

species.name: Conquistador ghoul
species.flavor: The remains of an adventurer who set out on a journey to rule a distant golden land. Even after death and reduced to nothing but bones, he continues to seek out targets to conquer. He was extremely greedy and had an unrivaled love of gambling during his lifetime, but it seems he lost his final big gamble, which put his life on the line.

species.name: Agehafly
species.flavor: A sinister fairy with white butterfly wings that brings death. Increases the speed of its friends and use Kaboom to knock enemies down. It is said that when countless Agehaflies dance around a person who is on the brink of life or death, a beautiful field of flowers can be seen. That's why it's called the Fairy of Death.

species.name: White imp
species.flavor: A small devil said to have been born from the snow. He licks it and ends up being buried in the cold snow of Kaboomle and the Death Dance. In fact, the white part of its body is made of shaved ice. Apparently it tastes like sweet milk, but no one other than myself has ever tasted it.

species.name: Asura king
species.flavor: An evil spirit has possessed the statue of an ancient king who loved justice. The distorted justice has become an incarnation of slaughter, seeking only conflict. The Zombie Gladiators, who have witnessed countless brutal massacres, worship him as a god of war. Today, the King continues to walk the path of hell.

species.name: Pumpkabinet
species.flavor: A festival-loving Chest Mimic dressed up for Halloween. When he gets high and violent, he's impossible to control. I'm told it's trick or treat, but no matter what you choose, you're faced with a hellish choice: they'll eat you whole.

species.name: Crankiid
species.flavor: A mysterious baby squid appears quietly in the shadows of scary monsters all over the world. It drops the Holy Crest of Zelmea. The Zelmea Crest that awaits them was stolen during an attack on a ship belonging to the World Innkeepers Association. The purpose of this attack remains unclear.

species.name: Phalaris bull
species.flavor: A beastman who is feared as the executioner of the wilderness. In addition to the devastating blows fired from his strong arms, he also uses lightning spells. Actually, I'm not good at handling iron balls. It would be more efficient for him to hit with his bare hands, but his pride as an iron ball boy makes him continue his daily routine.

species.name: Dark buzzard
species.flavor: A jet-black bird that spreads death and is said to have been born in ancient times. It spreads death to all living things with its Air Pollution and Kazammle. It is said to be the ancestor of the Hawk Moth, Snowbird, and many other bird monsters, but the truth remains unknown.

species.name: Coral dimos
species.flavor: A synthetic beast that has been given the ability to move underwater thanks to dark magic. Even in the ocean, it can rain down meteors and scatter scorching flames. They are excellent hunters who use their vivid body coloring to camouflage themselves as coral and attack prey. They have the patience to remain motionless for long periods of time.

species.name: Basiliscale
species.flavor: A monster with a wealth of combat experience that excels at mid-range combat using double claws and breath attacks from its long arms. It loves poisonous air, so when it is feeling down it licks the poison that has seeped into its sharp claws and feels better.

species.name: Paintbrush hermit
species.flavor: A mysterious demonic hermit who is the only one who drops materials for summoning charms. He hides behind a powerful bodyguard and rarely shows himself. Since he possesses special materials and is protected by bodyguards, he must be a VIP. Monsters can be deceptive.

species.name: Paladinsaurus
species.flavor: Its own scales harden and emit a unique glow, making it appear as if it is wearing

species.name: Guardian angel
species.flavor: A rare Harmor in the world, where the evil grudge was canceled out while being attacked by a holy attack, and in its place was imbued with holy power. Just because it's an angel doesn't mean it's kind; it's not at all gentle and will use super powerful attacks, so be careful.

species.name: Venompede
species.flavor: A caterpillar that breathes sticky threads that restrict movement and poisonous breath. Rotates its rounded body at high speed and approaches enemies slowly. It is said that a Killerpillar that fails to become a pupa becomes a Venompede when it swells and releases poison.

species.name: Diablada
species.flavor: A legendary dancer who is spoken of as a miracle in the world of devil dancing. It is said that the sharpness of his Sword Dance can even cut large rocks in half. Anyone who can tell the difference can clearly see the difference in the level of perfection between this and the dance of a weak devil, but unfortunately there is not much difference in the effect of the speech.

species.name: Pretty cat fly
species.flavor: A self-proclaimed healing cat demon who recovers with her Hustle Dance and shows off her dependability with the attack power of Sword Dance. She has known her partner, Sexy cat fly, for many years, but deep down she thinks she is cuter.

species.name: Sexy cat fly
species.flavor: A self-proclaimed devilish cat demon who charms you with her Charm-Cha-Cha and never forgets to create surprises with his cat tricks. She has known her partner Pretty cat fly for many years, but deep down she thinks she is the better woman.

species.name: Writhing root
species.flavor: Roots of the man-eating Malign Vine which seem to have a mind of their own. In truth more akin to tentacles, they can snatch a human and drag them underground in seconds flat.

species.name: Jurassic lloyd
species.flavor: A combat machine modeled after a dragon. Its main weapons are its steel claws and extendable tail, but it can also spew high-temperature flames using an internal combustion engine. They are made with technology that is clearly different from the Empire's Demon Soldiers, and are said to be a secret weapon from the Gateria Empire that has gone wild.

species.name: Hangelabra
species.flavor: A cruel demon who enjoys watching his prey suffer by blinding them with blinding lights and spraying deadly breath. His arms, which constantly support his entire body weight, are extremely powerful when used to attack, but they are literally his last resort as they inevitably result in him falling to the ground.

species.name: Platinasaurus
species.flavor: It is equipped with an advanced cooling system to cool the internal combustion engine, and it makes the most of it to emit a radiant breath. It's not actually made of platinum, but the name means that it is as strong as platinum, but there's no end to adventurers stealing its parts.

species.name: Gyldenaut
species.flavor: Glittering golden warriors who go around grabbing people's valuables, but always fail to find anything they like quite so much as their own twenty-four carat bones.

species.name: Gyldenbritches
species.flavor: Guv'nor of the Gyldenauts, and a great lover of booty. Enjoys draining his enemies' defences so his boys can step in and batter them.

species.name: Canaryano
species.flavor: A rainbow-colored monster bird that is one with its cage. It summons storms and unleashes heat to relentlessly pursue enemies that invade its territory until they die. The part that looks like a birdcage is apparently an exposed part of the skeleton. During breeding season, females lay eggs inside the cage and protect their chicks from predators.

species.name: Stone crablet
species.flavor: A monster that couldn't be crabbed if a stone tablet had been dropped in the past. The hardness of its shell is just as high as the stone tablet it carries on its back. It looks like a crab carrying a stone slab on its back, but in fact it is said that the grudge that resides in the discarded stone slab has given birth to the body of a demon that attacks.

species.name: Tricky devil
species.flavor: This little monster likes nothing more than hiding in treasure chests and playing pranks on people, but they tend to go off with a whimper rather than a bang. It might be time to change its name...

species.name: Tweedledoom and Tweedledeath
species.flavor: This lumbering trailmaster lurks in the depths of the Kingsbarrow, patiently awaiting any knights who wish to prove the depth of their camaraderie.

species.name: Geyzer in Memoriam
species.flavor: The first challenge you meet when you take a walk down Memories Lane. Not the sharpest tool in the box, but he'll wipe you out if you lake might of him.

species.name: Tortured Soul in Memoriam
species.flavor: Part of the second challenge that awaits down Memories Lane. Largely a healer for his cronies, for which he may employ Kazing, he may also injure the entire party with a single strike.

species.name: Trap Box in Memoriam
species.flavor: The third challenge down Memories Lane - another monster once slain by the party in the past, now back 'in memoriam' to deal a deadly concoction of critical hits and Whack wizardry

species.name: Don Mole in Memoriam
species.flavor: The fourth challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane. Don Mole's dead, but he still feels good. You knew that he would now. Oh yeah, he's duggone dangerous

species.name: Argon Lizard in Memoriam
species.flavor: The fifth challenge that a trip down Memories Lane leads you to. This great beast loves to scare the party stiff with it's terrifying war cries.

species.name: Gemon in Memoriam
species.flavor: The seventh challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane. For some reason - perhaps cowardice - he doesn't like to fight alone, and often summons his Dark Turkey and Darkbird lackeys.

species.name: Sir Leopold in Memoriam
species.flavor: The eighth challenge awaiting those who take a trip down Memories Lane. He uses a muttley assortment of breath attacks that hit the whole party. His weakness appears to be poison.

species.name: Dark Servant in Memoriam
species.flavor: The ninth challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane. Together with it's dancing flame flankers, it unleashes a deadly squall of Scorch and other attacks against the party.

species.name: Ruin in Memoriam
species.flavor: The tenth challenge that awaits those that take a trip down Memories Lane, Most attacks are futile against this impenetrable fortress of a foe, leaving only critical hits and defence dodging strikes to play with.

species.name: Jessica in Memoriam
species.flavor: The eleventh challenge to present itself on a trip down Memories Lane. Sepia seems to suit her, and this Jessica can captivate men with complete consistency. The more women in the party, the better.

species.name: Marcello in Memoriam
species.flavor: The twelfth knight - or rather, the twelfth challenge to be faced down Memories Lane, in the form of the Templar Marcello. In memoriam, his battle devices of choice are Fizzle and sweeping attacks against the whole party.

species.name: Dhoulmagus in Memoriam
species.flavor: Unlucky for some, the thirteenth challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane consists of Dhoulmagus in triplicate - one who attacks, one who heals and one who revives.

species.name: Skeleton in Memoriam
species.flavor: Part of the second challenge that awaits down Memories Lane. This rattling bag of bones likes to attack with his Walking Corpse companion.

species.name: Walking Corpse in Memoriam
species.flavor: Part of the second challenge that awaits down Memories Lane. This stinky stiff likes to attack with his skeleton sidekick.

species.name: Darkbird in Memoriam
species.flavor: A member of the seventh challenge you encounter down Memories Lane, who quietly bolsters his feathered friends in battle with Multiheal and Kasap.

species.name: Dark Turkey in Memoriam
species.flavor: A cocky member of the seventh challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane. He likes to stun the party into inaction with loud squawks.

species.name: Dancing Flame in Memoriam
species.flavor: A member of the ninth challenge you encounter down Memories Lane. Appearing with a Servant of Darkness, together they unleash a deadly squall of Scorch and other attacks against the party.

species.name: Shadow in Memoriam
species.flavor: An extra in the eleventh challenge you encounter down Memories Lane, this shadow is never far behind Evil Jessica, but only manages physical attacks in the main.

species.name: Wrongo bongo
species.flavor: The black sheep of the Bongo drongo family due to a lack of any discernible rhythm. Its tunes are said to be so bad that they cause those who hear them to go deaf for days.

species.name: Booga
species.flavor: A Spectral Sentinel and casino magnate whose monstrous dedication to his own desires caused him to corrupt Jade.

species.name: Pilferpithecus
species.flavor: If this sticky-fingered simian hadn't stolen Rodolfo Briscoletti's breaktime banana way back when, he wouldn't have had to be sealed away until his descendant Rodrigo's day.

species.name: Headless honcho
species.flavor: Headless commanders in the army of a certain Spectral Sentinel who keep their underlings in line with judicious use of their massive morning stars.

species.name: Gloomnivore
species.flavor: This cruel creature spent a lifetime gorging itself on the suffering of men, and found a particularly repast in the form of King Irwin's tragic fate.

species.name: Grampogriff
species.flavor: The old man who was absorbed into the statue of Pegasus after years of praying to get a glimpse of that noble being. They're right when they say you should be careful what you wish for!

species.name: Nagasus
species.flavor: Though a gentle gee-gee by nature, this creature combined with the statue of Pegasus to become a seething steed of petrifying proportions.

species.name: Kirinji giraffe
species.flavor: He was a genius child of the Giruffian clan who had great expectations for his future from an early age, but as he grew older, he became attracted to darkness and went astray. The stress of the expectations placed on him and the arrogance that came with being a genius had a negative effect on him, and he developed a completely cruel and exclusive personality.

species.name: Doomsday dragon
species.flavor: When some slimes found a fygg and feasted on it, they transformed into this deadly dragon-the most abominable creature they could imagine. Unfortunately, none of them remembers any of it.

species.name: Revivalist
species.flavor: A mean-spirited maritime menace who couldn't stand the sight of others being reborn, so took steps to put a stop to it.

species.name: Dud dude
species.flavor: A bad-tempered brute without an iota of appeal who tried to get into Tania's good books by disguising himself as her brother.

species.name: Jiangshi ghost
species.flavor: A Ghost with no redeeming features is transformed by a strange magic spell into a cool Ghost who is good at casting spells. The truth is, the banknote in front of me is really bothering me, but I'm worried it'll be dangerous if I take it without permission, so I'll endure the stress today as well.

species.name: Dazey
species.flavor: A fleur fatale found in the Neverglade, where it puffs out stupendously soporific pollen in order to send enemies to sleep.

species.name: Blind Hatred
species.flavor: The Luminary's most unpleasant animosities made flesh. Its swords, forged from pure loathing, cut cruel wounds not just into the body, but the very soul as well.

species.name: Unfathomable Anger
species.flavor: The Luminary's untrammeled rage made flesh. A deep sea beast that seethes and roils with boiling fury, its mere presence can call forth devastating storms, even from hundreds of fathoms beneath the surface.

species.name: Sheer Decadence
species.flavor: The Luminary's worst excesses made flesh. Those who cave in to temptation and give themselves up to debauchery will themselves paying a weighty price in the afterlife.

species.name: All Consuming Greed
species.flavor: The Luminary's most grotesque gluttonies made flesh. Its fangs can tear straight through steel, and its roar can make even the most fearless fighter's hair stand on end.

species.name: Abject Terror
species.flavor: The Luminary's deepest fears made flesh. Appears alongside Darkest Despair in order to drag those who have lost faith in life down into the depths of hell.

species.name: Darkest Despair
species.flavor: The Luminary's fear of failure made flesh. Appears alongside Abject Terror in order to drag those who have lost faith in life down into the depths of hell.

species.name: Crimson killing machine
species.flavor: A unique, ultra-high performance machine roaming the Realm of Fire. It wipes out swarms of enemies with its ruthless Fissure Fists. It was created as a successor to the Mechidroid, but was never mass-produced because its performance exceeded expectations and its creators feared it.

species.name: Bright Crystal Beast Zolzom
species.flavor: An evil spirit-type demonic beast that can generate a substance called a crystal nucleus. Driven by a strong grudge, it escaped from the Netherworld's Great Training Grounds. They were created by giving spiritual elements to ancient crystals that have existed in the Netherworld since ancient times. According to Gabra, despite their appearance, they are friendly.

species.name: Racoon platypunk
species.flavor: He's the drunkard of the Platypunk world. He shows up at parties all over the country singing, dancing, throwing around Kaswooshles and causing mayhem. Originally, he was just a normal Platypunk. He was made to look like this as punishment for causing a terrible disturbance, but he doesn't seem to mind at all.

species.name: Super darkism
species.flavor: The painting is displayed in the Magic Garden, but it also serves as the museum's security. The ideas behind this painting were sublimated into Dark Realism. An artistic concept that seeks to explore the dark beauty that represents the chaos of all things. The famous artist who advocated it was Maldragora.

species.name: Death Romanism
species.flavor: This is a painting that hangs in the Madesses Museum, but it also serves as a guard for the museum. The idea behind this painting is sublimated into Wild Fobism. They found beauty in the concept of death, which was often overlooked in the Netherworld, and created an era in the history of demon art. The center of the movement was Maldragora.

species.name: Phantom General Fuzzma
species.flavor: A sorcerer who serves as one of the four demon generals under Demon Marshal Zerudorado. He can manipulate illusions and send his enemies to their deaths within virtual images. He considers himself to be the most intelligent of the Four Demon Generals, but the other three don't think so at all.

species.name: Boodiful Hocus-poker
species.flavor: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Harnesses its inhuman mastery of magic to inflict pain on prisoners, and has a huge laugh doing so.}}

species.name: Boodiful Hoodlum
species.flavor: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Loves to hear victims beg for their lives before brutally butchering them.

species.name: Boodiful Wizard
species.flavor: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Incorporates all kinds of evil incantations into its efforts to drive prisoners to the depths of despair.

species.name: Boodiful Smogbonnet
species.flavor: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Its marvelous memory means it's able to fondly recall its favourite shrieks for years after eliciting them.

species.name: Boodiful Sootbonce
species.flavor: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Specialises in claw-based cruelty aimed at petrified prisoners.

species.name: Grave digger
species.flavor: A monster used by Captain Morva of the Desert Mole Thieves. Be careful of its fierce attacks using its four arms. The name was given to him by Captain Morva and apparently means "gravedigger." He doesn't like it, but he can't speak the language so he can't say it.

species.name: Halberdsaurus
species.flavor: A monster that drifted into the Gharial Cave in the False world from somewhere. It swings a giant axe and cuts down everything. Halbredsauruses have used the same axe for generations, and cannot tolerate losing it, even when they sleep.

species.name: Samba beakon
species.flavor: She is the fashion leader of the Netherworld, adorned with gorgeous feather ornaments... but only she thinks of it, and those around her are put off by her flashiness. The feather he wears on his back is made from pieces that were collected one by one from the fallen birds of the Lotus Sutra. It is the fruit of his blood, sweat and tears.

species.name: Emerald Dragon
species.flavor: A giant dragon with scales of deepest forest-green. Fought Hero and the party to draw out their fullest potential.

species.name: Amethyst crab
species.flavor: A celebrity in the crab monster world, carrying an amethyst on his back. He doesn't mind scattering it around in a big way during Gorgeous Rain. He has a close friendship with Stone Crablet and often gives advice to his friend who is often at the mercy of fate. He is a compassionate and caring person.

species.name: Guardian of the Dark Tree
species.flavor: A mysterious group of monsters appearing around the Great Dark Tree. They will mercilessly attack anyone who approaches the tree. The guardians of the Great Dark Tree have no names or genders, and apart from having a single leader, there seems to be no distinction between them.

species.name: Fuginmunin
species.flavor: He is an information master in the Netherworld who has excellent thinking and memory skills and uses his minion, the Stark Raven, to gather gossip from all over the place. He can use the information he gathers however he likes. Sometimes he sells it to those in power, other times he uses it to trick his enemies. He's a man of cunning and tactical wit.

species.name: Monogette
species.flavor: Cruelcumber, a plant-type creature, has somehow been reincarnated into a material-type creature. Apparently, he's been hired as a bodyguard because of his green origins. He once served the Kamaboko Shogunate, but during the turbulent times, his family line was wiped out. Now he lives as a ronin and aims to restore the Shogunate.

species.name: Buntzenberner
species.flavor: An evil incarnation of fire that exploits the lusts of the Dwarves. It will not disappear unless its central core is removed. Buntzenberner Hearts are extremely small and require considerable skill to steal. Despite all the big talk, it's actually just the size of a flea's heart.

species.name: Heavenloon
species.flavor: A bright red balloon-shaped monster floating in the air. Contrary to its round appearance, it performs a sharp dance. It is said that the name "Heaven Balloon" comes from the fact that when people encounter it, they are greeted by a dance of death and taken to heaven.

species.name: Blackseed kid
species.flavor: When the black sesame seeds that had fallen to the ground gathered together and formed a small mountain over time, they began to move with a will of their own. A fairy made from 100% sesame seeds. Basically, it's a lump of sesame seeds, which fall apart as you walk, creating a fragrant sesame road in your wake.

species.name: Apostandle
species.flavor: A monster that lights up a high-temperature blue flame. It looks cool but has a strong fighting spirit and uses Kafrizz, which has enhanced magical power, to burn down the enemy until it turns to ashes. He catches a candle demon and tricks him into buying a starter light at a high price by telling him that the blue flame is cool. Is this a real flame marketing tactic?

species.name: Mossy ghoul
species.flavor: A small demon that grew up eating poisonous plants. It drips bodily fluids from the tips of its claws and paralyzes or poisons any enemies it scratches, rendering them immobile before eating them. The green parts of its body are covered with moss, and when it gets wet in the rain, it releases spores, making a strong appeal to moss girls.

species.name: Carapoppo
species.flavor: Although it is often looked down upon due to its appearance and name, it is a fire demon bird that is considered to be as high-ranking as the Prism peacock among bird monsters. There is debate in academic circles about the origin of the name Carapoppo; one theory is that it comes from the fact that the bird has an empty stomach, and the other is that it comes from the sound of the flames spewing out.

species.name: Torchgan
species.flavor: A variant of the Wax Murderer that contains the explosive power of lava. It burns the enemy with the hellish flames stored in its strong body. Her fellow Wax Murderers will melt if you get too close. As a result, he is always kept at a distance and, ironically, his heart is cold.

species.name: Whitey clubber
species.flavor: He wanders around in search of a worthy opponent and challenges anyone he comes across. If he deems them unworthy, he sentences them to death. Although they are called judges, they decide who to pass judgment on based on their own selfish likes and dislikes, so it is hard to say they are fair or impartial.

species.name: Jungleye
species.flavor: A fearsome assassin of the sky, aiming at its prey from above and casting cursed blades, drawing the victim into its own pace with dazzling light. They love to sing, and in their free time they sway their bodies and make a unique sound that is neither a song nor a growl, called the Jungleye Melody.

species.name: Sinistletoe
species.flavor: A winged tree monster that flies around searching for criminals. Its giant eye will not miss any crime. It is said that anyone gazed upon by the Sinistletoe will be unable to bear the power of her gaze and will confess their sins.

species.name: Angerope
species.flavor: It was used as a shimenawa. A mass was placed in the rope and it started to move. The abundant techniques using the soft arms are not to be underestimated. He risked his life to seal a place believed to be harmful to humans, only to have it torn apart by a heartless person. His heart trembles with rage.

species.name: Gangrem
species.flavor: A Demon that casts advanced spells. Use Moreheal to turn the tide and attack with powerful spells. Be careful especially towards the end of the battle. Although he is a powerful spellcaster, his special skill as a Demon is serving. He flies around with agility and never empties the drinking cups of his master or guests.

species.name: Jadoai
species.flavor: A giant monster with a carved face made of jade. Its brilliance is overwhelming and so solemn that it freezes everything. Because it is made of jade, its surface is smooth and is looked upon with envy by the rough-surfaced Mad Moai.

species.name: Tengale
species.flavor: A yokai with speed like the wind. It specializes in powerful wind-related attacks such as the gale attack and Kaswoosh. Although he calls himself Tengu, he has a complex about his low nose. Dreaming of having a beautiful, high nose, he secretly wears a nose clip.

species.name: Harvest dragon
species.flavor: A dragon with a large golden tree growing on its back. It uses Oomph to increase its attack power and crushes opponents with its massive body. Be careful of its Burning Breath. The mighty and arrogant dragon spoke. "I'm not one to be harvested. I was given this name because I harvest adventurers."

species.name: Platinumimic
species.flavor: A monster that disguises itself as a luxurious-looking treasure chest. It will deliver a fatal attack to any traveler who is driven by greed and tries to open the chest. She seeks a luxurious, clean, and stylish place to live that suits her looks, but the conditions are strict and she can't find a place where she feels at ease.

species.name: Skycat
species.flavor: A cat demon dancing magnificently in the sky. He calls Bounce with the magical power he stole from Drain Magic. Do you like magic or hate it? I love blue skies on sunny days and am sensitive to changes in the weather. Skycats washing their face seems to be a sign of rain.

species.name: Pinkmushslime
species.flavor: A deceptively evil slime that dazzles travelers with suspicious spores and further inflicts suffering with paralysis and poison. Surprisingly, he hates mushrooms and throws away any mushrooms that grow on his body without thinking about where they go, which makes him disliked for being selfish.

species.name: Akuma knight
species.flavor: A masked knight with a secret mission. He appears in the darkness before dawn accompanied by a bat. Be careful of his desperate attack. He hides snacks such as nuts and insects on the inside of his cloak for the bats he summons. The slits in the snacks mark the slits in the border.

species.name: Mashouu
species.flavor: A Killer Gila that underwent a terrifying evolution after gaining demonic powers. It stores miasma in its body. It's said that it grows inside a giant crevice and cannot get out. What was it thinking?!

species.name: Mouldfish
species.flavor: A fish monster that swims in the ocean of the underworld. It attacks with its dark breath and powerful lightning bolts, sending its enemies to the brink of death. When it was alive and swimming in the ocean, it was a rare and monstrous fish that was sought after. It is said to have bitten the fingers of many anglers.

species.name: Killseeker
species.flavor: An elite overkilling machine that will kill any prey it targets. It will knock its opponents down with the force of the ground, immobilizing them. It is equipped with sensors for heat, sound, vibration, etc. to track down targets for elimination. If it were to be pursued by a Prisma Run pursuer in the middle of the night, it would surely be a crushing victory.

species.name: Shamanju
species.flavor: She boasts a vibrant crimson body like a manjushage flower. She also has a horrifying side, using her mysterious Death Dance to lure people to their deaths. They gather their friends and compete in a contest to see who has the most beautiful Kurenai. In order to win, they make an effort to suck the living blood of others.

species.name: Slimachine Z
species.flavor: A slime that has been remodeled by a mad scientist. Watch out for Kazapstrophe, which it emits at maximum output voltage. Until the completion of Sura Machine Z, it seems that a total of 25 prototype slimes were made from Cyber Slime A to Y.

species.name: Yellowjackwasp
species.flavor: A selected Waspion raised on a special nutritional diet. It is not only physically strong, but also has a clear mind and is mentally strong. The pollen balls it wears are rumored to be a complete nutritional food. It seems to improve beauty and health, causing them to be worried about being targeted by adventurers.

species.name: Marbguar
species.flavor: A ferocious beast that is consumed with rage and attacks anything that moves. It uses its sharp claws to unleash its powers and eradicate all living things around it. They have the ability to sense emotions directed towards them through their smell, and in fact they only attack in response to fear or hostility.

species.name: Ayashiitake
species.flavor: It is a popular mushroom in the Funghoul world, rich in umami ingredients. Even mushrooms that are thrown at you taste delicious. Its popularity does not make it arrogant, and its down-to-earth nature is also one of its charms. It has topped the ranking of mushrooms people want to become for three consecutive years.

species.name: Jiatick
species.flavor: Lunatick has adapted to the crystallizing light emitted by the Jia Kut Clan, and attacks with abilities and ferocity far surpassing those of the original monster. After transforming into a mineral lifeform, his prized eyes have become even more powerful and shining. It's said that just being exposed to his gaze can send tingling sensations through one's body.

species.name: Jiademon
species.flavor: A Demon steward that has adapted to the crystallizing light emitted by the Jia Kut Clan, it attacks with abilities and ferocity far surpassing those of its original monster. Apparently, he came to pay his respects to Belfggor, who was his superior when he was a regular Demon Steward. He is grateful to the Jia Kut Clan.

species.name: Ray-finned sahuagin
species.flavor: A cool, sharp-edged merman with striped patterns. He is proud of his jagged dorsal fin, which scratches anyone who touches it. Why stripes? Stripes are cool! Are you complaining? Come outside, damn it!

species.name: Magmados the Flame King of Darkness
Tornados the Dark Wind King of Darkness
Dune stalker
species.flavor: A destructive weapon with enhanced dust-proofing functions intended for carrying out operations in the desert. His green mono-eye shining on the horizon signifies death.
