In order to protect the internal structure from sandstorms, the gaps between parts are so perfectly aligned that it is said to be a pain to disassemble for maintenance.

species.name: Woolmaulus
species.flavor: The shorn wool was blown away by the wind and gathered together, and the grudge of the naked sheep took hold of it, turning it into a monster. Its fluffy fur is connected, and if it were all untangled, it would be long enough to easily circle Astoltia three times.

species.name: Dragnoir
species.flavor: A juvenile jet-black dragon that bears the resemblance of a mighty dragon. The whole party suffers with his shimmering breath. When an old Dragnoir is crowned with a golden crest, it will be feared as a dragon with power that is equal to that of a god.

species.name: Twisticider
species.flavor: A child of the clouds whose body contains a special gas that crackles and pops. Its breath is freezing and stimulating. They often invite their friends over and dance together, twisting their bodies. Apparently it's fun to hear the gas in their bodies popping.

species.name: Jadewarrior
species.flavor: A troublesome demonic flame warrior who seeks to burn the world to ashes. He attacks using a combination of Acid Breath and flame bullets. When the sacred tree was cut down by scoundrels and put on fire, an evil flame sparkling like a jewel flared up and gave birth to demons.

species.name: The thing that goes to the deep sea
Cottoncloud
species.flavor: A delicious-looking monster with a sweet fragrance emanating from its fluffy body. However, underestimating it could pose a nasty surprise. Because of its sweet scent and appearance, it was often tried by adventurers, which was a source of trouble for it, so it learned the technique of disappearing.

species.name: Leghorn emperor
species.flavor: A user of scorching flames worthy of his bright red tail feathers, he has laid many adventurers to rest with Kasizzle. Because its body color is similar to that of certain livestock, the protrusion on its head is often mistaken for a crest. However, if you look closely, you will see that it is actually a horn, so don't make that mistake.

species.name: Silhoubaron
species.flavor: A noble shadow monster with a noble title. His features are magnificent and handsome, and his gaze is filled with compassion for his subjects...or so it seems. In fact, he was a low-ranking noble. Due to his excellence, he was well-liked by the king and was the object of jealousy from the higher-ranking nobles, which made him haggard from the stress...or so it seems.

species.name: Deadorian
species.flavor: A shield-wielding specialist who can perform a variety of techniques with the spiked shields he holds in both hands. His motto is "offense is the best defense." It's called that because it looks like that, but I'm careful about the smell. It's okay. It doesn't smell bad.

species.name: Bloodape
species.flavor: A giant monkey with wings reminiscent of a flying dragon. With its powerful arms, it can easily throw boulders taller than itself. His scary name can easily lead to misunderstandings, but he was born with red fur. He's sick and tired of people worrying that its blood spurting out of his body.

species.name: Bloodcorn
species.flavor: A sinister crimson incarnation of corn. It uses its Hurt Converter to suck out the adventurer's vitality and weaken them. He is particularly particular about the dyed black beard on his head, and apparently spends half a day styling it to look just like that.

species.name: Kurogane giant
species.flavor: A giant with a body of steel forged by first-class craftsmen, a blow from his lustrous black fists can shatter even a stone wall. Kurogane means iron. In short, it is an iron giant, but it is hollow inside because it would be too heavy if it was made entirely of iron.

species.name: Vividoai
species.flavor: A gigantic stone head painted in brilliant colors. The overwhelming sense of color dazzles and confuses the viewer. When he was young, he was just a stone, but he wanted to change his plain self, so he transformed into something flashy, and he is a hard worker who successfully changed his image by honing his skills.

species.name: Fluzula
species.flavor: A mysterious monster that appears suddenly without a sound and eats humans. It is said that attacks other than the black spear are ineffective against it... The sturdy castle is a miraculous haven for the people of Zenias, but to the Fluzula, it is nothing more than a farm for prey.

species.name: Wight ruler
species.flavor: After a painful and painful life, this monarch wanders forever in order to inflict the drudgery of death on all living things. "We're cursing the world with the slogan "no curse, no life," but we're not even living in the first place!" she says, waiting to be teased.

species.name: Phantom general of the devil's plan
Purplanary
species.flavor: A bird fascinated by darkness, who has only mastered techniques and spells related to darkness. He believes in being cool and stylish. I have directed characters who live in the darkness, but I am worried that their comical appearance is making it difficult to get the role I want. I am now considering changing my approach.

species.name: Jellyfish kid
species.flavor: A completely different species of jellyfish monster from the Man o' war. It is called a boy, but it seems to be already an adult. It is surprisingly firm for a jellyfish, but when you press it, it has just the right amount of elasticity, and it is said that using it as a pillow makes for a very good night's sleep.

species.name: Whitecorn
species.flavor: She is a woman of beauty and dignity who is highly regarded even among the madam community. Even her attack methods are sweet and gorgeous, making her the ultimate madam. She is also famous as a gem collector, and the gems scattered by Gorgeous Rain are only a small part of them. Is her rival Sage Marine?

species.name: Bourgeois hand
species.flavor: Rings with expensive jewels and I wore a famous brand bracelet to see this. A nasty rich monster. I'm dissatisfied with not being able to wear ornaments such as earrings and pendants, so I'm spending money today to relieve the stress.

species.name: Scarabelina
species.flavor: With a shell that has a poisonous color scheme, it is the ominous creature of the beetle world. It also has the same attack methods as other beetles, sucking blood and poisoning it. Due to her naturally flashy appearance, she plays the role of a scoundrel, but deep down, she is a coward and an earnest person, which causes her to accumulate stress on a daily basis.

species.name: Darktor
species.flavor: He entered the path of faith, but was unable to endure the training, and was taken over by the darkness and turned into a monster. His purpose in life is to cause failure in the training of Priests. As a person, he was a former Priest, but it seems he became accustomed to the waters of the dark world, and as a monster he was reborn as a high-ranking priest.

species.name: Macely
species.flavor: The remains of a corrupted soul who wields Funereal Force and seeks to pass judgment on his enemies with Kaswoosh, granting them the peace of death. From the moment he was born, he knew no love, hated people, cursed the world, and rebelled against God's grace, devoting himself to evil deeds, but he lost his life as a result of divine punishment.

species.name: Kylla
species.flavor: A protector of the pyramid and one of Baramos's underlings. When a certain coworker slacks off, the glare it gives would cause other monsters to cower in fear.

species.name: Phantasm
species.flavor: Despicable spirits that turned Theddon into a village of death. They grow stronger each day by gorging on the anguish of any wandering souls they can catch.

species.name: Ashdemon
species.flavor: A demon of some distinction with a body of purest silver. Bombards its enemies with a wide array of abilities enabled by its elevated intellect.}}

species.name: Lightmour
species.flavor: A trial monster that stands in front of the brave and the Great Demon King who visit Grand Zenus's Trial Grounds. It has the power of God. I designed the shield myself. When I look at the ephemeral maiden's profile, my heart, which should not exist, is pounding.

species.name: Shadowmour
species.flavor: A trial monster that stands in front of the brave and the Great Demon King who visit Grand Zenus's Trial Grounds. It has the power of the devil. I designed the weapon myself. The heart, which should not exist in a large and cool weapon, is hot and hot.

species.name: Monochromour
species.flavor: A trial monster that stands in front of the brave and the Great Demon King who visit Grand Zenus's Trial Grounds. It has the power of God and Devil. I'm curious about the left half of the Lightmour that should have been left over when I created myself and the right half of the Shadowmour.

species.name: Gentledevil
species.flavor: The Gentledevil is also in the Monster Gentleman's Record. The dance is colorful, gorgeous, and teaches us what it means to be a gentleman. Silhoubaron, the same Rarefied monster, is a best friend, but the meeting was a duel for each other's honor.

species.name: Abouk, the weeping general of steel
Mummycanth
species.flavor: It is an ancient fish that has become a zombie, but it is unclear whether it is a fish that became a zombie long ago or whether it is a living ancient fish that has recently become a zombie. They call themselves "dead fossils", not "living fossils", which would technically make them plain fossils, but do not point this out to them, they get upset.

species.name: Hikuinadon
species.flavor: A ferocious and colorful monster bird that can follow a group of Apeckalypses running. The most violent food, the three violent extremes, it has a reputation as the twilight of the world. There are also rumors that it is a mixed species of Firebird and Forest peckerel. When it appears with Apeckalypse, it is Mayutsuba.

species.name: Giraffgoon
species.flavor: It is said that a chosen giraffe, born with a probability of once every 100 years, will gain the power of the dragon when it survives to be 1000 years old. When he lived as a giraffe, he was not ashamed to be naked, but as soon as he transformed into a dragon and gained intelligence, he quickly put on clothes.

species.name: Baora, the Secret Bird General of the Golden God
Tricerathon
species.flavor: As Drag Racer continues to run, the body temperature continues to rise. A rare species with flushed skin, it's burning hot when you touch it. It's a habit to practice bumping. When their eyes meet, they rush forward. I'm being avoided by my friends. No one can stop him anymore.

species.name: Icieye
species.flavor: Born in a cave in the snowy mountains, he prefers dark and cold places. He's a nasty creature who finds travelers, puts them to sleep, and freezes them. When they lived in the snowy mountains, they moved around by crossing icicles, but when spring came, the icicles melted and they would slip and fall.

species.name: Madder merman
species.flavor: A monster met on the rocks where the Mermaids like to sun themselves. It's particularly proud of its bright red body

species.name: Octopest
species.flavor: Underlings of Mariella's met in the Mermaids' Sanctuary. Having spent their whole lives in the sea, they had never seen humans before, and judged them to be extremely funny-looking creatures indeed.

species.name: Midnight manguini
species.flavor: An underling of Belial's met at the Dragonlord's Castle. While it judges all non-monsters to be beneath it, little does it know that it's looked down upon itself by the higher-ups in the monster hierarchy.

species.name: Boat-borer
species.flavor: Among the creepiest of creepy-crawlies, they keep the sea free of flotsam by boring their way through the bottoms of boats, then eating everyone and everything inside

species.name: Goyling
species.flavor: An underling of Belial's met at the Dragonlord's Castle. Smaller than most of its associates, but actually more important-although still but a lowly pawn in its masters' game.

species.name: Cold boulder
species.flavor: Lumps of ice that slowly became sentient over the centuries. So incredibly cold that if you threw one into a lake, the water would freeze almost instantaneously.

species.name: Neanderdrohl
species.flavor: Precursors of the land-bound drohls we know today. Also known as 'olden drohls'.

species.name: Shining Armour
species.flavor: An underling of Mariella's met in her mysterious seabed base. It was sick of its mistress's selfishness, and looking to be posted elsewhere.

species.name: Hornipillar
species.flavor: Mixed in with the Killerpillar, although it is a larva of Dread admiral. By putting out horns, I can't help but appeal to the difference. Horn, which I'm going to drink, seems to smell good. It seems that it only led to the result of being targeted by Yokei.

species.name: Tower flying dragon
species.flavor: Sad monsters born within the Tower of Lost Creation are destined to prey on each other. Their grudges become the food for the gigantic Loss Waves. The dragons in the tower are in a very tense situation. Don't be jealous just because you can't fly! Even if you had wings, you still can't get out of the tower.

species.name: White general
species.flavor: General Kacrack, who leads the army of the dead, freezes the enemy who stands up with a fast slash and leads them to death. Apparently, in order to be able to handle four weapons at once, he trained using a knife, fork, spoon, and even chopsticks.

species.name: Hellbound pendulum
species.flavor: An ominous monster with a purchase that makes those who see it unhappy. There was nothing that was safe when I saw the contents of the suspiciously glowing hood. It is said that his hobby is to shake his body by dowsing, and his ability to find veins and things he is also said to be out of a hundred.

species.name: Kaiser slime
species.flavor: A huge slime who surpassed the king and gained the title of emperor. The dignified voice turns into a loud breath and attacks the opponent. As expected, even King Slime is afraid to miss in front of Kaiville. I think it's a little easy to be afraid of everyone.

species.name: Salt dragonia
species.flavor: A human-shaped monster with a dragon factor. He has absolute confidence in swordsmanship and defeats enemies with three-dimensional movements that make use of his jumping power. I don't know if it's because of the name, but I like salty things. I always hold a small bottle of salt and sprinkle it on sweet fruits.

species.name: Seventh kingdom remnant soldier
species.flavor: A humanoid weapon of the Galiante Kingdom that once existed. Starting to move again with the power of the Atma Stone, we are now fighting to protect the dead kingdom. I am very heartbroken because all the large humanoid weapons I relied on as a force have been broken.

species.name: Blazing skelegon
species.flavor: The dragon, resurrected by vengeful spirit despite being consumed by scorching flames, still has bones that are glowing red and boiling at high temperatures. The thirst that attacks me all the time, no matter how much water I drink, can ever quench. Is there no salvation for this cursed soul?

species.name: Orc guard
species.flavor: An elite warrior with a sense of mission who has improved his combat skills with the guardian of the orc tribe. I don't like being told that I'm conscious. By acquiring a spell from ordinary orcs as an existence on Kumono, the distance has been placed.

species.name: Zomfish
species.flavor: He turned into a zombie because he accidentally ate another zombie that fell into the water. Be careful about eating things you find on the ground. Since I was already dead, eating poison wouldn't be a problem. And as I consumed poison, I learned poison spells.

species.name: Phantom Dragon of a Distorted World
